rows.source: Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft's magnificent representation of Cromwell is evidence of 19th century opinion and part of the historiography of a figure who many believe is still worth celebrating.
rows.output: Ìtọ́kasí Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft ti Cromwell jẹ́ ẹ̀rí ìrònú ọ̀rúndún kọkàndínlógún àti apá kan nínú ìtàn ìtàn nípa ẹni tí ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn gbà pé ó ṣì níyì.
rows.reference: Ìṣátúnfihàn ńlá ti Ọlọ́lajὺlọ́ William Hamo Thorneycroft nípa Cromwell ni ẹ̀rí ti èrò ọgọ́ọ̀rún ọdún ìkọkàndínlógún àti ara àkọsílẹ̀ ìtàn ẹnikan tí ọ̀pọ̀ eniyan sí gbàgbọ́ wípé ó sì yẹ lẹ́nití a ńṣàjọyọ̀.

rows.source: Mr Goldsmith told The Sunday Telegraph: "Cromwell is regarded by many, perhaps more in the late 19th century than today, as a defender of parliament against external pressure, in his case of course the monarchy.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Goldsmith sọ fún The Sunday Telegraph: “Cromwell ni a kà sí ẹni tí ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn, bóyá ju ní ọ̀rúndún kọkàndínlógún lọ ju lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ lọ, gẹ́gẹ́ bí olùṣàkóso ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin lòdì sí ìfọkànsìn láti ìta, ní ọ̀nà rẹ̀ dájọ́ pé, ọba.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Goldsmith sọ fún Sunday Telegraph: “Cromwell ni ọ̀pọ̀ eniyan kàsí, bóyá jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ lópin ọgọ́ọ̀rún ọdún kọkàndínlógún ju òní lọ, gẹ́gẹ́bí olùdáààbó ìgbìmọ̀ aṣojú-ṣofiń kúrò lọ́wọ́ ìnira tó ńwá láti ìta, níti ẹjọ́ tirẹ̀ àní àwọn orí-adé.

rows.source: Whether that is a wholly accurate representation is the subject of continuing historical debate.
rows.output: Bóyá ìyẹn jẹ́ àfihàn tó péye pátápátá ni kókó ìjíròrò ìtàn tó ń lọ lọ́wọ́.
rows.reference: Bóyá ìyẹn jẹ ìsàtúnfihàn kan tó péye tí ó sì bójúmu jẹ́ orí ọ̀rọ̀ àríyànjiyàn ìtàn tó ńtẹ̀síwájú.

rows.source: What is certain is that the conflict of the mid 17th century has shaped the subsequent development of our nation, and Cromwell is an individual recognisable figure who represents one side of that divide.
rows.output: Ohun tí ó dájú ni pé ìjà náà ní àárín ọ̀rúndún kọkàndínlógún ti ní ipa lórí ìdàgbàsókè wa lẹ́yìn náà, àti Cromwell jẹ́ ẹni tí a lè mọ̀ tí ó ṣàfihàn ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn ẹgbè méjèèjì náà.
rows.reference: Ohun tó dáju nipé aáwọ̀ ti ààrin àwọn ọgọ́ọ̀rún ọdún kẹtàdínlógún se àpèjuwè bi a se kọ ìdàgbàsókè oríléède wa, Cromwell sìí jẹ ẹnìkan Pàtàkì tí o dúró fún ìpín apá kan.

rows.source: His achievements as Lord Protector are also worth celebrating and commemorating."
rows.output: Àwọn àṣeyọrí rẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí Olùṣàkóso Ọba jẹ́ ohun tí ó yẹ kí a ṣe ayẹyẹ àti ìránti.
rows.reference: Àwọn àṣeyọrí rẹ̀ bí Oluwa Olùdáààbò ni wọ́n tún yẹ láti máa sàjọyọ̀ àti láti maá rántí.''

rows.source: Killer Pig Mauls Chinese Farmer to Death
rows.output: Ẹ̀dá alágbára kan pa agbèjà Ṣáínà kan.
rows.reference: Ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ Apànìyàn Ṣekú pa Àgbẹ̀ Ṣáína kan.

rows.source: A farmer was attacked and killed by a pig in a market in southwest China, according to local media reports.
rows.output: Ọkùnrin àgbẹ̀ kan ni a pa nígbèkùn pẹ̀lú ẹ̀dá ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kan ní ọjà kan ní gúúsù ìwọ̀-oòrùn Ṣáínà, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn ìròyìn àgbègbè ṣe sọ.
rows.reference: Àgbẹ̀ kan ni ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kan kọlù tí ó sì pa á nínú ọjà kan ní apá ìwọ̀-oòrùn gúúsù orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà, gẹ́gẹ́bí àwọn ìròyìn agbègbè náà ti sọ.

rows.source: The man, identified only by his surname "Yuan," was found dead with a severed artery, covered in blood near a sty at the market in Liupanshui in Guizhou province, the South China Morning Post reported Sunday.
rows.output: Ọkùnrin náà, tí a mọ̀ sí orúkọ “Yuan,” ni wọ́n rí pé ó ti kú, pẹ̀lú ẹ̀dọ̀fóró tí a gé, tí ó sì kún fún ẹ̀jẹ̀ nítòsí ibi ìtajà kan ní Liupanshui ní Guizhou, gẹ́gẹ́ bí South China Morning Post ṣe royin ní ọjọ́ Sunday.
rows.reference: Ọkùnrin náà, tí wọ́n dá mọ̀ pẹ̀lú orúkọ mọ̀lẹ́bí rẹ̀ ''Yuan,'' ni wọ́n rí tóti kù pẹ̀lú ojú-òpó ẹ̀jẹ̀ ńlá kan eyiti ó ti gé, tí ẹ̀jẹ̀ sì bò ó nítòsì ilé ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kan ní ọjà ní ìlú Liupanshui ní ẹkùn Guizhou, ìwé ìròyín Morning Post ti Gúúsù Ṣáínà ni o sọ íròyìn naa lọ́jọ́ Àìkú.

rows.source: A pig farmer prepares to inject vaccines into pigs at a hoggery on May 30, 2005 in Xining of Qinghai Province, China.
rows.output: Agbọ̀n-ọ̀rùú kan ń gbaradì láti fi àwọn àbójútó sínú àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ ní ilé ìtọ́jú ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ ní May 30, 2005 ní Xining ti Qinghai Province, China.
rows.reference: Àgbẹ̀ ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kan ńgbaradì láti fún àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ lábẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára ní ilé ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kan lọ́gbọ̀njọ́, Oṣù Ẹ̀bibi, lọ́dun 2005 nílù Xining ti Ẹkùn Qinghai, lorilẹ-ede Ṣáínà.

rows.source: He had reportedly travelled with his cousin from the neighboring Yunnan province Wednesday to sell 15 pigs at the market.
rows.output: Ó ti sọ pé ó ti rin ìrìn àjò pẹ̀lú arákùnrin rẹ̀ láti ìpínlẹ̀ aládùúgbò Yunnan ní ọjọ́bọ̀ láti ta àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dógún ní ọjà.
rows.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́bí ìròyìn ti wí ó ti rin ìrìn-àjò pẹ̀lú ìbátan rẹ láti aláàmúlégbé ẹkùn Yunnan lọ́jọ́ 'Ru láti ta àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ mẹ́ẹ̀dógún ní ọjá náà.

rows.source: The following morning, his cousin found him dead, and discovered a door to a neighbouring pig sty open.
rows.output: Ní ọjọ́ kejì, arákùnrìnrì rẹ̀ rí i, ó sì rí ilé ìdáná ẹran ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kan tí ó ṣí sílẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ní òwurọ̀ ọjọ́ kejì, ìbátan rẹ̀ ríi tóti kú, tí ó sì ṣàwári wípé ìlẹ̀kùn kan sí ilé ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ aláàmúlégbe kan wà ní sísí sílẹ̀.

rows.source: He said that in the sty was a large male pig with blood on its mouth.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé nínú ilé ìdáná náà ni ọ̀dọ́mọkùnrin kan wà tí ẹ̀jẹ̀ wà ní ẹnu rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ó sọpé ní inú ilé ẹlẹ́dẹ náà ni akọ ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kan gbé wá pẹ̀lú ẹ̀jẹ̀ lẹ́nu rẹ̀.

rows.source: A forensic examination confirmed that the 550 pound hog had mauled the farmer to death, according to the report.
rows.output: Ìwádìí ìwádì í ṣe ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pé ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ tó lé ní kìlógíráàmù 550 (ìwọ̀n 250) ti pa àgbẹ̀ náà ní ìṣọ̀kan, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìròyìn náà ṣe sọ.
rows.reference: Àyẹ̀wò láti ṣàwárí àwọn ẹ̀rí fi ìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀ pé akọ ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ tó níwọn ìwúwo ẹgbẹ̀tadínláàádọ́ta pọ́un náà ti ṣe ìpalára fún àgbẹ̀ náà títí dójú ikù, gẹ́gẹ́bí ìròyìn náà ti sọ.

rows.source: "My cousin's legs were bloody and mangled," the cousin, referred to by his surname "Wu," said, as quoted by the Guiyang Evening News.
rows.output: "Ẹsìnrere mi ni ẹsìnrere rẹ̀ ti ń jẹ́ ẹ̀jẹ̀ àti pé ó ti fọ́," arákùnrin náà, tí a ń pè ní orúkọ ìkùukùu rẹ̀ "Wu," sọ, gẹ́gẹ́ bí a ti sọ pé ó jẹ́ ìrònú rẹ̀ ní Ìròyìn Ìrònú.
rows.reference: ìwé ìròyìn Guiyang Evening News yọ ọ̀ro ìbátaṇ̀ arákὺnrin náà lò o wipe ''Àwọn ẹsẹ̀ ìbátan mi ló jẹ́ kìkìdá ẹ̀jẹ̀ tíwọn sì ti fàya,''  ẹni tíwọ́n tọ́kasí nípa orúkọ ìdílé rẹ̀ ''Wu,''

rows.source: Security camera footage showed Yuan entering the market at 4.40 am Thursday to feed his pigs.
rows.output: Fídíò ẹ̀rù ẹ̀rù náà fi hàn pé Yuan wọ ọjà náà ní ọ̀sán ọjọ́bọ̀ ní ọ̀sán láti fi oúnjẹ fún àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ayawòrán aláàbò fi Yuan hàn bí ó ti ńwọnú ọjà lọ ní aago máàrún-ku-ogún ìsẹ́jú lọjọ 'Bọ̀ láti fún àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ rẹ̀ lóúnjẹ.

rows.source: His body was found about an hour later.
rows.output: Ìwọ̀n rẹ̀ ni wọ́n rí ní wákàtí kan lẹ́yìn náà.
rows.reference: òkú rẹ̀ ni wọ́n rí ní wákàtí kan lẹ́yìn náà.

rows.source: The animal who killed the man did not belong to Yuan or his cousin.
rows.output: Ẹrankó tí ó pa ọkùnrin náà kò jẹ́ ti Yuan tàbí arákùnrin rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ẹranko tí ó pa ọkùnrin náà kìí ṣe ti Yuan tàbí ìbátan rẹ̀.

rows.source: A market manager told the Evening News that the pig had been locked away to prevent it attacking anyone else, while police gathered evidence at the scene.
rows.output: Aláṣẹ ọjà kan sọ fún Evening News pé a ti pa ẹ̀dá náà mọ́ láti dènà kí ó máa fi ara rẹ̀ lé ẹnikẹ́ni mìíràn, nígbà tí àwọn ọlọ́pàá ń kó ẹ̀rí jọ ní ibi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà.
rows.reference: Olùṣàkóso ọjà kan sọ fún Evening News wipe ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ náà ni wọn ti tì mọ́lé láti dènà kíkọlu ẹlomiran, nigbati àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá ńkó ẹ̀rí jọ níbi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà.

rows.source: Yuan's family and market authorities are reportedly negotiating compensation for his death.
rows.output: Ìdílé Yuan àti àwọn aláṣẹ ọjà ń bá a lọ láti gba ẹ̀san fún ikú rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ìdíle Yuan àti àwọn aláṣẹ ọjà ni ìròyìn sọpé wọn ti ńjíròrò lórí àti san owó gbà-maá-bínu fún ikú rẹ̀.

rows.source: Though rare, cases of pigs attacking humans have been recorded before.
rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò wọ́pọ̀, àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ ń kọlu ènìyàn ti wà tẹ́lẹ̀.
rows.reference: Botilẹjepe kò wọ́pọ̀, àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ kí àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ máa kọlu àwọn eniyan ni wọ́n ti ṣe àkọsílẹ wọn saáju rí.

rows.source: In 2016, a pig attacked a woman and her husband at their farm in Massachusetts, leaving the man with critical injuries.
rows.output: Ní ọdún 2016, ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kan kọlu obìnrin kan àti ọkùnrí rẹ̀ ní oko wọn ní Massachusetts, ó sì fi ọkùnrín náà sílẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìfarapa tó le.
rows.reference: Lọ́dún 2016, ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kan kọlu obìnrin kan àti ọkọ rẹ̀ ní oko wọn ní ìlú Massachusetts, tí ò sì fi ọkùnrin náà sílẹ pẹ̀lú àwọn ìpalára báákú-bááyè.

rows.source: Ten years previously, a 650 pound pig pinned a Welsh farmer to his tractor until his wife scared the animal away.
rows.output: Ọdun mẹwa sẹ́yìn, ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kan tó lé ní kìlógíráàmù 650 ní Wales pa agbègbè kan mọ́ tractor rẹ̀ títí tí ìyàwó rẹ̀ fi lé e lọ.
rows.reference: Ní ọdún mẹ́wàá saáju, ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ oníwọ̀n ìwúwo ẹgbẹ̀taléláààdọ́ta pọ́un kan mú ọkùnrin àgbẹ̀ Welsh kan mọ́ ara katakata rẹ títí ti aya rẹ̀ fi dẹ́rùba ẹranko náà láti sálọ.

rows.source: After an Oregon farmer was eaten by his pigs in 2012, one Manitoba farmer told CBC News that pigs are not normally aggressive but the taste of blood can act as a "trigger."
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn tí agbègbè kan ní Oregon jẹ́ kí àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ rẹ jẹ ní ọdún 2012, agbègbè kan ní Manitoba sọ fún CBC News pé àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kò máa ń jẹ́ alágbára, ṣùgbọ́n ìtọ́jútù ẹ̀jẹ̀ lè ṣiṣẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí “ìmúlẹ̀.”
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn tí àgbẹ̀ Oregon kan di jíjẹ tán láti ọwọ́ àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ rẹ̀ lọ́dún 2012, àgbẹ̀ Manitoba kan sọ fún CBC News wípé níti bótiyẹ àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ kìí ya ẹhànnà ṣùgbọ́n ìtọ́wò ẹ̀jẹ̀ leè ṣe bíi ''okó ìbọn.''

rows.source: "They're just being playful.
rows.output: Wọ́n ń ṣe eré ìdárayá.
rows.reference: Wọ́n kàn máa ńjẹ eléré ni.

rows.source: They're nippers, very inquisitive ... they aren't out to hurt you.
rows.output: Wọ́n jẹ́ àwọn ọ̀dọ́langba, wọ́n sì ń béèrè lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Wọn jẹ ọmọdé eléèékánná, tó ńfẹ́ mọ ohun tó ńṣẹlẹ̀...wọ́n ko wa láti pa ọ́ lára.

rows.source: You just have to pay them the right amount of respect," he said.
rows.output: O kan gbọdọ san wọn ni iye ọwọ́ tí ó tọ́, ó sọ.
rows.reference: O kàn níláti fún wọn ní iye ọ̀wọ̀ tí ó yẹ, ni ó wí.

rows.source: Hurricane Rosa's remnants to bring widespread heavy rain to southwest US
rows.output: Ìdàpọ̀ ìjì líle Rosa yóò mú ìjì líle tó gbooro bá a rí ní gúúsù ìwọ̀-oòrùn US
rows.reference: Àwọn ìyókù Ìjì-lílè Hurricane Rosa yóò mú òjò wọ káàkàkiri ìwọ̀-oòrùn orilẹ-ede US

rows.source: As forecast, Hurricane Rosa is weakening as it moves over the cooler waters of the northern coast of Mexico.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí a ti sọ, ìjì líle Rosa ń dín kù bí ó ti ń lọ sí etíkun ìwọ̀ oòrùn ilẹ̀ Meksiko.
rows.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́bí àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ ojú-ọjọ́ ti sọ, agbára Hurricane Rosa ti ńdínkù bí ó ti gòkè lọ sórí àwọn omi tí ó tútú díẹ̀ síi ní àríwá bèbè òkun ti orilẹ-ede Mẹ́síkò.

rows.source: However, Rosa will bring flooding rains across northern Mexico and the southwest U.S. over the coming days.
rows.output: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, Rosa yóò mú ìkún omi ńlá kọjá ní apá àríwá Meksíko àti gúúsù ìwọ̀-oòrùn U.S. ní ọ̀sẹ̀ tó ń bọ̀.
rows.reference: Bótiwùkórí, Rosa yóò àwọn òjò oníìkún omi lọ́wọ́ bí ó ti ńla àríwá Mẹ́ṣíkò àti ìwọ̀-oòrùn orilẹ-ede U.S. kọ́ja ní àwọn ọjọ́ tó ḿbọ.

rows.source: Rosa had winds of 85 mph, a Category 1 Hurricane, as of 5 a.m. Eastern time Sunday, and was located 385 miles southwest of Punta Eugenia, Mexico.
rows.output: Rosa ní afẹ́fẹ́ 85 mph, ìkìlọ̀ ẹ̀fúùfù 1, ní ọjọ́ Aarọ̀, ó sì wà ní 385 kìlómítà gúúsù ìwọ̀-oòrùn ti Punta Eugenia, Meksiko.
rows.reference: Rosa ní àwọn afẹ́fẹ́ tí ìwọn ìṣọwọ́sáré rẹ̀ jẹ́ máàrúndínláàádọ́ọ̀rún ìbùṣọ̀ ní wákàtí kan, Ìji-líle Hurricane Oníṣọ̀rí 1 kan, títí aago máàrún òwúrọ̀. Àkókò ìlà-oòrùn lọ́jọ́ Àìkú, tí wọn tí rí i ní máìlí irinwódínmẹ́ẹ̀dógún ní ìwọ̀-oòrùn gúúsù ti ìlú Punta Eugenia, lorilẹ-ede Mẹ́ṣíkò.

rows.source: Rosa is expected to move north on Sunday.
rows.output: Rosa ni a nireti lati lọ si ariwa ni ọjọ́ Aiku.
rows.reference: Rosa ni wọ́n ńretí láti lọsí ìhà àríwá lọjọ́ Àìkú.

rows.source: Meanwhile, a trough is beginning to take shape over the Pacific Ocean and move east toward the West Coast of the U.S. As Rosa approaches the Baja California peninsula on Monday as a tropical storm it will begin to push deep tropical moisture northward into the southwest U.S.
rows.output: Ní báyìí, ìdàpọ̀ kan ń bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í dá sílẹ̀ ní Òkun Pàsífíìkì àti pé ó ń lọ sí ìlà oòrùn sí etí ìlà oòrùn ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà. Bí Rosa ṣe ń sunmọ́ ìpínlẹ̀ Baja California ní ọjọ́ Aarọ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìjì líle, yóò bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í mú ìrì dọ́tí tó jinlẹ̀ lọ sí ìwọ̀ oòrùn ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀wẹ̀, àlàfo jìnjìn kan ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí farahàn lórí omi Òkun Pacific tí ó sì ńlọ sí apá ìlà-oòrùn láti dójúkọ Etíkun Ìwọ̀-oòrùn orilẹ-ede U.S. Bí Rosa ti ńsúnmọ́ erékùsù Baja Carlifonia lọ́jọ́ ajé bíi ìjì ilẹ̀ olóoru yóò bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí taari omi jínjìn ti ilẹ̀ olóoru sí ìhà àríwá lọsí ìwọ̀-oòrùn gúúsù orilẹ̀-ede U.S.

rows.source: Rosa will bring up to 10 inches of rain in parts of Mexico on Monday.
rows.output: Rosa yóò mú ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ òjò, tó lè dé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìdá mẹ́wàá nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún, ní àwọn apá kan ilẹ̀ Meksíko ní ọjọ́ Aarọ̀.
rows.reference: Rosa yóò mú ìwọn òjò tí ó tó íǹsì mẹ́wàá wọ àwọn apá Mẹ́ṣíkò lọ́jọ́ Ajé.

rows.source: Then, tropical moisture interacting with the approaching trough will create widespread heavy rainfall in the Southwest over the coming days.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn náà, ìdàpọ̀ ìrì dídì tó ń bọ̀ pẹ̀lú ìdàpọ̀ ìrì dídì náà yóò mú ìrì dídì tó pọ̀ jù lọ ní Gúùsù ìwọ̀-oòrùn ní ọjọ́ tó ń bọ̀.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn náà, omi ilẹ̀ olóoru tó ńfara kan àlàfo jínjìn tó ḿbọ̀ yóò ṣẹ̀dá ẹ̀kúnrẹ́rẹ́ jákejádò apá Ìwọ̀-oòrùn Gúúsù ní àwọn ọjọ́ tó ḿbọ̀.

rows.source: Locally, 1 to 4 inches of rain will cause dangerous flash flooding, debris flows and possibility landslides in the desert.
rows.output: Ni agbegbe, 1 si 4 inches ti òjò le fa ìjì líle, ìjì líle, ati ìjì líle ni agbègbè agbègbè.
rows.reference: Ní ti agbègbè, ìwọ̀n òjò íǹsì 1 sí 4 yóò fa ìkún omi aláyalù tó léwu, àwọn ìsàn pàǹti àtipé ó ṣeé ṣe kí àwọn ilẹ̀ ya sínú omi nínú aṣálẹ̀.

rows.source: Deep tropical moisture will cause rainfall rates to approach 2 to 3 inches per hour in spots, especially in parts of southern Nevada and Arizona.
rows.output: Ìdàpọ̀ ìrì dọ́tí tó jinlẹ̀ yóò mú kí ìwọ̀n òjò pọ̀ sí i, ó lè dé 2 sí 3 inches ní wákàtí kan ní àwọn ibi kan, pàápàá ní apá gúúsù Nevada àti Arizona.
rows.reference: Omi olóoru tójínlẹ̀ yóò fa ìwọ̀n òjò rírọ̀ tí ó súnmọ́ íǹsì 2 sí 3 ni wákàtí kan ní àwọn ibi kan, papàá jùlọ ní àwọn apá ti gúúsù Nevada àti Arizona.

rows.source: As much as 2 to 4 inches of rain is expected in parts of the Southwest, especially over much of Arizona.
rows.output: Láàárín 2 sí 4 inches ti òjò ni a ń retí ní àwọn apá kan ti Gúúsù-ìwọ̀-oòrùn, pàápàá jùlọ ní apá ńlá ti Arizona.
rows.reference: Bi ìwọ̀n òjò íǹsì 2 si 4 ni wọ́n ńretí ní àwọn apá Ìwọ-oòrùn  Gúúsù náà, papàá jùlọ ní ọ̀pọ̀ agbègbè ti Arizona.

rows.source: Flash flooding is possible with rapidly deteriorating conditions due to the scattered nature of tropical rain.
rows.output: Ìkún omi lè ṣẹlẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìṣòro tó ń pọ̀ sí i nítorí ìṣọ̀tá ìjì líle.
rows.reference: Ó ṣeé ṣe kí ìkún omi aláyalù wáyé pẹ̀lú àwọn ipò tó ńburú síi nitori àbùdá onísége-sège ti òjò olóoru náà.

rows.source: It would be extremely ill advised to venture out into the desert on foot with the threat of tropical rainfall.
rows.output: Ó ṣeé ṣe kí ó jẹ́ ìwà ọ̀daràn láti jáde lọ sí àwọ̀n ìgbín láwọn ẹsọ̀ pẹ̀lú ewu ìjì líle.
rows.reference: Yóò jẹ́ àmọ̀ràn tí kò dára láti jáde síta sí inú aṣálẹ̀ náà pẹ̀lú ẹsẹ̀ níbití òjò olóoru tí ńdúnkóókò láti rọ̀.

rows.source: Heavy rain could cause canyons to become raging rivers and thunderstorms will bring locally gusty winds and blowing dust.
rows.output: Òjìji tó lágbára lè mú kí àwọn àfonífojì di odò tó ń rọ̀ àti ìjì líle yóò mú kí afẹ́fẹ́ tó ń rọ̀ ní àgbègbè kan àti ìrì dọ̀tí.
rows.reference: Ọ̀pọ̀ òjò leè fa kí àwọn àfonífojì di àwọn odò tó ńbínú fùfù tí àwọn ìjì abójòrìn yóò sì mú àwọn afẹ́fẹ́ agbègbè àti eruku tó ńfẹ́ lọ́wọ́.

rows.source: The approaching trough will bring some locally heavy rain to parts of the Southern California coastline.
rows.output: Ìdàrúdàpọ̀ tó ń bọ̀ yóò mú ìrì dànù wá sí àwọn apá kan etíkun Gúúsù California.
rows.reference: Àlàfo jínjìn tó ḿbọ̀ náà yóò mú ọ̀pọ̀ òjò agbègbè wọ àwọn apá ti bèbè okùn ìhà Gúúsù California.

rows.source: Rainfall totals of over half an inch are possible, which could cause minor debris flows and slick roadways.
rows.output: Ìdàpọ̀ omi òjò tó ju ìdajì inch lọ lè ṣẹlẹ̀, èyí tó lè fa àwọn ìṣàn ìdọ̀tí kékeré àti àwọn ọ̀nà tó ń rọ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn àrọ̀pọ̀ òjò rírọ̀ tí ó ju ìlàjì íǹsì kan lọ ṣeé ṣe, eyiti ó leè fa àwọn ìsàn pàǹtí ráńpẹ́ àti àwọn ojú ọ̀nà mọ́tò tó ńyọ́.

rows.source: This would be the region's first rainfall of their wet season.
rows.output: Èyí yóò jẹ́ ìkùukùu àkọ́kọ́ ti agbègbè yìí ní àkókò ìrì.
rows.reference: Èyí ni yóò jẹ́ ìrọ̀ òjò àkọ́kọ́ ti agbègbè náà ti ìgbà òjò wọn.

rows.source: Some scattered tropical rain showers will begin to approach Arizona late Sunday and early Monday, before the rain becomes more widespread late Monday and Tuesday.
rows.output: Diẹ ninu awọn ojo ojo tropiki ti o tan kaakiri yoo bẹrẹ si de Arizona ni ipari ọjọ Aiku ati ibẹrẹ ọjọ Aiku, ṣaaju ki ojo naa to di pupọ si ni ipari ọjọ Aiku ati ọjọbọ.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìrọ̀ òjò olóoru onísége-sège kan yóò bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí súnmọ́ Arizona lọ́wọ́ alẹ́ ọjọ́ Àìkú àti kùtùkùtù ọjọ Ajé, kí òjò náà tó di eyiti ó ńrọ̀ káàkiri lálẹ́ ọjọ́ Ajé àti ọjọ́ Ìṣẹ́gun.

rows.source: Heavy rain will spread into the Four Corners on Tuesday and last through Wednesday.
rows.output: Òjìji yóò tàn káàkiri Àwọ̀n Mẹ́rin ní ọjọ́ Tuesday àti pé yóò wà títí di ọjọ́ Wednesday.
rows.reference: Ọ̀pọ̀ òjò yóò tàn káàkiri dé Àwọn Orígun Mẹ́rin lọ́jọ́ Ìṣẹ́gun àti nígbẹ̀yìn ni gbogbo ọjọ 'Ru.

rows.source: October can see some intense temperature swings across the U.S. as the Arctic gets cooler, but the tropics remain quite warm.
rows.output: Oṣù kọ́kọ́ lè rí àwọn ìyípadà ìwọ̀n ìgbóná tó le gan-an káàkiri orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà nígbà tí Arctic ń dín kù, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ìtọ́jútọ́ ń dín kù.
rows.reference: Oṣù Ọ̀wàrà leè rí àwọn ìlọsókè-sódò kan nínú ìwọn ooru tàbi otútú jákè-jádò orilẹ-ede U.S. bí ìhà Arctic tí ńtutù síi, ṣùgbọ́n agbègbè olóoru sì m'óoru síbẹ̀.

rows.source: Sometimes this leads to dramatic changes in temperature over short distances.
rows.output: Nígbà míì, èyí máa ń yọrí sí àwọn ìyípadà tó ń fa ìyàlẹ́nu nínú ìwọ̀n ìgbóná ní àwọn ibi tó súnmọ́.
rows.reference: Nigba miran èyí ńyọrísí àwọn ìyípadà tó yanilẹ́nu nínú ìwọ̀n otútù tàbí ooru ní àwọn ọ̀nà ìrìn tó kúrú.

rows.source: There is a great example of dramatic temperature differences through the central U.S. on Sunday.
rows.output: Ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn àpẹẹrẹ tó dára jùlọ ti ìyípadà ìwọ̀n ìgbóná ní àárín Amẹ́ríkà ní ọjọ́ Sunday.
rows.reference: Àpẹẹrẹ ńlá tóyanilẹ́nu kan wà nípa ti àwọn ìyàtọ̀ ìwọ̀n otútù tàbí ooru ní gbogbo ààrin gùngùn orilẹ-ede U.S. lọ́jọ́ Àìkú.

rows.source: There is nearly a 20-degree temperature difference between Kansas City, Missouri, and Omaha, Nebraska, and between St. Louis and Des Moines, Iowa.
rows.output: Àwọn ìwọ̀n ìgbóná tó tó 20 ìwọ̀n ní ìyàtọ̀ láàrin Kansas City, Missouri, àti Omaha, Nebraska, àti láàrin St. Louis àti Des Moines, Iowa.
rows.reference: Ìyàtọ̀ tó fẹ́rẹ̀ tó ìwọ̀n ogún dìgírì ti otútù tàbí ooru lówà láàrin Ìlú Kansas, Missouri, àti Omaha, Nebraska, àti láarin St. Louis àti Des Moines, ní Iowa.

rows.source: Over the next few days, lingering summer warmth will try to build and expand again.
rows.output: Ní àwọn ọjọ́ díẹ̀ tó ń bọ̀, ìgbádùn ìgbà òtútù yóò gbìyànjú láti kọ́ àti láti faagùntì lẹ́ẹ̀kan síi.
rows.reference: Nínú àwọn ọjọ́ díẹ̀ tó ḿbọ̀ lọ́nà, ìmóoru ìgbà ooru tí yóò pẹ́ yóò gbiyanju láti kọ́lé tí yóò sì gbòòrò lẹ́ẹ̀kan síi.

rows.source: Much of the central and eastern U.S. is expected to see a warm start to October with widespread 80s from the Southern Plains to parts of the Northeast.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ apá àárín àti ìlà oòrùn U.S. ni a ń retí pé yóò ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ October tó gbóná pẹ̀lú àwọn 80s tó gbooro láti àwọn Ìpínlẹ̀ Gúúsù sí apá kan ìlà oòrùn ìlà oòrùn.
rows.reference: Ọ̀pọ̀ nínú agbègbè ààrin gungun àti ìlà-oòrùn orilẹ-ede U.S. ní wọ́n ńretí láti rí ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ooru títí dé oṣù Ọ̀wàrà pẹ̀lú àwọn ìwọ̀n ọgọ́rin káàkiri láti Àwọn Ọ̀dàn Gúúsù náà sí àwọn apá ti Ìlà-oòrùn Àríwá.

rows.source: New York City could reach 80 degrees on Tuesday, which would be approximately 10 degrees above average.
rows.output: Ìlú New York lè dé ìwọ̀n 80 ìwọ̀n ní ọjọ́bọ̀, èyí tó jẹ́ tó 10 ìwọ̀n lókùú.
rows.reference: Ìlú New York leè dé àwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ọgọ́rin dìgírì lọ́jọ́ Ìṣẹ́gun, èyítí yóò fi bíi ìwọ̀n dìgírì mẹ́wàá ju agbedeméjì lọ.

rows.source: Our long term climate forecast is indicating high chances for above-average temperatures for the eastern U.S. through the first half of October.
rows.output: Ìtọ́kasí ojú ọjọ́ wa fún àkókò pípẹ́ ń fi hàn pé ó ṣeé ṣe kí ìwọ̀n ìgbóná tó ga ju ìwọ̀n àtọ́ka lọ fún ìlà oòrùn U.S. ní àwọn apá àkọ́kọ́ ti October.
rows.reference: Àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ ojú-ọjọ́ ọlọ́jọ́pípẹ́ wa ńtọ́kasí àwọ̀n ìṣọwọ́ṣeéṣe tóga fún àwọ̀n ìwọ̀n otútù tàbí ooru eyiti ó ju agbedeméjì lọ fún ìlà-oòrùn orilẹ-ede U.S. nínú gbogbo ìlàjí àkọ́kọ́ ti oṣù Ọ̀wàrà.

rows.source: More than 20 million people watched Brett Kavanaugh hearing
rows.output: Diẹ̀ sì ju mílíọ̀nù 20 ènìyàn lọ́wọ́ nínú ìgbọ́wọ́ Brett Kavanaugh
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan tóju mílíọ̀nù ogún lọ ló wo ìgbẹ́jọ́ Kavanaugh

rows.source: More than 20 million people watched Thursday's gripping testimony by Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh and the woman who accused him of a sexual assault that allegedly occurred in the 1980s, Christine Blasey Ford, on six television networks.
rows.output: Diẹ̀ sì ni mílíọ̀nù 20 ènìyàn ló wo ìtọ́jútọ́ tí ilé ẹjọ́ gíga kan, Brett Kavanaugh, àti obìnrin kan tí ó fi ẹ̀sùn kan an pé ó fà á lọ́wọ́ ní ìbálòpọ̀ tí ó sọ pé ó ṣẹlẹ̀ ní ọdún mẹ́wàá 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, lórí àwọn nẹ́tíwọ́kì tẹlifíṣọ̀n mẹ́fà.
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan tóju mílíọ̀nù ogún ló wo ìjẹ́ẹ̀rí amóríyá ti ẹnití a fàkalẹ̀ fún Ilé Ẹjọ́ tógajùlọ Brett Kavanaugh àti ti obìnrin tí o fẹ̀suǹ kàn án pé ó bá òun lòpọ̀ lọ́nà àìtọ́ eyiti ó sọpé ó ṣẹlẹ̀ nínú àwọn ọdún tówà láàrin1980 si 1989, Christine Blasey Ford, lórí àwọn ìtàkùn ẹrọ amóhùnmáwòrán mẹ́fà.

rows.source: Meanwhile, the political standoff continued, with broadcasters interrupting regular programming for Friday's last-minute twist: an agreement engineered by Arizona Sen. Jeff Flake for the FBI to conduct a one-week investigation of the charges.
rows.output: Ní báyìí, ìdàrúdàpọ̀ òṣèlú náà ń bẹ, pẹ̀lú àwọn olùtànkálẹ̀ tó ń fọ́kìtá àwọn ètò tó ń lọ lọ́wọ́ fún ìyàtọ̀ ìkẹyìn ọjọ́ Jimọ: ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tí Sẹ́nétọ̀ Arizona Jeff Flake ṣe fún FBI láti ṣe ìwádìí ọ̀sẹ̀ kan lórí ẹ̀sùn náà.
rows.reference: Lọ́nà miran ẹ̀wẹ̀, ipò òṣèlú èmikògbà-ìwọkògbà náà tẹ̀síwájú, pẹ̀lú àwọn agbóhùnsáfẹ́fẹ́ tó ńdá àwọn èto tíwọn ńṣe ìdákúrekú fún àwọn ètò tóyẹ fún ìyípadà ìṣẹ́jú tógbẹ̀yìn ọjọ́ Ẹtì: àdéhùn kan tí Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà Jeff Flake ti Arizona ṣètò rẹ̀ fún àjọ FBI láti ṣe ìwáàdí ọlọ́sẹ̀ kan lórí àwọn ẹ̀sùn náà.

rows.source: Ford told the Senate Judiciary Committee that she's 100 percent certain that Kavanaugh groped her drunkenly and tried to take off her clothes at a high school party.
rows.output: Ford sọ fún Igbimọ́ Ìdájọ́ Sénétọ̀ pé ó ní ìdá 100 nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún pé Kavanaugh fọwọ́ kan rẹ̀ nígbèkùn, ó sì gbìyànjú láti yọ aṣọ rẹ̀ kúrò ní ìpàdé ilé ẹ̀kọ́ gíga.
rows.reference: Ford sọ fún Ìgbîmọ̀ Ètò Ìdájọ́ ti Àwọn Àṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà wípé ó dá òun lójù ní gbogbo ọ̀nà pé Kavanaugh fí ọwọ́ pa òun lára fún ìtẹ́lọ́rún ara rẹ lẹ́yìn tí ó mutíyò àtipé ó gbìyànjú láti bọ asọ kúrò lára òun ní òde àríya ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ gíga kan.

rows.source: Kavanaugh, in impassioned testimony, said he's 100 percent certain that it didn't happen.
rows.output: Kavanaugh, ní ìfọkànsìn, sọ pé òun ní ìdá ọgọ́rùn-ún nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún (100%) dájú pé kò sí.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh, nínú ẹ̀rí tí kò ká òun fúnrarẹ̀ lára, sọpé ó dá oùn lójú ní gbogbo ọ̀na pé kó ṣẹlẹ̀ rárá.

rows.source: It's likely that more than the 20.4 million people reported by Nielsen on Friday watched it.
rows.output: Ó ṣeé ṣe kí àwọn ènìyàn ju mílíọ̀nù 20.4 tí Nielsen royin ní ọjọ́ Friday lọ tí wọ́n ń wo rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ó ṣeé ṣé kí ó jẹ́pé àwọn eniyan tó ju mílíọ̀nù ogun àti ẹgbẹ̀rún lọ́nà irinwo ti Nielsen ròyìn rẹ̀ ló wò o.

rows.source: The company was counting average viewership on CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel and MSNBC.
rows.output: Ilé iṣẹ́ náà ń ṣe àkójopọ̀ àwọn olùwòpọ̀ lórí CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel àti MSNBC.
rows.reference: Ilé-iṣẹ́ náà ńṣe òǹka iye agbedeméjí àwọn olùwòran lórí CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News, Channel àti MSNBC.

rows.source: Figures weren't immediately available for other networks that showed it, including PBS, C-SPAN and the Fox Business Network.
rows.output: Àwọn ìsọfọ́fọ́ kò lọ́wọ́là fún àwọn nẹ́tíwọ́kì mìíràn tí wọ́n fi hàn, títí kan PBS, C-SPAN, àti Nẹ́tíwọ́kì Fox Business.
rows.reference: Àwọn iye olùwòran kòwá nílẹ̀ lójú ẹsẹ fún àwọn ìtàkùn miran tó fi i hàn, pẹ̀lú PBS, C-SPAN àti Ìtàkùn Oko-òwò Fox.

rows.source: And Nielsen usually has some trouble measuring people who watch in offices.
rows.output: Àti Nielsen sábà máa ń ní ìṣòro kan láti ṣe ìwọn àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ń wo nínú àwọn ọ́fíìsì.
rows.reference: Àtipé Nielsen sáábà máa ńní ìṣòro ìṣòdiwọ̀n iye àwọn eniyan ti o ńwòran ní àwọn ọ́fíìsì.

rows.source: To put that in perspective, that's an audience size similar to that for a playoff football game or the Academy Awards.
rows.output: Láti fi ìyẹn hàn, ìyẹn jẹ́ ìwòye ènìyàn tó jọra pẹ̀lú ti ìpàdé bọ́ọ̀lù ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tàbí Àmì ẹ̀yẹ Academy.
rows.reference: Láti fi ìyẹn sójú ìwòye, ìyẹn jẹ́ ìwọn olùwòran tó dàbí ti ìdíje eré bọ́ọ̀lù aláàfẹ̵sẹ̀gbá kan tàbí ti Ìgbàmì-ìdálólá Academy.

rows.source: Fox News Channel, whose opinion hosts have strongly backed Kavanaugh's appointment, led all networks with an average of 5.69 million viewers during the all-day hearing, Nielsen said.
rows.output: Ìtòlẹ́sẹẹsẹ Fox News, tí àwọn agbọ̀rọ̀sọ rẹ̀ ti ṣe atilẹyin ìdìbò Kavanaugh, ṣe itọsọna gbogbo àwọn nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì pẹ̀lú àwọn olùwò ọgọ́rùn-ún 5.69 ní àkókò gbogbo ọjọ́ ìgbọ́wọ́ náà, nígbá tí Nielsen sọ.
rows.reference: Ìkànnì Fox News, tí èrò àwọn olùgbàlejò rẹ̀ ti ṣàtìlẹ́yìn gidigidi fún fífún Kavanaugh níṣẹ́, ló síwáju gbogbo àwọn ìkànnì pẹ̀lú agbedeméjí àwọn olùwòran tííṣe mílíọ̀nù mẹ́fà dín lẹ́gbẹ̀rún mẹ́wàá nínú ìgbẹ́jọ́ tó gba gbogbo ọjọ kan náà, ni Nielsen sọ.

rows.source: ABC was second with 3.26 million viewers.
rows.output: ABC ni kejì pẹlu awọn oluwo 3.26 milionu.
rows.reference: ABC ló ṣe ipò kejì pẹ̀lú àwọn olùwòran mílíọ̀nù mẹ́ta àti ẹgbẹ̀rún lọ́nà ọ̀ọ́dúndínlógójì.

rows.source: CBS had 3.1 million, NBC had 2.94 million, MSNBC had 2.89 million and CNN had 2.52 million, Nielsen said.
rows.output: Ni CBS, 3.1 million, NBC ni 2.94 million, MSNBC ni 2.89 million ati CNN ni 2.52 million, ni ibamu si Nielsen.
rows.reference: CBS ní mílíọ̀nù 3.1, NBC ní mílíọ̀nù 2.94, MSNBC ní mílíọ̀nù 2.89 tí CNN sì ní mílíọ̀nù 2.52, ni Nielsen sọ.

rows.source: Interest remained high after the hearing.
rows.output: Ìfọkànsìn ṣì ga lẹ́yìn ìgbọ́wọ́ náà.
rows.reference: Ìfẹ̀ láti mọ ohun tó nlọ sì ga síbẹ̀ lẹ́yìn ìgbẹ́jọ́ náà.

rows.source: Flake was the central figure in Friday's drama.
rows.output: Flake ni o jẹ́ àkòrí pàtàkì nínú eré ìdárayá ọjọ́ Friday.
rows.reference: Flake jẹ ẹni àfojúsùn pàtàkì nínú ìṣẹ̀lẹ ọjọ́ Ẹtì.

rows.source: After the moderate Republican's office issued a statement that he would be voting in favor of Kavanaugh, he was caught be CNN and CBS cameras Friday morning being shouted at by protesters as he tried to ride an elevator to a Judiciary Committee hearing.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn tí ọ́fíìsì Olùdíje Olómìnípúpò (Republican) ti ṣe àdéhùn pé yóò dibo fún Kavanaugh, wọ́n rí i pé wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an fún CNN àti CBS ní ọjọ́ Friday nígbati wọ́n ń gbìyànjú láti gun elevator kan lọ sí ìgbọ́kùnlé Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ (Judiciary Committee).
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn tí ọ́fíìsì òṣèlú alábọ́dé ti Republican ṣe àtẹ̀jáde gbólóhùn kan wípé òun yóò dìbò fún Kavanaugh, àwọn kámẹ́rà CNN àti CBS gbá a mú ní òwúrọ̀ ọjọ́ Ẹtì bí àwọn tó ńfì ìbínú wọn hàn ti ńpariwo lé e lórí bí ó ti ńgbiyanju láti wọ inú ẹ̀rọ agbénigòke-àjà lọ́si ibi ìgbéjọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ètò Ìdájọ́ kan.

rows.source: He stood with eyes downcast for several minutes as he was berated, televised live on CNN.
rows.output: Ó dúró pẹ̀lú ojú rẹ̀ tí ó sọnù fún ọ̀pọ̀ ìṣẹ́jú, nígbà tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan an, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan
rows.reference: Ó dìde pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹyinjú tó doríkodò fún ọ̀pọ̀ ìṣẹ́jú bí  wọ́n tiṣe kàn an lábùkù, tí wọ́n sì gbé e jáde bóti ńṣẹlẹ̀ lori ẹ̀rọ amóhùnmáwòrán CNN.

rows.source: "I'm standing right here in front of you," one woman said.
rows.output: "Mo dúró níbè níwájú rẹ," obìnrin kan sọ.
rows.reference: ''Mo ńdúró níbí gan-an ní ìwájú yín,'' ni obìnrin kan sọ.

rows.source: "Do you think he's telling the truth to the country?
rows.output: "Ǹjẹ́ o rò pé ó ń sọ òtítọ́ fún orílẹ̀-èdè náà?
rows.reference: ''Ǹjẹ́ o rò wípé ó ńsọ òtítọ́ fún orilẹ-ede?

rows.source: He was told, "you have power when so many women are powerless.""
rows.output: Wọ́n sọ fún un pé, “ìwọ ni agbára nígbà tí ọ̀pọ̀ obìnrin kò ní agbára.”
rows.reference: Wọ́n sọ fún un, ''ìwọ ní agbára nigbati ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn obìnrin jẹ aláìlágbára.''''

rows.source: Flake said that his office had issued a statement and said, before the elevator closed, that he would have more to say at the committee hearing.
rows.output: Flake sọ pé ilé iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ti jáde ìtọ́sọ́nà kan, ó sì sọ pé, kí elevator náà tó pa, pé òun yóò ní ohun míì láti sọ nígbèkùn ìgbìmó náà.
rows.reference: Flake sọpé ọ́fíìsí òun ti ṣe àtẹ̀jáde gbólóhùn kan tí ó sì tún wí, kí ẹ̀rọ agbénigòkè-àjà tó palẹ̀kùndé, pé òun yóò ní ọ̀pọ̀ nǹkan láti sọ níbi ìgbẹ́jọ́ ìgbìmọ̀ náà.

rows.source: The cable and broadcast networks were all covering live hours later, when the Judiciary Committee was to vote to advance Kavanaugh's nomination to the full Senate for a vote.
rows.output: Àwọn nẹ́tíwọ́kì kábìlì àti ìtànkálẹ̀ ní gbogbo wọn ń ṣe ìtànkálẹ̀ ìpàdé náà ní wákàtí mẹ́ta lẹ́yìn náà, nígbà tí Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ yóò dibo láti tẹ̀síwájú sí ìdìbò Kavanaugh sí ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin fún ìdìbò.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìtàkùn olókùn àti ti agbóhùnsáfẹ́fẹ́ ní wọ́n ńgbé ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà bótiṣe ńwáyé lẹ́yìn àwọn wákàtí, nigbati Ìgbìmọ̀ Ètò Ìdájọ́ níláti dìbò láti jẹ́kí ìfanikalẹ̀ fún iṣẹ́ ti Kavanaugh tẹ̀síwájú sọ́dọ̀ gbogbo àwọn Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà.

rows.source: But Flake said he would only do so with the understanding that the FBI would look into the allegations against the nominee for the next week, which minority Democrats have been urging.
rows.output: Ṣugbọn Flake sọ pé yóò ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìmúrasílẹ̀ pé FBI yóò wo ẹ̀sùn tí wọ́n fi kan olùdíje náà fún ọ̀sẹ̀ kan, èyí tí àwọn Democrats kékeré ti ń bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n Flake sọpé òun yóò ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀ nìkan pẹ̀lú òye wípé àwọn FBI yóò ṣe ìwáàdì lórí àwọn ẹ̀sùn tí wọ́n fi kan ẹnití wọ́n fàkalẹ̀ fún iṣẹ́ náà fún ọ̀sẹ̀ tó ńbọ̀, eyiti àwọn aṣoju-ṣofin Democrats tó kéré níye ti ńsọpé àwọn ńfẹ́.

rows.source: Flake was convinced in part by conversations with his friend, Democratic Sen. Chris Coons.
rows.output: Flake gba pé apá kan ni nípa àwọn ìjíròrò rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀, Sẹnetọ́ Alágbára Chris Coons.
rows.reference: Flake ni wọ́n mú ní ìdánilójú ni apá kan nípaṣẹ́ àwọn ìjíròrò pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà Chris Coons ti ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Democrats.

rows.source: After a conversation with Coons and several senators afterwards, Flake made his decision.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn ìjíròrò kan pẹ̀lú Coons àti ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ sínátọ̀ lẹ́yìn náà, Flake pinnu.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn ìjíròrò kan pẹ̀lú Coons àti ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin àgbà tówáyé lẹ́yìn náà, Flakes ṣe ìpinnu rẹ̀.

rows.source: Flake's choice had power, because it was evident Republicans would not have the votes to approve Kavanaugh without the investigation.
rows.output: Ìyàlẹ́nu Flake ní agbára, nítorí pé ó hàn gbangba pé àwọn Olómìnira kò ní ìdánilójú láti fọwọ́ sí Kavanaugh láì ní ìwádìí.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀yàn Flakes ni agbára, nitoripe ó ti fojú hàn gbangba pé àwọn ti Repubicans kòní ní àwọn ìbò láti fọwọ́sí Kavanaugh láìsí ìwáàdí náà.

rows.source: President Trump has opened an FBI investigation into the allegations against Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Trump ti ṣí ìwádììlù FBI sí ẹ̀sùn tí wọ́n fi kan Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ Trump ti sí ìwáàdí FBI kan sílẹ̀ láti bojúwo àwọn ẹ̀sùn tí wọn fi kan Kavanaugh.

rows.source: British PM May accuses critics of 'playing politics' over Brexit
rows.output: Alága ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì May fi ẹ̀sùn kan àwọn alátakò rẹ̀ pé wọ́n ń ṣe “ìṣelu ìṣelu” nípa Brexit
rows.reference: Adarí Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìjọba ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì May ńfẹ̀sùn kan àwọn tó ńtọ́kasí àṣiṣe rẹ̀ wípé wọ́n 'ńṣe òṣèlú' pẹlúi ọ̀rọ̀ Brexit

rows.source: Prime Minister Theresa May accused critics of her plans to leave the European Union of "playing politics" with Britain's future and undermining the national interest in an interview with the Sunday Times newspaper.
rows.output: Alága ìjọba Theresa May fi ẹ̀sùn kan àwọn alátakò àwọn ètò rẹ̀ láti kúrò ní Yúróòpù pé wọ́n ń “ṣeré” pẹ̀lú ọjọ́ iwájú ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì àti pé wọ́n ń bàjẹ́ ìfọkànsìn orílẹ̀-èdè náà nínú ìfọrọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò pẹ̀lú ìwé ìròyìn Sunday Times.
rows.reference: Àdari Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìjọba Theresa May fẹ̀sùn kan àwọn tó ńsọ nípa ȧṣiṣe tówà nínú àwọn ètò àgbékalẹ rẹ̀ láti fi Àjọ Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Yuroopu sílẹ̀ wipe wọ́n ''ńṣe òṣèlú́'' pẹ̀lú ọjọ́ iwájú ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì tí wọn sì ńṣe àkóbá fún ìfẹ́-fún-ire ilẹ̀ náà nínú ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò kan pẹlu ìwé ìròyìn Sunday Times.

rows.source: Britain's Prime Minister Theresa May arrives for the Conservative Party Conference in Birmingham, Britain, September 29, 2018.
rows.output: Ìpínlẹ̀ Ọ̀ṣun
rows.reference: Adarí Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìjọba Briteeni Theresa May dé síbi ipade Àpèro Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlu Conservative ní Birmingham, lórilẹ-ede Briteeni, lọ́jọ́ kọkàndínlọ́gbọ́n, oṣù Owewe, lọ́dún 2018.

rows.source: In another interview next to the one with her on the newspaper's front page, her former foreign minister Boris Johnson pressed his attack of her so-called Chequers plan for Brexit, saying a proposal that Britain and the EU should collect each other's tariffs was "entirely preposterous."
rows.output: Ní ìdánilójú ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò mìíràn lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò rẹ̀ lórí ojú ìwé ìròyìn náà, ọ̀gá àgbègbè rẹ̀ Boris Johnson tẹ̀síwájú nínú ìkìlọ̀ rẹ̀ sí ètọ́ rẹ̀ tí a ń pè ní ètọ́ Chequers fún Brexit, ní sọ pé ìpèníjà kan pé kí ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì àti EU máa kó owó orí ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì àti EU jẹ́ “àríyànjiyàn.”
rows.reference: Nínú ìfọ̀ròwánilẹ́nuwò miran èyí tókàn sí ọ̀kan pẹ̀lú rẹ̀ lójú ewé iwájú ti iwe iroyin náà, aláàkóso rẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ rí fún ọ̀rọ̀ ilẹ̀ òkèèrè Boris Johnson tẹramọ́ ìtakoni tó ńṣe lórí ètò àgbékalẹ̀ rẹ̀ tó pè ní Aláràm̀barà fún Brexit, tó sì ńsọpé àbá kan tí ó wípé Briteeni àti àjọ EU níláti máa gba àwọn owó-orí ara wọn jẹ́ eyiti ''ó ńbéèrè àbùkú ní gbogbo ọ̀nà.''

rows.source: Wayde Sims shooting: Police arrest suspect Dyteon Simpson in LSU player's death

rows.reference: Ìbọn yínyín ti Wayde: Àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá mú Dyteon Simpson lórí ikú agbábọ́ọ̀lù alápẹ̀rẹ̀ LSU

rows.source: Police have arrested a suspect in the fatal shooting death of Wayde Sims, a 20-year-old basketball player at LSU.
rows.output: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti mú ẹni tí wọ́n fura sí nínú ikú ẹ̀jìrì Wayde Sims, ẹni ọdún 20 tí ó jẹ́ agbábọ́ọ̀lù ní LSU.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá ti mú afurasí kan nitori ìbọn yínyín tó jásí ikú Wayde Sims, ẹni ogún ọdún kan tójẹ́ agbábọ́ọ̀lù alápẹ̀rẹ̀ ní LSU.

rows.source: Dyteon Simpson, 20, has been arrested and booked into prison on a second-degree murder charge, the Baton Rouge Police Department said.
rows.output: Dyteon Simpson, 20, ti mu ati fi ẹsun ipaniyan keji, Ẹgbẹ́ ọlọ́pàá Baton Rouge sọ.
rows.reference: Dyteon Simpson, ọmọ ogún ọdún, ní wọ́n mú tí wọ́n sì fi sí ọgbà ẹ̀wọ̀n lórí ẹ̀sùn apànìyan onípele kejì, Ẹ̀ka Àwọn Ọlọ́ọ̀pá Baton Rouge ni o sọ.

rows.source: Officials released video of the confrontation between Sims and Simpson, and police said Sims lost his glasses during the fight.
rows.output: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ náà ṣí fídíò ìforígbárí láàrin Sims àti Simpson, àwọn ọlọ́pàá sì sọ pé Sims pàdánù gílásì rẹ̀ nígbà ìjà náà.
rows.reference: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ gbé àwòrán fídíò kan síta tó ṣàfihàn ìtàpórógan láàrin Sims àti Simpson, tí àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá sì sọpé Sims pàdánù àwọn awò ojú rẹ̀ nínú ìjá náà.

rows.source: Police recovered the glasses from the scene and said they found Simpson's DNA on them, CBS affiliate WAFB reports.
rows.output: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá náà gba àwọn gilaasi náà padà láti ibi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà, wọ́n sì sọ pé wọ́n rí DNA Simpson lórí wọn, ó sì jẹ́ pé CBS affiliate WAFB.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá rí àwọn awò ojú mú kúrò níbì ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà tí wọ́n sì sọpé wọ́n rí kókó àbùdá àjẹbí DNA ti Simpson lára wọn, ní WAFB tííṣe alájọṣe CBS sọ nínú ìròyìn.

rows.source: After questioning Simpson, police said he admitted to fatally shooting Wayde.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n bá Simpson, àwọn ọlọ́pàá sọ pé ó jẹ́wọ́ pé ó pa Wayde.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n bèèrè ọ̀rọ̀ lọ́wọ́ Simpson, àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá ní ó gbà wípé òun yin ìbọn tó jásí ikú Wayde.

rows.source: His bond has been set at $350,000, the Advocate reports.
rows.output: Ìbálòpọ̀ rẹ̀ jẹ́ $350,000, Ìwọ̀n Ìrònú sọ.
rows.reference: Owó oníìdúró rẹ̀ ní wọ́n ti fi sí ẹgbẹ̀rún-lọ́ná-irinwódínláàádọ́ta dọ́la, ìwé Advocate  ní ́o ìròyìn bẹẹ,

rows.source: The East Baton Rouge Parish Coroner's Office released a preliminary report Friday, saying the cause of death is a gunshot wound to the head into the neck.
rows.output: Ẹka Iṣoogun Ọran Ọran Ipinlẹ East Baton Rouge ti tu iroyin akọkọ kan jade ni ọjọ Jimọ, ti o sọ pe idi iku naa jẹ ibọn kan si ori si ọrun.
rows.reference: Ọ́fíisì Olùwáàdí Ikú ti Ẹ̀ka Ìla Oòrùn Baton gbé ìròyìn ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ kan jadé lọ́jọ́ Ẹtì, tó ńsọpé ohun tó ṣokùnfa ikù ní ọgbẹ́ ìbọn kan tí wọn yìn sí orí náà sínú ọrùn.

rows.source: The department is crediting the Louisiana State Police fugitive task force, the state police crime lab, Southern University police and area citizens in assisting in the investigation leading to the arrest.
rows.output: Ẹ̀ka náà ń fún Louisiana State Police fugitive task force, ilé-iṣẹ́ ọlọ́pàá Louisiana, ọlọ́pàá Southern University, àti àwọn aráàlú ní àgbègbè náà ní ẹ̀bùú fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ nínú ìwádìí náà tó yọrí sí ìdádúró.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀ka náà ńkan sáará sí ikọ̀ amúṣẹ́ṣe lóri àwọn ìsáǹsá ti Àwọn Ọlọ́ọ̀pá Ìpínlẹ̀ Louisiana, ilé iṣẹ́ aṣàyẹ̀wò ìwà ọ̀daràn ti àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá ìpínlẹ̀, àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá Yunifasiti Gúsúù àti àwọn olùgbé agbègbè náà fún ríràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ nínu ìwáàdí eyiti o jẹ́kí wọ́n mú afurasí náà.

rows.source: LSU athletic director Joe Alleva thanked area law enforcement for its "diligence and pursuit of justice."
rows.output: Oludari ere idaraya LSU Joe Alleva dupẹ lọwọ awọn alabojuto agbegbe fun “ifaramọ ati itara fun idajọ.”
rows.reference: Olùdarí eré ìdárayá LSU Joe Alleva dúpẹ́ lọ́wọ́ àwọn agbófinró agbègbè fún ''iṣẹ́ takun-takun àti ilépa ìdájọ́'' wọn.

rows.source: Sims was 20 years old.
rows.output: Sims jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún ogún.
rows.reference: Sims jẹ́ ọmọ ogún ọdún lọ́jọ́ orí.

rows.source: The 6-foot-6 forward grew up in Baton Rouge, where his father, Wayne, also played basketball for LSU.
rows.output: Agbàbọ́ọ̀lù 6-6 náà dàgbà ní Baton Rouge, níbi tí bàbá rẹ̀ Wayne, ti ṣeré bọ́ọ̀lù inu agbọn fún LSU.
rows.reference: Onípo-iwáju náà tóga níwọ̀n ẹsẹ̀ bàtà mẹ́fà àti íǹsì mẹ́fà dàgbà ní Baton Rouge, nibiti bàbá rẹ̀, Wayne, bákannáà ti gbá bọ́ọ̀lù alápẹ̀rẹ̀ fún LSU.

rows.source: He averaged 5.6 points and 2.6 rebounds a game last season.
rows.output: Ó ṣe àbájade 5.6 àwọ̀n àti 2.6 ìdáàbòbò ní eré kọ̀ọ̀kan ní àkókò tó kọjá.
rows.reference: Ó gba kókó 5.6 ati àwọn àtúntasókè 2.6 níti agbedeméji nínú eré ní sáà tó kọjá.

rows.source: On Friday morning, LSU basketball coach Will Wade said the team is "devastated" and "in shock" by Wayde's death.
rows.output: Ní ọjọ́ Friday, olùkó bọ́ọ̀lù LSU Will Wade sọ pé ẹgbẹ́ náà “bàjẹ́” àti “ní ìdààmú” nípa ikú Wayde.
rows.reference: Ní òwúrọ ọjọ́ Ẹtì, akọ́nimọ̀-ọ́n-gbá bọ́ọ̀lù alápẹ̀rẹ̀ ti LSU Will Wade sọpé ikọ̀ náà wà nínú ''ipò aláìlágbára'' àtipé ''háà ṣe wọ́n'' nípaṣẹ̵̀ ikú Wayde.

rows.source: "This is what you worry about at all times," Wade said.
rows.output: "Èyí ni ohun tí o máa ń ṣe àníyàn nípa ní gbogbo ìgbà," Wade sọ.
rows.reference: Wade sowipe ''Èyí ní ohun ti ó ma ńṣàníyàn rẹ̀ ní gbogbo igbà,'̣.

rows.source: Ash spewing from the Popocatepetl volcano has reached the southern neighborhoods of Mexico's capital.
rows.output: Àwọ̀n èèpo tí ń jáde láti inú òkè ńlá Pópocatépetl ti dé àwọn àgbègbè gúúsù ti olú ìlú Meksíko.
rows.reference: Eérú tí a ńpọ̀ jáde láti orí-ilẹ́ tí ó lanu Fòlìkánò Popocatepetl ti dé àwọn agbègbe gúúsù ti olú-ìlú orilẹ-ede Mẹ́ṣíkò.

rows.source: The National Center for Disaster Prevention warned Mexicans on Saturday to stay away from the volcano after activity picked up in the crater and it registered 183 emissions of gas and ash over 24 hours.
rows.output: Ìṣàkóso Àgbáyé fún Ìdènà Ìṣòro Ìṣòro ti kìlọ̀ fún àwọn ará Meksíko lọ́jọ́ Sátidéì láti yẹra fún òkè ńlá náà lẹ́yìn tí ìṣòro kan ti pọ̀ sí i nínú ihò náà, ó sì ti gba ìtúsílẹ̀ 183 ti gáàsì àti ìsìnkúù lójoojúmọ́ fún wákàtí mẹ́rinlelọ́gbọ̀n.
rows.reference: Ibùdò tó Ńrísí Dídènà Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ Àjálù Lorilẹ-ede ti kìlọ fún àwọn ọmọ orilẹ-ede Mẹ́ṣíkò lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta wípé kí wọn kùrò níbi fòlìkánò náà lẹ́yìn tí iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ gbéra sókè lẹ́nu ihò tí wọ́n sì ṣàkọsílẹ̀ àwọn ìtújáde afẹ́fẹ́ àti eérú nígbà mẹ́tàlélọ́gọ́sán láàrin wákàtí mẹ́riǹlélógún.

rows.source: The center was monitoring multiple rumblings and tremors.
rows.output: Ìàkàwé náà ń ṣàkóso ọ̀pọ̀ ìró àti ìdààmú.
rows.reference: Ibùdó náà ńṣàkíyèsí ọpọlọpọ àwọn ìrọ́kẹ̀kẹ̀ àti ìmìtìtì ilẹ̀.

rows.source: Images on social media showed thin layers of ash coating car windshields in neighborhoods of Mexico City such as Xochimilco.
rows.output: Àwọn àwòrán lórí àwọn ìkanni ìbára-ẹni-sọ̀rọ̀ ṣàfihàn àwọn ìpìlẹ̀ tí ó rọ̀ mọ́ àwọn fèrèsé ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ ní àwọn àgbègbè ìlú Meksíko bí Xochimilco.
rows.reference: Àwọn aworan lori àwọn ojú-òpó ìbáṣepọ̀ ti ayelujara ṣàfihàn àwọn ipele fẹ́rẹfẹ́ éerú lárá gíláàsì àwọn ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ ní àwọn agbègbè ti Ìlú Mẹ́ṣíkò bíi Xochimilco.

rows.source: Geophysicists have noticed an increase in activity at the volcano that sits 45 miles (72 kilometers) southeast of the capital since a 7.1-magnitude earthquake rocked central Mexico in September 2017.
rows.output: Àwọn onímọ̀ ẹ̀rọ́ ilẹ̀ ayé ti ṣàkíyèsí ìmúpọ̀ ìmúpọ̀ ní inú àpáta tí ó wà ní 72 kìlómítà (72 kìlómítà) sí gúúsù-ìlà-oòrùn ti olú ìlú náà láti ìgbà tí ìmúpọ̀ 7.1 ti ṣẹlẹ̀ ní àárín Meksíko ní September 2017.
rows.reference: Àwọn onímọ-orilẹ-ayé ti ṣàkíyèsí pípọ̀síi nínú iṣẹ́ níbí fòlìkánò náà eyiti ó jókòó ní máìlì máàrúndínláàádọ́ta (kilomita méjìléláàádọ́rin) ní ìlà-oórùn gúúsù ti olú-ìlú náà lẹ́yìn ti ilẹ̀ rírì oníwọ̀n-7.1 kan tó ṣe ọṣẹ́ ní ààrin-gùngùn Mẹ́ṣíkò nínú oṣù Owewe lọ́dún 2017.

rows.source: The volcano known as "Don Goyo" has been active since 1994.
rows.output: Ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n tí a mọ̀ sí “Don Goyo” ti ń ṣiṣẹ́ láti ọdún 1994.
rows.reference: Fòlìkánò náà tí wọ́n mọ̀ bíi ''Don Goyo'' ti ńṣiṣé di ìsinsìnyí láti ọdún 1994.

rows.source: Police clash with Catalan separatists ahead of independence vote anniversary
rows.output: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti kọlu àwọn olùfọkànsìn ìyàtọ̀ síra ní àkókò ìdìbò òmìnira.
rows.reference: Ìkọlù àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá pẹ̀lú àwọn ajàfómìnira Catalan sáájú àjọ̀dun ìbò òmìnira

rows.source: Six people were arrested in Barcelona on Saturday after pro-independence protesters clashed with riot police, and as thousands joined rival demonstrations to mark the first anniversary of Catalonia's polarizing vote on secession.
rows.output: Àwọn ènìyàn mẹ́fà ni wọ́n mú ní Barcelona ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta lẹ́yìn tí àwọn olùfọkànsìn òmìnira ti fọwọ́ kan àwọn ọlọ́pàá, nígbà tí ọgọ́rùn-ún mẹ́ta [3,000] ṣe ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ìdánilójú láti ṣe ayẹyẹ ọdún àkọ́kọ́ ti ìdìbò Catalonia lórí ìyàtọ̀ sí ìpìlẹ̀ orílẹ̀-èdè.
rows.reference: Eniyan mẹ́fà ni wọ́n mú sátìmọ́lé ní ìlú Barcelona lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta lẹ́yìn tí àwọn tó ńfẹ̀hónúhàn nitori àti-gbòmìnira kọlú àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá apaná-ọ̀tẹ̀, tí bíi àwọn ẹgbẹ̀rún eniyan sì darapọ̀ mọ awọn ìfẹ̀hónúhàn olórogún miran láti ṣààmi àjọ̀dún àkọ́kọ́ ti ìbò tópín ilẹ̀ Catalonia sì méjì lórí àti dá dúró bíi olómìnira.

rows.reference: Ẹgbẹ́ kan ti àwọn tófẹ́ omìnira tíwọn lo ìbòjú tí àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá apaná-ọ̀tẹ̀ dínà mọ́ ńju wọ́n lókò pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹyin ti wọn sì tún ńfẹ́ ọ̀dà aláàtíkè sí wọn, eyiti ó ṣẹ̀dá àwọn kùrukùru eruku dúdú ní àwọn òpópónà tí ó máa ńsáábà kún fọ́fọ́ fún àwọn arìnrìn-àjò ìgbafẹ́.

rows.source: Scuffles also broke out later in the day with police using their batons to contain the fighting.
rows.output: Àwọn ìforígbárí náà tún bẹ̀rẹ̀ lẹ́yìn náà ní ọjọ́ náà, àwọn ọlọ́pàá sì lo ìdààmú wọn láti ṣàkóso ìjà náà.

rows.source: Over several hours pro-independence groups chanting "No forgetting, no forgiveness" faced off with unionist protesters shouting, "Long live Spain."
rows.output: Láàrin àwọn wákàtí mẹ́ta, àwọn ẹgbẹ́ olùfọkànsìn òmìnira ń ké “Kò sí ìgbádùn, kò sí ìdáríjì” dojukọ àwọn aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ aláwọ̀ alá
rows.reference: Fún ọ̀pọ̀ wákàtí ni àwọn ẹgbẹ́ tófẹ́ òmìnira fi ńkọrin ''Kòsí gbígbàgbé, kòsí ìdáríjìn'' tíwọ́n sì kọjú ìjà sí àwọn tó ńfẹ̀hónúhàn fún ìsọkan tó ńpariwo, ''Ḱ Sipeeni kí ó pẹ́.''

rows.source: Fourteen people received treatment for minor injuries received in the protests, local press reported.
rows.output: Mẹ́rìnlá [14] ló gba itọju fún àwọn ìfarapa kékeré tí wọ́n gba nígbà ìdàrúdàpọ̀ náà, àwọn ìròyìn àgbègbè sọ.
rows.reference: Eniyan mẹ́rìnlá ló gba ìtọ́jú fún ìfarapa díẹ̀ tí wọ́n ní níbí àwọn ìfẹ̀hónúhàn náà, ni àwọn oníròyìn agbègbè sọ.

rows.source: Tensions remain high in the independence-minded region a year after the October 1 referendum deemed illegal by Madrid but celebrated by separatist Catalans.
rows.output: Ìdààmú ń bá a lọ ní agbègbè tí ó fẹ́ òmìnira ọdún kan lẹ́yìn ìdìbò October 1 tí Madrid kò fọwọ́ sí i ṣùgbọ́n tí àwọn ará Catalonia tí wọ́n fẹ́ yipada sọ pé ó jẹ́ ìdìbò.
rows.reference: Àwọn àìbalẹ̀-ọkàn tóga sì wà ní agbègbe tófẹ́ òmìnira lẹ́yìn ọdún kan tíwọn dìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ ní ọjọ́ Kìn-ín-ní oṣù Ọ̀wàrà eyiti Madrid sọpé ó lòdì sófin ṣùgbọ́n tí àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ Catalonia tófẹ òmìnira ńṣàjọyọ̀ rẹ̀

rows.source: Voters chose overwhelmingly to become independent, though turnout was low with those against secession largely boycotting the vote.
rows.output: Àwọn olùdìbò yan pẹ̀lú ìfọkànsìn láti di ọ̀tọ̀tọ̀, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ìdìbò náà kéré, àwọn tí wọ́n kọ̀ láti yọ kúrò nínú orílẹ̀-èdè náà sì kọ̀ láti dibo.
rows.reference: Àwọn olùdìbò yàn lọ́ná tí kòṣeé dojúkọ láti di olómìnira, botilẹjepe iye àwọn tó jáde dìbò kéré pẹ̀lú ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn tó ńtako dídádúró tíwọn dẹ́yẹ sí ìbò náà.

rows.source: According to Catalan authorities almost 1000 people were injured last year after police tried to stop the vote going ahead at polling stations across the region in violent clashes.
rows.output: Ní ọdún tó kọjá, àwọn aláṣẹ ilẹ̀ Kátálíà sọ pé ó lé ní ẹgbẹ̀rún ènìyàn 1000 ló farapa lẹ́yìn tí àwọn ọlọ́pàá gbìyánjú láti dènà ìdìbò náà láti wáyé ní àwọn ibi ìdìbò káàkiri agbègbè náà, pẹ̀lú ìforígbárí.
rows.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́bí àwọn aláṣẹ Catalonia ti wí ó fẹ́rẹ̀ tó ẹgbẹ̀rún eniyan tí ó farapa lọ́dún tó kọjá lẹ́yìn tí àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá gbìyànjú láti dá ìbò tó ńlọ dúró ní àwọn ibùdó ìdìbò káàkiri agbègbè náà nínú àwọn ìkọlù ipá.

rows.source: Pro-independence groups had camped out overnight on Friday to prevent a demonstration in support of the national police.
rows.output: Àwọn ẹgbẹ́ olùfọkànsìn-ọ̀rọ̀ òmìnira ti ṣe ìpàdé ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ Aarọ̀ láti dènà ìfihàn ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú ọlọ́pàá orílẹ̀-èdè náà.
rows.reference: Àwọn ẹgbẹ́ tófẹ́ òmìnira ti pàgọ́ síta ní gbogbo òru ọjọ́ Ẹtì láti ìwọ́de kan tíwọ́n fẹ́ fi ṣàtìlẹyìn fún àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá orilẹ-ede náà.

rows.source: The demonstration went ahead but was forced to take a different route.
rows.output: Ìfihàn náà lọ síwájú ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n ní láti gba ọ̀nà míràn.
rows.reference: Ìwọ́de náà tẹ̀síwájú ṣùgbọn wọ́n fi ipá mú un láti gba ọ̀nà kan tó yàtọ̀.

rows.source: Narcis Termes, 68, an electrician attending the separatist protest with his wife said he was no longer hopeful about the prospects of Catalonia gaining independence.
rows.output: Narcis Termes, 68, onimọ-ọpa ina kan ti o wa si ibudó awọn alatako pẹlu iyawo rẹ sọ pe ko ni ireti mọ nipa ireti Catalonia ti nini ominira.
rows.reference: Narcis Termes, ẹni ọdún méjìdínláàádọ́rin, òṣìṣẹ́ iná mànàmáná tó ńlọ síbí ìfẹ̀hónúhàn àwọn tófẹ òmìnira pẹ̀lú aya rẹ̀ sọpé òun kòní ìrètí mọ́ nípa ìṣọwọ́ṣeéṣe àṣeyọrí fún Catalonia láti gba òmìnira.

rows.source: "Last year we lived through one of our best moments.
rows.output: "Ọdun to kọjá, a ti gbé ní ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn àkókò tó dára jùlọ.
rows.reference: ''Lọ́dún tó kọjá a gbé nínù ọ̀kan nínú àwọn àkókò tó dára jùlọ.

rows.source: I watched my parents cry with joy at being able to vote but now we are stuck," he said.
rows.output: Mo wo awọn obi mi ti n sunkun pẹlu ayọ̀ fun anfaani lati dibo ṣugbọn bayii a ti di idẹkù.
rows.reference: Mo wo àwọn òbí mi bí wọ́n ti ńsọkún ayọ̀ nitori pe wọ́n leè dìbo sùgbọ́n nísinsìnyí a ti há sójú kan,'' ni o sọ.

rows.source: Despite managing a vital if narrow victory in regional elections last December, Catalan pro-independence parties have struggled to retain momentum this year with many of their best known leaders either in self imposed exile or in detention awaiting trial for their role in organizing the referendum and subsequent declaration of independence.
rows.output: Láàárín àwọn ìdìbò agbègbè tó wáyé ní December tó kọjá, àwọn ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú tó ń ṣe ìfipápadà ní Catalonia ti ń tiraka láti pa ìmúṣẹ́ mọ́lè ní ọdún yìí, nítorí pé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ nínú àwọn aṣáájú wọn tó mọ̀ jù lọ ni wọ́n ti fi ara wọn sílẹ̀ nígbèkùn tàbí tí wọ́n ń dúró de ẹjọ́ fún ipa wọn nínú ìdìbò náà àti ìkede òmìnira lẹ́yìn náà.
rows.reference: Pẹ̀lú wípé wọ́n rápálá láti jáwé olúborí tóṣe pàtakì nínú àwọn ìbò agbègbè nínú oṣù Ọpẹ́ tó kọjá, àwọn ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Catalonia tófẹ́ òmìnira ti làkàkà láti tún di agbára mú lọ́dún yìí p̀ẹlú wípé ọ̀pọ̀ nínú àwọn adarí wọn tí wọ́n gbajúmọ̀ jùlọ ti sálọ lọ sájò fúnrawọn tàbí kí wọ́n wà látìmọ́lé nibiti wọn tí ńdúró dé ìgbẹ́jọ́ fún ipa ti wọ́n kó nínú ṣíṣe ètò ìdìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ àti kíkéde òmìnira lẹ́yìn rẹ̀.

rows.source: Joan Puig, a 42-year-old mechanic recording the protest in support of the police on his phone, said the conflict had been stoked by politicians on both sides.
rows.output: Joan Puig, onimọ ẹrọ ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ ọmọ ọdun 42, ti n ṣe igbasilẹ ikede atilẹyin ọlọpa lori foonu rẹ, sọ pe rogbodiyan naa ti pọ si nipasẹ awọn oloselu ni ẹgbẹ mejeeji.
rows.reference: Joan Puig, òṣìṣẹ́ àtọkọ̀ṣe ẹni ọdún méjìlélógójì tó ńṣe ìgbàsílẹ̀ ìfẹ̀hónúhàn hàn fún àtìlẹ́yìn àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá lórí fóònu rẹ̀, sọpé aáwọ̀ nàà ní àwọn òṣèlu ti rú iná sí ní àwọn ìhà méjèèjì.

rows.source: "It's getting more and more tense," he said.
rows.output: "Ó ń di ìdààmú àti ìdààmú."
rows.reference: ''Ó kàn túnbọ̀ ńgbóná síwájú àti síwájú síi,'' ní ó sọ.

rows.source: On Saturday, Oriol Junqueras, one of nine Catalan leaders in pre-trial jail since late last year, announced he would run in European Parliament elections next year.
rows.output: Ni Satide, Oriol Junqueras, ọkan ninu awọn aṣofa mẹsan ti Catalonia ti wọn wa ni tubu lati ipari ọdun to kọja, kede pe oun yoo dije ninu idibo ile-igbimọ Yuroopu ni ọdun to nbọ.
rows.reference: Lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, Oriol Junqueras, ọ̀kan nínú àwọn adarí Catalonia tówà lẹ́wọ̀n kí ìgbẹ́jọ́ tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ láti òpin ọdún tó kọjá, kéde wípé òun yóò díje nínú àwọn ìdìbò sílé Ìgbímọ̀ Aṣojú-ṣòfin ti Àjọ Yuroopu lọ́dún tó ńbọ̀.

rows.source: "Standing as a candidate for the European elections is the best way to denounce the regression in democratic values and repression we have seen from the Spanish government," he said.
rows.output: "Ìdúró gẹ́gẹ́ bí olùdíje nínú ìdìbò Yúróòpù jẹ́ ọ̀nà tó dára jù láti tako ìsọdá ìwà ìjọsìn àti ìdènà tí a ti rí láti ọ̀dọ̀ ìjọba Sípéènì," ó sọ.
rows.reference: ''Dídúró bíi olùdíje kan fún àwọn ìdìbò ti Yuroopu ni ọ̀nà kan tó dára jùlọ láti kọ ìfàsẹ́yìn tó ńdébá àwọn ohun rere ti ìjọba àwarawa àti inira tí a tí láti ọwọ́ ìjọba Sipeeni.

rows.source: Londonderry: Men arrested after house rammed by car
rows.output: Londonderry: Àwọn ọkùnrin tí wọ́n mú lẹ́yìn tí ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ kan fọ́ ilé kan
rows.reference: Ìlú Lọndọnderi: Wọ́n mú àwọn ọkùnrin sátìmọ́lé lẹ́yìn ìfipáwa-ọkọ́ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ wọnú ilé

rows.source: Three men, aged 33, 34 and 39, have been arrested after a car was repeatedly rammed into a house in Londonderry.
rows.output: Àwọn ọkùnrin mẹ́ta, tí wọ́n jẹ́ ọdún mẹ́tàlélọ́gbọ̀n, mẹ́rinlelàádọ́rin, àti ọkandínlogójì, ni wọ́n ti mú lẹ́yìn tí ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ kan ti ń lu ilé kan ní Londonderry.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọkùnrin mẹ́ta, tí ọjọ́-orí wọn jẹ́ ọdún mẹ́tàlélọ́gbọ̀n, mẹ́rìnlélọ́gbọ̀n àti ọ̀kàndínlógójì ni wọn ti mú sátìmọ́lé lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n fi ipá wa ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ wọ inú ilé kan léra-léra ní ìlú Lọndọndẹri.

rows.source: The incident unfolded in Ballynagard Crescent on Thursday at about 19:30 BST.
rows.output: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà wáyé ní Ballynagard Crescent ní ọjọ́ Tọ́sì ní àgbègbè 19:30.
rows.reference: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà fojú hàn síta ní Ballynagard Crescent lọ́jọ́ 'Bọ̀ ní bíi aago méje àti ààbọ̀ alẹ́ Àkókò ti Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.

rows.source: Det Insp Bob Blemmings said damage was caused to the gates and the building itself.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Bob Blemmings, ọlọ́pàá, sọ pé ìbàjẹ́ ni wọ́n ṣe sí àwọn ẹ̀wọ̀n àti ilé náà fúnrararẹ̀.
rows.reference: Òṣiṣẹ́ Ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ́ Bob Blemmings sọpé ó fa ìdíbàjẹ́ fún ẹnu-ọ̀nà ilé àti ile gan-an fúnrarẹ̀.

rows.source: A crossbow may also have been fired at the car at some point.
rows.output: Ìbàjẹ́ àtàtà lè ti ta ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ náà ní àkókò kan.
rows.reference: Ó ṣeé ṣe kí wọ́n ti fi ọrún alásomọ́gi kan ta ọfà mọ́ ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ nàà nigba kan rí.

rows.source: Menga strike gives Livingston 1-0 win over Rangers
rows.output: Ìkùnsín Menga fún Livingston 1-0 ní ìdánilójú lórí Rangers
rows.reference: Gbígbá aláìtàsé ti Menga fún Livingston ní ìborí 1-0 lórí Rangers.

rows.source: Dolly Menga's first goal for Livingston secured victory
rows.output: Ìdánilójú Dolly Menga fún Livingston gba ìṣégun
rows.reference: Bọ́ọ̀lù àkọ́kọ́ tí Dolly Menga gbá wọlé fún Livingston ló mú ìṣẹ́gun dájú

rows.source: Promoted Livingston stunned Rangers to consign Steven Gerrard to just his second defeat in 18 games as manager of the Ibrox club.
rows.output: Ìtànkálẹ̀ Livingston ṣàkóbá fún Rangers láti fi Steven Gerrard sílẹ̀ nínú ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ rẹ̀ kejì nínú àwọn eré 18 rẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí alága ilé-iṣẹ́ Ibrox.
rows.reference: Livingston tó gba ìgbéga sọ Ranger di òmùgọ̀ láti fi Steven Gerrard sínù ìjákulẹ̀ ẹlẹ́ẹ̀keji rẹ nínú ìdíje méjìdínlógún gẹ́gẹ́bí alaakoso fún ẹgbẹ́ Ibrox náà.

rows.source: Dolly Menga's strike proved to be the difference as Gary Holt's side moved level with Hibernian in second.
rows.output: Ìdáàbò Dolly Menga jẹ́ ìyàtọ̀ sí i gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹgbẹ́ Gary Holt ṣe dé ìpele pẹ̀lú Hibernian ní kejì.
rows.reference: Gbígbá aláìtàsé ti Dolly Menga fihàn gbangba pé ohun ni ìyàtọ̀ náà bí ẹgbẹ́ ti Gary Holt sún ipele pẹ̀lú Hibernian ní ipò keji.

rows.source: Gerrard's side remain without an away win in the Premiership this season and face leaders Hearts, who they trail by eight points, next Sunday.
rows.output: Ìdílé Gerrard wà láyé láìmẹ̀wàá nínú àpèjọ yìí fún ìgbà yìí, wọ́n sì ń dojú kọ àwọn olùdíje náà, tí wọ́n ń tẹ̀lé e pẹ̀lú àwọn aṣíwájú, ní ọjọ́ Sunday tó ń bọ̀.
rows.reference: Ẹgbẹ́ ti Gerrard sì wà síbẹ̀ láìní ìbori kankan lẹ́yìn odi nínú Ìṣọ̀rí Líìgí Àkọ́kọ́ ní sáà yìí tí wọ́n sí ńkojú àwọn olóri tííṣe Hearts, ẹniti wọ́n ńtẹ̀lé pẹ̀lú àmì kókó mẹ́jọ, lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta tó ńbọ̀.

rows.source: Before then, Rangers host Rapid Vienna in the Europa League on Thursday.
rows.output: Ṣaaju eyi, Rangers gbalejo Vienna ni Ajumọṣe Yuroopu ni ọjọ́ Thursday.
rows.reference: Saájú rẹ̀, Rangers ti gbàlejò Rapid Vienna nínú Líìgì Yuropa lọjọ 'Bọ̀.

rows.source: Livingston, meanwhile, extend their unbeaten run in the division to six games, with head coach Holt still to taste defeat since replacing Kenny Miler last month.
rows.output: Ìwọ̀n ìdánilójú Livingston ní ìpìlẹ̀ náà dé àwọn eré mẹ́fà, pẹ̀lú olùkó Holt ṣì ní ìdánilójú nínú eré kan láti ìgbà tí ó rọ́pò Kenny Miler ní oṣù tó kọjá.
rows.reference: Livingston, ẹ̀wẹ̀, sì ńmú aré aílàní-ìjákulẹ̀ rẹ gbòòrò síi nínú ìpín náà lọsí ìdíje mẹ́fà, pẹ̀lú olórí akọ́nimọ̀-ọ́n-gbá Holt tí kò tíì tọ́ ìjákulẹ̀ wo lẹ́yìn tí ó ti pààrọ̀ Kenny Miller lóṣu tó kọjá.

rows.source: Livingston miss chances against blunt visitors
rows.output: Ìdánilójú ti pàdánù àwọn àǹfààní lòdì sí àwọn àlejò tó rọrùn
rows.reference: Livinston pàdánù àwọn àǹfààní tóyẹ kí ó lò lòdì sí àwọn olùbẹwò kògbérèégbè

rows.source: Holt's team should have been ahead long before they scored, with their directness causing Rangers all manner of problems.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ Holt yẹ ki o ti jẹ́wọ́ ní kíá kí wọ́n tó gba wọ́n, nítorí ìmúṣẹ wọn mú kí àwọn ìpèníjà pọ̀ sí i fún àwọn Rangers.
rows.reference: Ìkọ ti Holt yẹ kóti wà níwájú tipẹ́ kí wọ́n tó gbá bọ́ọ̀lù wọlé, pẹ̀lú ìgbájúmọ́ sí ìlépa wọn eyiti ó fa oŕiṣiriṣi àwọn ìyọnu fún Rangers.

rows.source: Scott Robinson broke through but dragged his effort across the face of goal, then Alan Lithgow could only direct his effort wide after sliding in to meet Craig Halkett's header across goal.
rows.output: Scott Robinson ti fọ́ ọ́fọ́ ṣùgbọ́n ó fi agbára rẹ̀ yọ́ ọ́fọ́ náà kọjá ojú góòlù, lẹ́yìn náà Alan Lithgow lè ṣe é ṣoṣo láti tọ́ka sí ọ̀nà ìwọ̀n rẹ̀ lẹ́yìn tí ó ti wọ inú ìbàdí rẹ̀ láti pàdé Craig Halkett.
rows.reference: Scott Robinson la àlùyọ ṣùgbọ́n ó fa igbiyanju rẹ nílẹ̀ nìgbàtí ó kọjú sílé latí gbá bọ́ọ̀lù wọlé, lẹ́yìn náà Alan Lithgow kàn leè kọjú ipá tirẹ̀ sí igbó lẹ́yìn tó ti yọ wọlé láti pàdé àforìgbá ti Craig Halkett lójú ilé.

rows.source: The hosts were content to let Rangers play in front of them, knowing they could trouble the visitors at set pieces.
rows.output: Àwọn olùgbọ́ náà fẹ́ láti jẹ́ kí Rangers ṣeré ní iwájú wọn, mọ̀ pé wọ́n lè ṣe ìpalára fún àwọn àlejò ní àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí wọ́n ṣètò.
rows.reference: Àwọn olùgbàlejò náà ti ní ìtẹ́lọ́rùn láti jẹ́kí Rangers gbá bọ́ọ̀lú níwájú wọn, pẹ̀lu pé wọ́n mọ́pè àwọn leè da àwọn náà ní ẹyọ-ẹyọ.

rows.source: And that was the manner in which the crucial goal came.
rows.output: Àtipa ni bí wọ́n ṣe dé ibi tí wọ́n ti ń ṣe pàtàkì.
rows.reference: Ìyẹn sì ni ọ̀nà náà tí àmì ayò tóṣe pàtàkì náà fi wá.

rows.source: Rangers conceded a free-kick and Livingston worked an opening, Declan Gallagher and Robinson combining to set up Menga, who took a touch and scored from the centre of the box.
rows.output: Àwọn Rangers gba ìfọwọ́ sí, wọ́n sì ṣiṣẹ́ àyè kan, Declan Gallagher àti Robinson sì darapọ̀ mọ́ Menga, ẹni tí ó gba ìfọwọ́ sí, ó sì gba wọ́n ní góòlù láti àárín pápá náà.
rows.reference: Rangers fáàyè gba ìjìya bọ́ọ̀lù gbígbá aláìsí-àtakò tí Livinston sì ṣiṣẹ́ láti sí ọ̀nà kan sílẹ̀, Declan Gallagher àti Robinson ńpá iṣẹ́ pọ̀ láti fún Menga ni àǹfààní, ẹniti ó gba ìfọwọ́kàn kàn tí ó sì gbá bọ́ọ̀lù wọlé ní ààrin àpótí ìjìya pẹnariti náà.

rows.source: By that stage, Rangers had dominated possession but had found the home defence impenetrable and goalkeeper Liam Kelly was largely untroubled,
rows.output: Ni ipele yẹn, Rangers ti ṣe akoso iṣẹgun ṣugbọn wọn ti ri aabo ile naa ko ṣee ṣe, oluṣọ Liam Kelly si jẹ alaimuṣin.
rows.reference: Ní ipele yẹn, Rangers ti borí nípa kí bọ́ọ̀lù pẹ́ lẹ́sẹ̀ ẹni sùgbọ́n wọ́n ti rí i pé ààbò àwọn onile kòṣeé wọ tí kòsí sí ìpayá rárá fún olùṣọ́lé Liam Kelly.

rows.source: That pattern continued into the second half, though Alfredo Morelos did force a save from Kelly.
rows.output: Ìṣọ̀kan yẹn tẹ̀síwájú sí ìdajì kejì, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé Alfredo Morelos fa ìfipá mú Kelly.
rows.reference: Bátàni yẹn tẹsiwaju wọ inú abala keji ìdíje náà botilẹjẹpe Alfred Morelos fi ipa mú Kelly láti dènà ìwọlé bọ́ọ̀lù kan.

rows.source: Scott Pittman was denied by the feet of Rangers goalkeeper Allan McGregor and Lithgow flicked wide from another Livingston set play.
rows.output: Scott Pittman ni a kọ́ nípa ẹsì àwọn olùṣọ́ Rangers Allan McGregor, ó sì tún kọ́ ọ́ lọ́wọ́ Lithgow láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn olùṣọ́ Livingston.
rows.reference: Scott Pittman ní a fi àǹfàànì dùn nípaṣẹ̀ ẹsẹ̀ olùṣọ́lé Rangers Allan McGregor tí Lithgow sì gbá bọ́ọ̀lù miran tí Livingston fún un dànù sígbó.

rows.source: Crosses continually came into the Livingston box and were continually cleared, while two penalty claims - after Halkett's challenge on substitute Glenn Middleton, and one for handball - were waved away.
rows.output: Àwọn àmì ìdánilójú ń bọ̀ sínú àpótí Livingston, wọ́n sì ń pa wọ́n mọ́, nígbà tí àwọn ìbéèrè ìdánilójú méjì - lẹ́yìn ìdánilójú Halkett lórí Glenn Middleton tí ó rọ́pò, àti ọ̀kan fún ọwọ́ - ni wọ́n kọ.
rows.reference: Bọ́ọ̀lù ńtẹ̀síwájú láti máa wá sínú àpòtí pẹnariti ti Livinston láti àwọn igun-ilé tí wọ́n sì ńgbá wọn dànu, nigbati àwọn ìbèèrè fún ẹ̀tọ́ ìjìyà pẹnariti méjì -lẹ́yìn i̇̀kọlù Halkett lórí àfirọ́pò Glenn Middleton, àti ọ̀kan fún bọ́ọ̀lù àfọwọ́mù - ni wọ́n bí dànù.

rows.source: 'Phenomenal' from Livingston - analysis
rows.output: Ìyàlẹ́nu láti ọ̀dọ̀ Livingston - àyẹ̀wò
rows.reference: 'Ìyanu Àrà-ọ̀tọ̀' láti Livingston - ìṣàtúpalẹ̀

rows.source: BBC Scotland's Alasdair Lamont at the Tony Macaroni Arena
rows.output: Ìwé ìròyìn BBC Scotland's Alasdair Lamont ní pápá Tony Macaroni
rows.reference: Alasdair Lamont ti BBC Scotland ní Gbàgede Tony Macaroni

rows.source: A phenomenal performance and result for Livingston.
rows.output: Ìṣe tí ó tayọ, àti ìpinnu tí ó tayọ fún Livingston.
rows.reference: Iṣẹ́ takun-takun àra-ọ̀tọ̀ tó yanilẹ́nu àti èsì fún Livingston.

rows.source: To a man, they were excellent, continuing to exceed expectations on this upward trajectory.
rows.output: Fún ọkùnrin kan, wọ́n dára púpọ̀, wọ́n sì ń tẹ̀síwájú láti kọjá àwọn ìrònú nípa ìrì dọ́là yìí.
rows.reference: Sí ẹnìkan, wọ́n j̇ẹ́ ohun tó tayọ, títẹ̀síwájú láti tayọ àwọn ìrètí lójú ipa ọ̀nà òké yìí.

rows.source: Their style of play and personnel has scarcely changed since their return to the top flight, but great credit has to go to Holt for the way he has galvanised the team since his arrival.
rows.output: Ìṣòro wọn àti àwọn ènìyàn wọn kò tíì yí padà gan-an láti ìgbà tí wọ́n padà sípò gíga, ṣùgbọ́n ẹ̀yà ńlá kan gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ fún Holt fún bí ó ṣe ń mú kí ẹgbẹ́ náà lọ́wọ́ láti ìgbà tí ó dé.
rows.reference: Ìrúfẹ ọ̀nà bọ́ọ̀lù gbígbá wọn àti àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ kò fí bẹ́ẹ̀ yípadà láti ìgbà ìpadàbọ̀ wọn sókè, sùgbọn òṣùbà ńlá nilati lọ́ sọ́dọ̀ Holt fun ọ̀nà tí ó gbà ṣékóríyá fún ikọ̀ náà láti ìgbà tí ò ti dé.

rows.source: He had so many heroes.
rows.output: Ó ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ akọni.
rows.reference: Ó ní ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn akọni.

rows.source: Captain Halkett was immense, marshalling a superbly-organised defence, while Menga kept Connor Goldson and Joe Worrall on their toes throughout.
rows.output: Alágbẹ̀dẹ́ Halẹ́kìtì jẹ́ ńlá, ó sì ń ṣàkóso ìdáàbòbò tí ó dára jù, nígbà tí Menga ń mú Connor Goldson àti Joe Worrall ṣe iṣẹ́ dáadáa ní gbogbo ìgbà.
rows.reference: Balògun Halkett pọ̀lọ́kan, tí ó ndarí ààbò eyiti ààtò rẹ̀ lágbára, nigbati Menga fi Connor Golson àti Joe Worall sípò àìnísinmi lórí ẹsẹ̀ títí tí ìdíje fi parí.

rows.source: Rangers were short of inspiration, though.
rows.output: Àwọn Rangers kò ní ìmọ̀lára, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé.
rows.reference: Rangers kòní ìmísí, bótiwùkórí.

rows.source: As good as they have been at times under Gerrard, they fell well short of those standards.
rows.output: Bí ó ti jẹ́ pé wọ́n ti ṣe dáadáa nígbá kan níbì kan lábẹ́ Gérard, wọ́n ṣì jẹ́ ìwọ̀n díẹ̀ sí àwọn ìwọ̀n yẹn.
rows.reference: Bí wọ́n ti dára tó ni àwọn àkókò tíwọ́n lábẹ́ Gerrard, wọ́n kùnà gidi láti dé irú àwọn òdiwọ̀n wọ̀nyẹn.

rows.source: Their final ball was lacking - only once did they cut the home side open - and it is something of a wake-up call for Rangers, who find themselves in mid-table.
rows.output: Ìbùkún ikọ̀kù wà ní ìdánilójú - wọ́n ṣe é lọ́kan ṣoṣo ni wọ́n sọ ọ́ di aláìmẹ́wà - ó sì jẹ́ ìkìlọ̀ fún àwọn Rangers, tí wọ́n rí ara wọn ní àárín àtẹ́lẹwọ́.
rows.reference: Bọ́ọ̀lù wọn tó gbẹ̀yìn ṣe aláìpéye - ẹ̀ẹ̀kan ṣoṣo ni wọ́n sí ilé awọn onílé sílẹ̀ - tí èyí sì jẹ nǹkan bíi ìpè ìtanijí kan fún Rangers, àwọn tí wọn ti rí ara wọn laàrin tábìlì ìṣòrí.

rows.source: Erdogan get mixed reception in Cologne
rows.output: Ìròyìn Erdogan ní Cologne gba ìdáhùn tí ó yàtọ̀
rows.reference: Erdogan gba ìgbanilálejò aládàlú ní Cologne

rows.source: There were smiles and blue skies on Saturday (September 29) as the leaders of Turkey and Germany met for breakast in Berlin.
rows.output: Ọjọ́ Aarọ̀ (ọjọ́ kẹrìndínlọ́gbọ̀n, oṣù kẹsàn-án) ni àwọn olórì ilẹ̀ Tọ́kì àti Jámánì pàdé fún oúnjẹ òwúrọ̀ ní Berlin.
rows.reference: Àwọn ẹ̀rín àti ojú-ọrun aláwọ aró lówà lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́tà (ìkọkàndínlọ́gbọ̀n oṣ̀ù Owewe) bí àwọn adari orilẹ-ede Tọ́kì àti orilẹ-ede Jamani ṣe pàdé fún oúnjẹ òwúrọ̀ ní ìlú Berlin.

rows.source: It's the last day of President Erdogan's controversial visit to Germany - which is aimed at repairing relations beteen the NATO allies.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ọjọ́ ìkẹhin tí ìbàjẹ́ Ààrẹ Erdogan wà ní Jámánì, èyí tí ó ní ìfojúsùn láti tún ìbádọ̀rẹ́ ṣe láàárín àwọn alájùmọ̀ṣepò NATO.
rows.reference: Ó jẹ́ ọjọ tó gbẹ̀yìn ti ìbẹ̀wò aláàríyànjiyàn Aàrẹ Erdogan sí orilẹ-ede Jamani - eyiti ó fi lépa ọ̀nà  láti tún ìbáṣepọ̀ tówà láàrin alájọṣe NATO ṣe.

rows.source: They've fallen out over issues including human rights, press freedom and Turkey's accession to the EU.
rows.output: Wọ́n ti yàgò fún ara wọn nípa ọ̀rọ̀ bíi ẹ̀tọ́ ọmọnìyàn, òmìnira ìròyìn, àti ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún EU.
rows.reference: Wọn tí ni èdè-àìyede lórí àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tó nííṣe pẹ̀lú ẹ̀tọ̀ ọmọniyàn, òmìnira àwọn oníròyìn àti ètò ìṣàfikún orilẹ-ede Tọki sínú àjọ EU.

rows.source: Erdogan then headed for Cologne to open a giant new mosque.
rows.output: Erdogan lọ sí Cologne láti ṣí àgọ́ ńlá kan.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn náà ni Erdogan dári lọ sí ìlú Cologne láti sí mọ́sálásí ńlá kan.

rows.source: The city is home to the largest Turkish population outside Turkey.
rows.output: Ìlú náà jẹ́ ilé fún àwọn ará Tọ́kì tó pọ̀ jùlọ níta Tọ́kì.
rows.reference: Ìlú náà jẹ́ ilé fún àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ Tọki tópọ̀ jùlọ lẹ́yìn odi Tọki.

rows.source: Police cited security reasons to block a 25,000-strong crowd from gathering in front of the mosque, but plenty of supporters turned out nearby to see their president.
rows.output: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá sọ pé àwọn ní ìdí ààbò láti dènà àwọn ènìyàn 25,000 láti péjọ níwájú mọ́ṣéjì, ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn olùfẹ́ rẹ̀ lọ síbè láti rí Ààrẹ wọn.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́ọ̀pá sọpé fún ìdí ààbò àwọn nilati dínà mọ́ èrò  ẹlẹ́gbẹ̀rún mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dọ́gbọ̀n eniyan kí wọ́n má baà leè péjò niwaju mọ́sálásí náà, ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn alátìlẹ́yìn jáde wa nítòsí láti rí ààrẹ wọn.

rows.source: Hundreds of anti-Erdogan protesters - many of them Kurdish - also made their voices heard, condemning both Erdogan's policies and the German government's decision to welcome him to the country.
rows.output: Àwọn olùfọkànsìn Erdogan - ọ̀pọ̀ nínú wọn jẹ́ Kùrdì - tún fi ohùn wọn hàn, tí wọ́n ń bẹnu àtẹ́ lu àwọn ìlànà Erdogan àti ìpinnu ìjọba Jámánì láti gbà á wọlé sí orílẹ̀-èdè náà.
rows.reference: Ọgọ-ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn afẹ̀hónúhàn tíwọ́n jẹ́ alátakò Erdogan - tí ọ̀pọ̀ ninu wọn jẹ ẹ̀yà Kurd - bákannáà fọ ohùn wọn fáyé gbọ́, tíwọn sì ńbu ẹnu atẹ́ lu àwọn ìlànà ìṣejọba Erdogan àti ìpinnu ìjọba ilẹ̀ Jamani láti kì i káàbọ sí orilẹ-ede náà.

rows.source: The dueling protests reflect the divisiveness of a visitor hailed as a hero by some German Turks and reviled as an autocrat by others.
rows.output: Àwọn ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ tí ń bọ́ lọ́wọ́ fi hàn pé ìyàtọ̀ tí ó wà láàárín àwọn ará Jámánì Tọ́kì tí wọ́n ń bọ̀wọ̀ fún ẹni tí wọ́n ń pè ní ọ̀gọ̀ọ̀gọ̀ àti àwọn tí wọ́n ń ṣàríwísí rẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí aláṣẹ-ọba.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìfẹ̀hónúhàn oníjà náà fi ìṣègbè olùbẹ̀wò kan hàn ẹniti àwọn ọmọ Tọki ilẹ̀ Jamani kan ńyìn bí akọni tí àwọn miran sì ńsọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ láburú bí afipáṣejọba kan.

rows.source: Deptford road crash: Cyclist dies in collision with car
rows.output: Ìjàmbá ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ ní Deptford: Arìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrìnrì
rows.reference: Ìjàm̀bá òpópónà Deptford: Agunkẹ̀kẹ́ kú nínú ìforísọrawọn pẹ̀lú ọkọ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́

rows.source: A cyclist has died in a collision involving a car in London.
rows.output: Ọ̀dọ́kùnrin kan tí ó ń gun kẹ̀kẹ́ ti kú nínú ìjàǹbá kan pẹ̀lú ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ ní London.
rows.reference: Agunkẹ̀kẹ́ kan ti kú nínú ìforísọrawọn kan tí ó nííṣe pẹ̀lú ọkọ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ kan ní ìlú Lọndọnu.

rows.source: The crash happened near the junction of Bestwood Street and Evelyn Street, a busy road in Deptford, in the south-east of the city, at about 10:15 BST.
rows.output: Ìjàǹbá náà ṣẹlẹ̀ nítòsí ìpàdé Bestwood Street àti Evelyn Street, ọ̀nà tí ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ ní Deptford, ní gúúsù-ìlà-oòrùn ìlú náà, ní nǹkan bí aago 10:15 Àárọ̀.
rows.reference: Ìjàm̀bá náà ṣẹlẹ̀ nítòsí oríta ti Òpópónà Bestwood àti Òpópònà Evelyn, ọ̀nà kàn tí kìí sinmi ní Deptfird, ní ìlà-oòrùn ìlú náà ní bíi aago mẹ́wàá kọjá ìṣẹ́gún mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dógún Àkókò Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.

rows.source: The driver of the car stopped and paramedics attended, but the man died at the scene.
rows.output: Awakọ ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ naa duro, awọn paramedics si wa si, ṣugbọn ọkunrin naa ku ni ibi iṣẹlẹ naa.
rows.reference: Awakọ̀ ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ náà dúró tí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera sì mójútó o, s̀ugbọ́n ọkùnrin náà kú níbi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà.

rows.source: The crash comes months after another cyclist died in a hit-and-run on Childers Street, about a mile away from Saturday's crash.
rows.output: Ìjàǹbá náà ń wáyé ní oṣù mẹ́ta lẹ́yìn tí ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ mìíràn ti kú nínú ìjàǹbá kan ní ọ̀nà Childers, tó jẹ́ ìwọ̀n kìlómítà kan síbi ìjàǹbá náà ní ọjọ́ Saturday.
rows.reference: Ìjàm̀bá náà wáyé lẹ́yìn oṣu diẹ̀ ti agunkẹ̀kẹ́ miran kú nínú ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ó-gbá-a-ó-sálọ kan ní Òpópónà Childers ní bíi máìlì kan síbi ìjàm̀bá ti ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta.

rows.source: The Metropolitan Police said officers were working to identify the man and inform his next-of-kin.
rows.output: Ìjọpọ̀ ọlọ́pàá náà sọ pé àwọn ọlọ́pàá ń ṣiṣẹ́ láti mọ ẹni tó jẹ́ ọkùnrín náà àti láti sọ fún ẹbí rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn Ọlọ́ọ̀pá Metropolitan sọpé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ńṣiṣẹ́ láti dá ọkùnrin náà mọ̀ kí wọ́n sì fi tó ìbátan rẹ̀ tó súnmọ́ ọ́n jùlọ létí.

rows.source: Road closures and bus diversions are in place and motorists have been advised to avoid the area.
rows.output: Ìdènà ọ̀nà àti ìyípadà ọkọ akérò wà níbè, àwọn awakọ̀ sì ti gba ìmúrasílẹ̀ láti yẹra fún agbègbè náà.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọ̀nà títìpa àti ìdarí bọ́ọ̀sì-akérò síbòmíràn  wá nípò tí wọ́n sì gba àwọn awakọ̀ lámọ̀ràn láti  yàgò fún agbègbè náà.

rows.source: Long Lartin prison: Six officers hurt in disorder
rows.output: Ìwọ̀n Lartín: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ mẹ́fà farapa nínú ìdàrúdàpọ̀
rows.reference: Ọgbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n Long Lartin: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ mẹ́fà farapa nínú ìdàrúdàpọ̀

rows.source: Six prison officers have been injured in a disturbance at a high security men's jail, the Prison Office has said.
rows.output: Àwọn ọ̀gọ̀ọ̀rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìndọ́rìnd
rows.reference: Àwọn òṣiṣẹ́ ogbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n mẹ́fà níwọn farapa níbi ìdàdarádàpọ̀ kan nínú ọgbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n aláààbò gíga ti àwọn ọkùnrin, Ọ́fíìsì Ọgbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n náà ti sọ.

rows.source: Disorder broke out at HMP Long Lartin in Worcestershire at about 09:30 BST on Sunday and is ongoing.
rows.output: Ìdàrúdàpọ̀ bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní HMP Long Lartin ní Worcestershire ní àgbègbè 09:30 BST ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, ó sì ń lọ lọ́wọ́.
rows.reference: Ìdàrúdàpọ̀ bẹ́ sílẹ̀ ní HMP Long Lartin ní Worcestershire ní bíi aago mẹ́ẹ̀sán àti ààbọ̀ Àkókò Gẹ̀ẹ́sì lọ́jọ́ Àìkú àtipé ó sì ńlọ lọ́wọ́.

rows.source: Specialist "Tornado" officers have been brought in to deal with the disturbance, which involves eight inmates and is contained to one wing.
rows.output: Àwọn ọ̀gọ̀ọ̀rìndọ́gbọ̀n “Tornado” ti wọ inú láti ṣàkóso ìdàrúdàpọ̀ náà, èyí tí ó kan àwọn ẹ̀wọ̀n mẹ́jọ àti pé ó wà ní ẹ̀ka kan ṣoṣo.
rows.reference: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ ''Tornado'' níwọ́n ti kó wọlé láti yanjú aáwọ̀ náà, eyiti o nííṣe pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹlẹ́wọ̀n mẹ́jọ tí ó sì dáwà ní apá kan ọgbà-ẹ̀wọ̀n náà.
