rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.source: On the matter of the AMs' title, the Commission favoured Welsh Parliament Members or WMPs, but the MWP option received the most support in a public consultation.
rows.output: A kan batun sunan AMs, hukumar ta fi son mambobin Majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi yawan goyon baya a wani bincike na jama'a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.source: AMs are apparently suggesting alternative options, but the struggle to reach consensus could be a headache for the Presiding Officer, Elin Jones, who is expected to submit draft legislation on the changes within weeks.
rows.output: Ana ganin AMs suna ba da wasu zaɓuɓɓuka, amma gwagwarmayar cimma yarjejeniya na iya zama matsala ga Shugaban Majalisar, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran zai gabatar da kundin tsarin doka kan canje-canje a cikin makonni masu zuwa.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.source: The legislation on the reforms will include other changes to the way the assembly works, including rules on disqualification of AMs and the design of the committee system.
rows.output: Dokar gyarawa za ta hada da wasu canje-canje ga yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da dokokin da suka shafi cirewar mambobi da kuma tsarin tsarin kwamitocin.
rows.reference: Dokar a kan canje-canjen za su haɗa da sauran canje-canje na yadda majalisar ke aiki, da ya haɗa da ƙa’idoji a kan ayyana rashin cancanta na AMs da kuma tsara tsari na kwamitin.

rows.source: AMs will get the final vote on the question of what they should be called when they debate the legislation.
rows.output: AMs za su sami karshe na kuri'a kan tambayar abin da za su kira lokacin da suke tattaunawa kan dokar.
rows.reference: AMs za su sami kaɗa kuri’ar karshe a kan batun abin da za a kira su da shi a yayin da suka yi mahawarar dokar.

rows.source: Macedonians go to polls in referendum on changing country's name
rows.output: Macedoniyawa za su je rumfunan zaɓe a zaben da za a yi kan canza suna ƙasar.
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia sun tafi yin zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin zaɓen raba gardama a kan canza sunan kasar

rows.source: Voters will vote Sunday on whether to change their country's name to the "Republic of North Macedonia."
rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a za su jefa kuri'a a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza suna kasar zuwa "Jamhuriyyar Makedoniya ta Arewa."
rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.source: The popular vote was set up in a bid to resolve a decades-long dispute with neighboring Greece, which has its own province called Macedonia.
rows.output: An kafa kuri'ar jama'a ne domin magance rikicin da ya dore da makwabta ta kasar Girka, wadda ke da wani yanki mai suna Makedoniya.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.source: Athens has long insisted that its northern neighbor's name represents a claim on its territory and has repeatedly objected to its membership bids for the EU and NATO.
rows.output: Athens ta yi iƙirarin cewa sunan makwabcinta na arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan ƙasar ta, kuma ta yi adawa da neman shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.source: Macedonian President Gjorge Ivanov, an opponent of the plebiscite on the name change, has said he will disregard the vote.
rows.output: Shugaban Macedon Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ya yi adawa da plebiscite kan canjin suna, ya ce zai yi watsi da wannan kuri'a.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.source: However, supporters of the referendum, including Prime Minister Zoran Zaev, argue that the name change is simply the price to pay to join the EU and NATO.
rows.output: Duk da haka, masu goyon bayan zabe, ciki har da Firaminisita Zoran Zaev, sun ce canjin suna kawai farashin da za a biya don shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.source: The Bells of St. Martin's Fall Silent as Churches in Harlem Struggle
rows.output: Ƙarar Ƙarar St. Martin sun yi shuru yayin da majami'u ke gwagwarmaya a Harlem
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.source: "Historically, the old people I've talked to say there was a bar and a church on every corner," Mr. Adams said.
rows.output: "A tarihi, tsohon mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane lungu," in ji Mista Adams.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.source: "Today, there's neither."
rows.output: "A yau, babu komai."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.source: He said the disappearance of bars was understandable.
rows.output: Ya ce bacewar mashaya ta zama abu mai ma'ana.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.source: "People socialize in a different way" nowadays, he said.
rows.output: "Yanzu mutane suna mu'amala ta hanyoyi daban-daban"
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.source: "Bars are no longer neighborhood living rooms where people go on a regular basis."
rows.output: "Shaguna ba su zama dakunan zama na unguwa ba inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.source: As for churches, he worries that the money from selling assets will not last as long as leaders expect it to, "and sooner or later they'll be right back where they started."
rows.output: Game da majami'u, yana damuwa cewa kudi daga siyar da kadarori ba zai dore na tsawon lokaci kamar yadda shuwagabanni suka yi tsammani ba, "kuma a karshe za su dawo inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.source: Churches, he added, could be replaced by apartment buildings with condominiums filled with the kind of people who will not help the neighborhood's remaining sanctuaries.
rows.output: Coci, ya kara, za a iya maye gurbin su da gine-gine na gidan zama da kuma gidajen da aka cika da irin mutanen da ba za su taimaka wa majami'u da suka rage a unguwar ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.source: "The overwhelming majority of people who buy condominiums in these buildings will be white," he said, "and therefore will hasten the day that these churches close altogether because it is unlikely that most of these people who move into these condominiums will become members of these churches."
rows.output: "Yawanci mutane da ke siyan gidajen haya a cikin waɗannan gine-gine za su kasance fari ne," ya ce, "sannu kuma za su hanzarta ranar da waɗannan majami'u za su rufe gaba ɗaya saboda ba a yi tsammanin yawancin mutanen da za su koma wajen da suke zaune a cikin waɗannan gidajen haya za su zama mambobin waɗannan majami'u ba."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.source: Both churches were built by white congregations before Harlem became a black metropolis - Metropolitan Community in 1870, St. Martin's a decade later.
rows.output: Dukkan majami'u biyu an gina su ne ta hannun al'ummomin fari kafin Harlem ta zama birni mai rinjaye bakar fata - Majami'ar Al'umma a shekara ta 1870, St. Martin a shekara goma bayan haka.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.source: The original white Methodist congregation moved out in the 1930s.
rows.output: An fara da cocin Methodist na farko ya bar wurin a cikin shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.source: A black congregation that had been worshiping nearby took title to the building.
rows.output: Al'umma baki da suke ibada a kusa da suka ɗauki ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.source: St. Martin's was taken over by a black congregation under the Rev. John Howard Johnson, who led a boycott of retailers on 125th Street, a main street for shopping in Harlem, who resisted hiring or promoting blacks.
rows.output: An yi wa St. Martin's kama da kuma jagorantar da wani gungun baƙar fata a karkashin Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yajin aiki da masu siyar da ke kan titin 125, wanda shi ne babban titi na siyayya a Harlem, wadanda suka ki daukan ma'aikata ko kuma su yi musu aiki.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.source: A fire in 1939 left the building badly damaged, but as Father Johnson's parishioners made plans to rebuild, they commissioned the carillon.
rows.output: Wani wuta a 1939 ya bar ginin da ya yi muni sosai, amma yayin da majami'ar Father Johnson ta yi shiri don sake gina shi, sun ba da umarnin carillon.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.source: The Rev. David Johnson, Father Johnson's son and successor at St. Martin's, proudly called the carillon "the poor people's bells."
rows.output: An yi wa Rev. David Johnson, ɗan Father Johnson da magaji a St. Martin's, ya yi alfahari da cewa "carillon" "agogo na talaka ne."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.source: The expert who played the carillon in July called it something else: "A cultural treasure" and "an irreplaceable historical instrument."
rows.output: Kwararre wanda ya yi wasan kaho a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu daban: "Kasadar al'adu" da "kayan tarihi mara maye gurbin."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.source: The expert, Tiffany Ng of the University of Michigan, also noted that it was the first carillon in the world to be played by a black musician, Dionisio A. Lind, who moved to the larger carillon at the Riverside Church 18 years ago.
rows.output: Kwararre, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta kuma lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da ta yi wa baƙar fata, Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babban motar a Cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.source: Mr. Merriweather said that St. Martin's did not replace him.
rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's bai maye gurbin shi ba.
rows.reference: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ɗin ba ta musanya shi ba.

rows.source: What has played out at St. Martin's over the last few months has been a complicated tale of architects and contractors, some brought in by the lay leaders of the church, others by the Episcopal diocese.
rows.output: Abin da ya faru a St. Martin a cikin watanni da suka gabata ya kasance wani labari mai rikitarwa na masu zanen gini da masu gini, wasu da masu kula da cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma ta cocin Episcopal.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.source: The vestry - the parish's governing body, made up of lay leaders - wrote the diocese in July with concerns that the diocese "would seek to pass along the costs" to the vestry, even though the vestry had not been involved in hiring the architects and contractors the diocese sent in.
rows.output: Maganar majami'ar - hukumar da ke kula da al'umma, wadda ta kunshi shugabanni masu zaman kansu - ta rubuta wa bishop din a watan Yuli da damuwarta cewa bishop din "zai yi ƙoƙarin watsar da farashi" ga hukumar, duk da cewa hukumar ba ta da hannu a daukan masu zanen da masu ginin da bishop din ya aika.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.source: Some parishioners complained of a lack of transparency on the diocese's part.
rows.output: Wasu masu ibada sun yi korafi kan rashin gaskiya game da shugabancin cocin.
rows.reference: Wasu mabiya sun yi ƙorafi game da rashin bayyana abin da aka yi ta ɓangaren yankin iyakar majami’ar.

rows.source: Shark injures 13-year-old on lobster dive in California
rows.output: Wani kifin shark ya raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a lokacin da yake nutsewa don kamawa lobster a California.
rows.reference: Babban kifin teku ya raunata mai iyon neman lobster ɗan shekaru 13 a California

rows.source: A shark attacked and injured a 13-year-old boy Saturday while he was diving for lobster in California on the opening day of lobster season, officials said.
rows.output: An harbe da raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a ranar Asabar yayin da yake nutsewa don lobster a California a ranar farko na kakar lobster, jami'ai sun ce.
rows.reference: Wani babban kifin teku ya kai hari da raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a ranar Asabar a lokacin da yake iyon neman losbter a cikin California a ranar buɗe lokacin lobster, kamar yadda jami’ai suka ce.

rows.source: The attack occurred just before 7 a.m. near Beacon's Beach in Encinitas.
rows.output: Harin ya faru ne da misalin karfe 7 na safe kusa da bakin teku na Beacon a Encinitas.
rows.reference: Harin ya faru ne kawai kafin ƙarfe 7 na safe kusa da Bakin Tekun Beacon a cikin Encinitas.

rows.source: Chad Hammel told KSWB-TV in San Diego he had been diving with friends for about half an hour Saturday morning when he heard the boy screaming for help and then paddled over with a group to help pull him out of the water.
rows.output: Chad Hammel ya gaya wa KSWB-TV a San Diego cewa ya yi iyo da abokai na kusan rabin sa'a a ranar Asabar da safe lokacin da ya ji yaron yana kukan neman taimako, sannan ya yi iyo tare da gungun mutane don taimaka masa ya fito daga cikin ruwa.
rows.reference: Chad Hammel ya fada wa gidan talabijin na KSWB-TV a San Diego yana iyo ne tare da abokansa na kusan rabin sa’a a ranar Asabar da safe a lokacin da ya ji yaron yana kururuwa shi ke nan sai ya nufi wurin tare da wani gungun mutane don su jawo shi waje daga ruwan.

rows.source: Hammel said at first he thought it was just excitement of catching a lobster, but then he "realized that he was yelling, 'I got bit!
rows.output: Hammel ya ce da farko ya yi tunanin kawai sha'awa ne na kama lobster, amma sai ya gane cewa "ya yi kira, 'Na ciji!
rows.reference: Hammel ya ce da farko ya ɗauka wata annishuwa ce ta kama wani losbter, amma shi ke nan sai ya “gano cewa ihu yake yi, ‘An cije ni!

rows.source: I got bit!'
rows.output: Na samu kiba!
rows.reference: An cije ni!’

rows.source: His whole clavicle was ripped open," Hammel said he noticed once he got to the boy.
rows.output: An bude dukkan ƙashinsa," in ji Hammel da ya ce da zarar ya isa yaron.
rows.reference: An buɗe kashin kafaɗarsa gaba ɗaya,” inji Hammel da ya gani a lokacin da isa wurin yaron.

rows.source: "I yelled at everyone to get out of the water: 'There's a shark in the water!'" Hammel added.
rows.output: "Na yi ihu ga kowa da ya fita daga ruwa: 'Akwai wani kifin shark a cikin ruwa!'" Hammel ya kara.
rows.reference: “Na yi ihu ga kowa don su fita daga ruwan. Hammel ya ƙara da cewa, ‘Akwai babban kifin teku a cikin ruwan!”

rows.source: The boy was airlifted to Rady Children's Hospital in San Diego where he is listed in critical condition.
rows.output: An tashi yaron zuwa Asibitin Yara na Rady a San Diego inda yake cikin mawuyacin hali.
rows.reference: An ɗauki yaron a cikin jirgin sama zuwa Asibitin Yara na Rady da ke cikin San Diego inda aka jera shi a yanayi mai tsanani.

rows.source: The species of shark responsible for the attack was unknown.
rows.output: Jinsin kifin da ya yi kisan ba a san shi ba.
rows.reference: Ba a san irie-iren jinsunan babban kifin tekun da ya yi wannan harin ba.

rows.source: Lifeguard Capt. Larry Giles said at a media briefing that a shark had been spotted in the area a few weeks earlier, but it was determined not to be a dangerous species of shark.
rows.output: Jagoran lifeguard Capt. Larry Giles ya ce a wani taron manema labarai cewa an ga wani kifin kifi a yankin makonnin da suka gabata, amma an gano ba wani nau'in kifin da ke da haɗari ba.
rows.reference: Kyaftin Larry Giles mai kula da rayuwa ya ce a gaban maneman labarai cewa an ga wani babban kifin teku a cikin yankin ‘yan makonni baya, amma an ƙudurta cewa ba daga wani jinsuna ne babban kifi mai haɗari ne ba.

rows.source: Giles added the victim sustained traumatic injuries to his upper torso area.
rows.output: Giles ya kara wa wanda aka azabtar da raunukan da suka yi tsanani a jikin sa na sama.
rows.reference: Giles ya kara da cewa wanda abin da ya shafa ya ji raunuka munana a kan yankin sama na gadon bayansa.

rows.source: Officials shut down beach access from Ponto Beach in Casablad to Swami's in Ecinitas for 48 hours for investigation and safety purposes.
rows.output: Jami'an sun rufe hanyar shiga bakin teku daga Ponto Beach a Casablanca zuwa Swami's a Encinitas na tsawon sa'o'i 48 don bincike da dalilai na tsaro.
rows.reference: Jami’ai sun rufe iso ga bakin tekun daga Bakin Tekun Ponto na cikin Casablad zuwa Swami's a cikin Ecinitas na sa’o’i 48 don dalilan bincike da kariya.

rows.source: Giles noted that there are more than 135 shark species in the area, but most are not considered dangerous.
rows.output: Giles ya lura cewa akwai fiye da nau'in kifin shark 135 a yankin, amma yawancin ba a dauke su a matsayin masu haɗari.
rows.reference: Giles ya lura cewa akwai fiye da jinsunan 135 na manyan kifin teku a cikin yankin, amma mafi yawa ba a ɗauka suna da haɗari.

rows.source: Sainsbury's plans push into UK beauty market
rows.output: Shirin Sainsbury na shiga kasuwar kayan kwalliyar Birtaniya
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana shirye-shiryen shiga kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya

rows.source: Sainsbury's is taking on Boots, Superdrug and Debenhams with department store-style beauty aisles staffed with specialist assistants.
rows.output: Sainsbury's na fafata da Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams da shagunan sashe masu salo na kayan kwalliyar fata da ma'aikatan masuwarewa.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana ɗaukan Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams tare da irin ɓangarorin shagon salon kwalliya da aka ɗauka masa ma’aikata da ƙwararrun masu ba da taimako.

rows.source: As part of a substantial push into the UK's £2.8bn beauty market, which is continuing to grow while fashion and homeware sales fall back, the larger beauty aisles will be tested out in 11 stores around the country and taken to more stores next year if it proves a success.
rows.output: A matsayin wani ɓangare na babban tashin hankali zuwa kasuwar kyawu ta Birtaniya ta £2.8bn, wadda ke ci gaba da girma yayin da sayar da kayan kwalliya da kayan gida ke komawa baya, manyan sassan kyawu za a gwada a cikin shaguna 11 a faɗin ƙasar, kuma a kawo su zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekarar gaba idan ya yi nasara.
rows.reference: A matsayin ɓangaren shiga cikin kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya ta Fam biliyan 2.8, wadda ke ci gaba da haɓaka duk da cewa cinikayyar ado da kayan gida ta sami koma baya, za a gwada manyan ɓangarorin kwalliya a shaguna 11 na kasar kuma a ɗauke su zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan abin ya ci wata nasara.

rows.source: The investment in beauty comes as supermarkets hunt for ways to use up shelf space once sued for TVs, microwaves and homeware.
rows.output: Zuba jari a cikin kyawu ya zo ne yayin da manyan shagunan kayan abinci ke neman hanyoyin amfani da sararin shiryayye da aka yi amfani da su a baya don TV, microwave, da kayan daki.
rows.reference: Zuba jari a harkar kwalliya yana zuwa ne kamar yadda manyan shagunan sayar da kaya ke fafutukar hanyoyi don yin amfani da gurbin da babu kome da a da na ajiye talabijoji ne, da na’urorin dafa abinci da kayan gida.

rows.source: Sainsbury's said it would be doubling the size of its beauty offering to up to 3,000 products, including brands such as Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman and Dr. PawPaw for the first time.
rows.output: Sainsbury's ya ce zai ninka girman kayan kwalliyarsa zuwa samfuran 3,000, ciki har da alamomin kamar Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dr. PawPaw a karon farko.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s ya ce zai ruɓanya girma na abubuwan da zai samar na kwalliya har kusan kayayyaki 3,000, da suka haɗa da nau’uka kamar su Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dokta PawPaw a lokaci na farko.

rows.source: Existing ranges from L'Oreal, Maybelline and Burt's Bees will also get more space with branded areas similar to those found in shops like Boots.
rows.output: Rage na yanzu daga L'Oréal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees za su sami ƙarin sarari tare da wuraren da aka yi wa lakabi irin na waɗanda aka samu a shagunan kamar Boots.
rows.reference: Ranji-ranji da ke nan daga L'Oreal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees su ma za su sami gurbi masu yankin nau’uka iri ɗaya da waɗanda ake samu a cikin shaguna kamar Boots.

rows.source: The supermarket is also relaunching its Boutique makeup range so that the majority of products are vegan-friendly - something increasingly demanded by younger shoppers.
rows.output: Kantin sayayya na kuma sake fara samar da layin kayan shafawa na Boutique don haka mafi yawan kayan suna da amfani da vegan - wani abu da ake buƙatar matasan masu siya.
rows.reference: Haka kuma babban shagon zai sake ƙaddamar da ranjinsa na kayan zamani saboda mafi yawancin kayayyakin su zama na abotar vegan - wani abin da ke samun ƙaruwar buƙata ga kananan masu yin ciniki.

rows.source: In addition, perfume retailer the Fragrance Shop will be testing out concessions in two Sainsbury's stores, the first of which opened in Croydon, south London, last week while a second opens in Selly Oak, Birmingham, later this year.
rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, mai siyar da turare, The Fragrance Shop, za ta gwada shagunan a cikin shagunan Sainsbury guda biyu, na farko da aka bude a Croydon, kudu London, a makonnin da suka gabata, yayin da na biyu za a bude a Selly Oak, Birmingham, a karshen wannan shekarar.
rows.reference: Kari a kan haka, mai sarin turare wato Shagon Turare zai gwada samar da rangwame a cikin shagunan Sainsbury's guda biyu, na farkonsu wanda ya buɗe a cikin Croydon, kudancin Landan, makon da ya wuce sa’an nan na biyun zai buɗe a cikin Selly Oak, Birmingham, daga baya cikin wannan shekarar.

rows.source: Online shopping and a shift towards buying small amounts of food daily at local convenience stores means supermarkets are having to do more to persuade people to visit.
rows.output: Sayen kan layi da kuma sauya hankali zuwa siyan ƙananan kayan abinci a kullum a shagunan da ke kusa yana nufin dole ne masu sayar da kayan abinci su yi ƙarin ƙoƙari don su shawo kan mutane su ziyartar su.
rows.reference: Sayan kaya ta yanar gizo da ‘yar matsawa zuwa sayan abinci kadan a kowace rana a shaguna masu samar da sauki na gida yana nufi ya zama dole manyan shagunan sayar da kayan su himmatu wajen jan hankalin mutane su ziyarta.

rows.source: Mike Coupe, the chief executive of Sainsbury's, has said the outlets will look increasingly like department stores as the supermarket chain tries to fight back against the discounters Aldi and Lidl with more services and non-food.
rows.output: Mike Coupe, shugaban kamfanin Sainsbury, ya ce shagunan za su yi kama da shagunan sasanta a hankali yayin da kamfanin na supermarket ke kokarin kare kansa daga masu rangwame Aldi da Lidl da ƙarin ayyuka da kayan da ba na abinci ba.
rows.reference: Mike Coupe, shugaban Sainsbury's, ya ce shagunan gefen za su ci gaba da zama kamar manyan shaguna masu ɓangarori kamar yadda jerin babban shagon ke ƙoƙarin gasa da masu rangwame Aldi da Lidl tare da karin ayyuka da wanda ba na abinci ba.

rows.source: Sainsbury's has been putting Argos outlets in hundreds of stores and has also introduced a number of Habitats since it bought both chains two years ago, which it says has bolstered grocery sales and made the acquisitions more profitable.
rows.output: Sainsbury's ta sanya wuraren Argos a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna kuma ta gabatar da wasu sabbin wurare na Habitat tun da ta sayi duka jerin kayan masu amfani da su shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda ta ce ya kara sayar da kayan abinci da kuma sa sayen su ya fi riba.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana sa wuraren sayarwa na gefe na Argos a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna haka kuma ya gabatar da wasu Habitats tun da ya saye gaba ɗaya jerinsu shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda yake cewa ya ƙara inganta cinikayyar kayan abinci inda kuma ya sa samun ya zama mai riba.

rows.source: The supermarket's previous attempt to revamp its beauty and pharmacy departments ended in failure.
rows.output: Kantin sayen kayan masu amfani da kayan masu amfani da na magani na baya-bayan nan na sake fasalin sashensa na kyau da na magani ya ƙare a cikin gazawar.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarin da babban shagon ya yi na da a farfaɗo da ɓangarorin kwalliyar da magunguna ya ƙare babu nasara.

rows.source: Sainsbury's tested a joint venture with Boots in the early 2000s, but the tie-up ended after a row over how to split the revenues from the chemist's stores in its supermarkets.
rows.output: Sainsbury ya gwada haɗin gwiwa tare da Boots a farkon shekarun 2000, amma an dakatar da haɗin gwiwar bayan wani rikici kan yadda za a raba kudin da ake samu daga shagunan magani a cikin shagunan su.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s ya gwada wani haɗin gwiwar kasuwanci tare da Boots a farkon shekaru na 2000, amma haɗuwar ta zo ƙarshe a bayan wani rikici na yadda za a raba kuɗaɗen da ke shigowa daga shagunan magani a cikin manyan shagunan nasa.

rows.source: The new strategy comes after Sainsbury's sold its 281-store pharmacy business to Celesio, the owner of the Lloyds Pharmacy chain, for £125m, three years ago.
rows.output: Sabuwar dabarar ta zo ne bayan Sainsbury ta sayar da kasuwancinta na asibiti 281 ga Celesio, mai Lloyds Pharmacy, akan fam miliyan 125, shekaru uku da suka wuce.
rows.reference: Sabuwar dabarar ta zo ne a bayan Sainsbury's ya sayar da kasuwancin nasa na shaguna 281 na magunguna ga  Celesio, mamallakin jerin shagunan Lloyds Pharmacy, a kuɗi Fam miliyan 125.

rows.source: It said Lloyds would play a role in the plan, by adding an extended range of luxury skincare brands including La Roche-Posay and Vichy in four stores.
rows.output: Ya ce Lloyds za ta taka rawa a cikin shirin, ta hanyar ƙara nau'in kayan kula da fata na alfarma da suka haɗa da La Roche-Posay da Vichy a cikin shaguna hudu.
rows.reference: Ya ce Llyods zai taka wata rawa a cikin shirin, ta yin ƙarin wani ranji da aka faɗaɗa na nau’ukan kayan kula da fatar jiki na morewa da suka haɗa da La Roche-Posay da Vichy a cikin shaguna huɗu.

rows.source: Paul Mills-Hicks, Sainsbury's commercial director, said: "We've transformed the look and feel of our beauty aisles to enhance the environment for our customers.
rows.output: Paul Mills-Hicks, Daraktan kasuwanci na Sainsbury, ya ce: "Mun canza kamannin da kuma yanayin shagunanmu na kyawu don inganta muhallinmu ga abokan cinikinmu.
rows.reference: Paul Mills-Hicks, daraktan ciniki na Sainsbury's ya ce: “Mun canza gani da yadda ake ji na ɓangarorin kwalliya don inganta yanayi ga abokan cinikinmu.

rows.source: We've also invested in specially trained colleagues who will be on hand to offer advice.
rows.output: Mun kuma saka hannun jari a kan abokan aiki da aka horar da su musamman, za su kasance a shafinsu don bayar da shawara.
rows.reference: Mun kuma zuba jari a abokan aikinmu da suka sami horarwa ta musamman waɗanda za su kasance a kusa wajen ba da shawara.

rows.source: Our range of brands is designed to suit every need and the alluring environment and convenient locations mean we're now a compelling beauty destination which challenges the old way of shopping."
rows.output: An tsara jerin samunmu don biyan duk wani buƙatu, da kuma yanayin da ke jan hankali da kuma wurin da ya dace yana nufin yanzu mu ne wurin da ya dace da kyawu wanda ke kalubalantar hanyar da ta gabata ta siya."
rows.reference: An tsara ranjinmu na nau’uka ne don dacewa da kowace buƙata kuma yanayin mai ƙayatarwa da wuraren da ke sauki wanda ke nufin wani wurin zuwa na kwalliya mai jan hankali da ke ƙalubalantar tsohuwar hanya ta sayan kaya.”

rows.source: Peter Jones 'furious' after Holly Willoughby pulls out of £11million deal
rows.output: Peter Jones ya yi fushi bayan Holly Willoughby ta janye daga yarjejeniyar fam miliyan 11
rows.reference: Peter Jones 'ya fusata' bayan Holly Willoughby ya fita daga kwangila ta Fam miliyan 11

rows.source: Dragons Den star Peter Jones left 'furious' after TV presenter Holly Willoughby pulls out of £11million deal with his lifestyle brand business to focus on her new contracts with Marks and Spencer and ITV
rows.output: An bar Peter Jones daga gidan talabijin na Dragons Den ya yi fushi bayan mai gabatar da shirin TV Holly Willoughby ya janye daga yarjejeniyar fam miliyan 11 da kamfanin kasidu na sa.
rows.reference: Tauraron Dragons Den Peter Jones ya tafi a 'fusace' bayan mai gabatarwa a talabijin Holly Willoughby ta fita daga kwangila ta Fam miliyan 11 da irin salon nau’in rayuwarta ta kasuwanci don koma kan sababbin kwangilolinta tare da Marks da Spencer da ITV

rows.source: Willoughby has no time for their homewear and accessories brand Truly.
rows.output: Willoughby ba shi da lokaci don kayan sawa da kayan sawa na su na gaskiya.
rows.reference: Willoughby ba ta da lokaci na kayansu na gida da nau’in abubuwan tallafi na Truly.

rows.source: The pair's business had been likened to Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop brand.
rows.output: An kwatanta kasuwanci na ma'auratan da al'adar Gwyneth Paltrow ta Goop.
rows.reference: An alaƙanta kasuwanin nasu ga nau’i na Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop.

rows.source: This Morning presenter, 37, took to Instagram to announce she is leaving.
rows.output: Mai gabatar da Safiya, mai shekara 37, ta sanar da barin ta a Instagram.
rows.reference: Mai gabatar da shirin Wannan Safiyar, mai shekaru 37, ta je Instagram inda ta sanar za ta tafi.

rows.source: Holly Willoughby has left Dragons" Den star Peter Jones fuming by pulling out of their lucrative lifestyle brand business at the last minute - to focus on her own new bumper contracts with Marks & Spencer and ITV.
rows.output: Holly Willoughby ta bar Peter Jones daga cikin Dragons" Den ta hanyar ficewa daga kasuwancin su na rayuwa mai tsada a makare - don mai da hankali kan sababbin kwantiraginta masu yawa tare da Marks & Spencer da ITV.
rows.reference: Holly Willoughby ta bar Dragons" tauraron Den Peter Jones cikin fushi ya ce ta fita daga nau’in salon kasuwancinsu mai samar da kuɗi a ƙarshen lokaci - don ta fuskanci sababbin kwangilolinta masu tsoka tare da Marks & Spencer da ITV

rows.source: Sources say Jones was "furious" when TV's golden girl admitted during a tense meeting on Tuesday at the headquarters of his business empire in Marlow, Buckinghamshire, that her new deals - worth up to £1.5 million - meant she no longer had enough time to devote to their homewear and accessories brand Truly.
rows.output: An ce Jones ya yi "fushi" lokacin da TV's golden girl ta amince a wani taron da ke da tashin hankali a ranar Talata a hedkwatar da'awarsa a Marlow, Buckinghamshire, cewa yarjejeniyar ta ta sabunta - har zuwa fam miliyan 1.5 - ta ninka ta da lokaci don ba da himma ga al'adun su na kayan gado da kayan aiki, Truly.
rows.reference: Kafofi sun ce Jones ya ‘fusata’ ne a yayin da sananniyar yarinya talabijin ɗin ta tabbatar a lokacin wata tattaunawa mai tsauri a ranar Talata a hedikwatar babban kasuwancin nasa a cikin Marlow, Buckinghamshire, cewa sababbin kwangilolin nata - da suka kai har Fam miliyan 1.5 - na nufin yanzu ba ta da lokaci isasshe da za ta bata ga kayansu na gida da nau’in abubuwan tallafi na Truly.

rows.source: The business had been likened to Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop brand and was tipped to double Willoughby's estimated £11 million fortune.
rows.output: An kwatanta kasuwanci da al'adar Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop da kuma hasashen zai ninka arzikin da aka kiyasta na Willoughby na fam miliyan 11.
rows.reference: An alaƙanta kasuwancin ga nau’in Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop kuma an ce zai jawo rubanyar abin da Willoughby's ke da shi da aka kimanta ya kai Fam miliyan 11.

rows.source: As Willoughby, 37, took to Instagram to announce she was leaving Truly, Jones jetted out of Britain to head for one of his holiday homes.
rows.output: A yayin da Willoughby, mai shekaru 37, ta yi amfani da Instagram don sanar da cewa tana barin Truly, Jones ya tashi daga Birtaniya don zuwa ɗaya daga cikin gidajen hutu.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda Willoughby, yar shekaru 37, ta shiga Instagram ta sanar cewa za ta bar Truly, Jones hawa jirgi ya yi ya wuce daya daga cikin gidajensa na yin hutu.

rows.source: A source said: "Truly was by far the top of Holly's priorities.
rows.output: Wani mai magana da yawun ya ce: "Gaskiya ita ce ta fi so a cikin abubuwanta.
rows.reference: Wata kafa ta ce: “Truly shi ne a sama na abubuwan da Holly ya fifita.

rows.source: It was going to be her long-term future that would see her through the next couple of decades.
rows.output: Zai zama na tsawon shekaru masu zuwa da za ta yi ta hanyar shekaru masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Zai zama zangonta mai tsawo da zai nan gaba daga yadda za ta yi a wasu shekaru masu zuwa nan gaba.

rows.source: Her decision to pull out left everyone involved absolutely stunned.
rows.output: Shawararta ta cirewa ta bar kowa da ke cikin hakan cikin mamaki.
rows.reference: Hukuncita da ta yanke na fitar ya sa duk waɗanda ke ciki a yanayin ban mamaki.

rows.source: Nobody could believe what was happening on Tuesday, it was so close to the launch.
rows.output: Babu wanda ya yi imani da abin da ke faruwa a ranar Talata, ya yi kusa da ranar da za a yi.
rows.reference: Ba wanda zai iya yarda da abin da ya faru a ranar Talata, ya yi kusa da ƙaddamarwar.

rows.source: There is a warehouse full of goods at the Marlow HQ which are ready to be sold."
rows.output: Akwai wani kantin da ke cike da kayayyaki a hedkwatar Marlow wanda ke shirya sayarwa.
rows.reference: Akwai wani babban wuri na ajiyar kaya cike da kayayyaki a hedikwatar Marlow waɗanda an shirya sayar da su.”

rows.source: Experts believe the departure of the This Morning presenter, who is among Britain's most bankable stars, could cost the firm millions due to hefty investment in products ranging from cushions and candles to clothing and homewear, and the potential for further delays to its launch.
rows.output: Kwararru sun yi imanin cewa ficewar mai gabatar da wannan Morning, wanda daya ne daga cikin taurarin da suka fi daraja a Birtaniya, na iya haifar da asara mai yawa ga kamfanin saboda babban jarin da aka yi a cikin kayayyakin da suka hada da kushin da kyandir zuwa kayan sawa da kayan sawa, da kuma yiwuwar jinkirin da za a yi a kan gabatar da kayan.
rows.reference: Ƙwararru sun yi imani tafiyar mai gabatar da shirin na Wannan Safiyar, wadda ke cikin taurarin Birtaniyya mafi warwaso, zai jawo hasarar miliyoyi ga kamfanin saboda matsanancin zuba jari a kayayyaki daga kushin-kushin zuwa kyandira zuwa tufafi da kayan gida, da kuma yiwuwar jinkiri na ƙaddamarwar tasa.

rows.source: And it could mean the end of a long friendship.
rows.output: Kuma hakan na iya nufin ƙarshen doguwar abota.
rows.reference: Kuma zai ba da ma’anar ƙarshe ta wata abokanta mai tsayi.

rows.source: Mother-of-three Willoughby and husband Dan Baldwin have been close to Jones and his wife Tara Capp for ten years.
rows.output: Uwa ta uku, Willoughby, da mijinta, Dan Baldwin, sun kasance masu kusanci da Jones da matarsa, Tara Capp, tsawon shekaru goma.
rows.reference: Mahaifiyar yara uku Willoughby da mijinta Dan Baldwin sun kasance kusa da Jones da matarsa Tara Capp na shekaru goma.

rows.source: Willoughby set up Truly with Capp in 2016 and Jones, 52, joined as chairman in March.
rows.output: An kafa Truly tare da Capp a shekarar 2016, kuma Jones, mai shekaru 52, ya zama shugaban hukumar a watan Maris.
rows.reference: Willoughby ya kafa Truly tare da Capp a cikin 2016 da Jones, mai shekaru 52, da ya shigo a matsayin shugaba a Maris.

rows.source: The couples holiday together and Jones has a 40 per cent stake in Baldwin's TV production firm.
rows.output: Ma'auratan suna hutun su tare kuma Jones yana da kashi 40 cikin 100 na kamfanin samar da talabijin na Baldwin.
rows.reference: Ma’auratan sukan yi hutu tare kuma Jones yana wani kaso 40 cikin dari a cikin kamfani talabijin mai samarwa na Baldwin.

rows.source: Willoughby is to become a brand ambassador for M&S and will replace Ant McPartlin as host of ITV's I'm A Celebrity.
rows.output: Willoughby zai zama jakada na alamar M& S kuma zai maye gurbin Ant McPartlin a matsayin mai masaukin baki na ITV's I'm A Celebrity.
rows.reference: Willoughby zai zama wani jakadan wani samfur ga M&S kuma zai maye gurbin Ant McPartlin a matsayin mai gabatar da shirin  ITV na Ni Wani Sananne Ne.

rows.source: A source close to Jones said last night "We wouldn't comment on his business affairs."
rows.output: Wani mai ba da shawara ga Jones ya ce a daren jiya "Ba za mu yi tsokaci kan harkokin kasuwanci ba."
rows.reference: Wata kafa kusa da Jones ta ce jiya da dare “Ba za mu yi sharhi a kan al’amuransa na kasuwanci ba.”

rows.source: Tough talk 'and then we fell in love'
rows.output: Tattaunawar da ba ta da daɗi 'sannan muka yi soyayya'
rows.reference: Babbar magana ‘kuma shi ke nan sai muka fara soyayya’

rows.source: He joked about criticism he would get from the news media for making a comment some would consider "unpresidential" and for being so positive about the North Korean leader.
rows.output: Ya yi dariya game da sukar da zai samu daga kafafen yada labarai na yin sharhi da wasu za su yi la'akari da "ba na shugaban kasa ba" kuma saboda kasancewa mai kyau sosai game da shugaban Koriya ta Arewa.
rows.reference: Ya yi barkwanci game da sukar da zai samu daga kafafen watsa labarai don yin wani sharhi da wasu za su ɗauka “abin da bai dace da shugaban ƙasa ba” da kuma kasancewa yana ganin abu mai kyau game da shugaban Koriya ta Arewa.

rows.source: Why has President Trump given up so much?
rows.output: Me yasa shugaban kasa Donald Trump ya yi watsi da wasu abubuwa da yawa?
rows.reference: Me ya sa Shugaba Trump ya ba da abubuwa masu yawa?

rows.source: Trump said in his mock "news anchor" voice.
rows.output: Trump ya ce a cikin murya mai ban dariya "mai gabatar da labarai".
rows.reference: Trump ya ce a cikin muryarsa ta muzanta “mai yin labaran”.

rows.source: "I didn't give up anything."
rows.output: "Ban ba da komai ba."
rows.reference: “Ban barin komai.”

rows.source: He noted that Kim is interested in a second meeting after their initial meeting in Singapore in June was hailed by Trump as a big step toward denuclearization of North Korea.
rows.output: Ya lura cewa Kim yana da sha'awar wani taron na biyu bayan taron farko da aka yi a Singapore a watan Yuni, wanda Trump ya bayyana a matsayin wani babban mataki na kawar da makaman nukiliya a Koriya ta Arewa.
rows.reference: Ya lura cewa Kim yana da sha’awa ne a tattaunawa ta biyu bayan tattaunawarsu ta farko a Singapore a watan Yuni wanda Trump ya jinjina a matsayin wani babban mataki da ke tunkarar rage makaman nukiliya a Koriya ta Arewa.

rows.source: But denuclearization negotiations have stalled.
rows.output: Amma tattaunawa kan kawar da makaman nukiliya ta tsaya.
rows.reference: Amma yarjejeniyoyin rage makaman nukiliyar sun ci tura.

rows.source: More than three months after the June summit in Singapore, North Korea's top diplomat Ri Yong Ho told world leaders at the U.N. General Assembly Saturday that the North doesn't see a "corresponding response" from the U.S. to North Korea's early disarmament moves.
rows.output: A cikin watan Yuni a Singapore, babban jakadan Koriya ta Arewa Ri Yong Ho ya sanar da shugabannin duniya a taron Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a ranar Asabar cewa Koriya ta Arewa ba ta ga "amsa mai kyau" daga Amurka ga matakin da Koriya ta Arewa ta dauka na rage makamanta.
rows.reference: Fiye da watanni uku bayan babban taro a cikin Singapore, babban jami’in diflomasiyyar Koriya ta Arewa Ri Yong Ho ya fada wa shugabannin duniya a Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a ranar Asabar cewa Arewar ba ta ga wani “martani irin yadda suka yi ba” daga Amurka zuwa ga yinƙurin rage makaman da Koriya ta Arewar ta fara ba.

rows.source: Instead, he noted, the U.S. is continuing sanctions aimed at keeping up pressure.
rows.output: A maimakon haka, ya lura, Amurka na ci gaba da takunkumi da aka yi niyya don ci gaba da matsawa.
rows.reference: A maimaiko, ya lura, Amurka ta ci gaba da sa takunkumi ne da niyyar ci gaba da matsi lamba.

rows.source: Trump took a much more optimistic view in his rally speech.
rows.output: Trump ya yi la'akari da wani ra'ayi mai kyau a jawabin gangamin sa.
rows.reference: Trump ya ɗauki wani ra’ayi da yake jin zai yiwu a cikin jawabinsa na gangami.

rows.source: "We're doing great with North Korea," he said.
rows.output: Muna yin kyau da Koriya ta Arewa, ya ce.
rows.reference: “Kome yana tafiya mana daidai tare da Koriya ta Arewa,” inji shi.

rows.source: "We were going to war with North Korea.
rows.output: Mun yi shiri mu yi yaƙi da Koriya ta Arewa.
rows.reference: “Da za mu fara yaki tare da Koriya ta Arewa.

rows.source: Millions of people would have been killed.
rows.output: Miliyoyin mutane za su mutu.
rows.reference: Da an kashe miliyoyin mutane.

rows.source: Now we have this great relationship."
rows.output: Yanzu muna da wannan kyakkyawar alaƙa."
rows.reference: Yanzu kuwa muna da wannan babbar danganta.”

rows.source: He said his efforts to improve relations with Kim have brought positive results - ending rocket tests, helping free hostages and getting the remains of American servicemen returned home.
rows.output: Ya ce kokarin da yake yi na inganta alaƙa da Kim ya kawo sakamakon da ya dace - dakatar da gwajin roka, taimakawa a sakin fursunoni, da kuma dawo da gawar sojojin Amurka.
rows.reference: Ya ce ƙoƙare-ƙoƙarensa don inganta hulɗoɗi tare da Kim sun samar da sakamako mai kyau - kawowa ƙarshe gwaje-gwajen roka, taimakawa a sake mutanen da aka yi garkuwa da su da kuma samun dawowa da sauran gawawwakin sojojin Amurka gida.

rows.source: And he defended his unusual approach in talking about relations with Kim.
rows.output: Kuma ya kare hanyar da ya ke bi a kan tattaunawa game da dangantakarsa da Kim.
rows.reference: Kuma ya kare hanyarsa wata iri a cikin magana mage da hulɗoɗi tare da Kim.

rows.source: "It's so easy to be presidential, but instead of having 10,000 people outside trying to get into this packed arena, we'd have about 200 people standing right there," Trump said, pointing at the crowd directly in front of him.
rows.output: "Yana da sauƙi a zama shugaban ƙasa, amma maimakon samun mutane 10,000 a waje suna ƙoƙarin shiga wannan filin wasa mai cike da jama'a, za mu sami kusan mutane 200 suna tsaye a can," Trump ya ce, yana nuna ga taron da ke gaban shi.
rows.reference: “Yana da sauki halayyar shugaban ƙasa, amma maimakon a sami mutane 10,000 a waje suna ƙoƙarin shigowa cikin wannan wuri mai dandazo, za mu sami kusan mutane 200 a nan wurin,” inji Trump, yana mai nuna jama’ar da ke gabansa da yatsa kai tsaye.

rows.source: Indonesia Tsunami and Quake Devastate an Island, Killing Hundreds
rows.output: Indoneshiya Tsunami da Girgizar Kasa Sun lalata Wani Tsibiran, Sun kashe Dubban Mutane
rows.reference: Tsunamin Indonesiya da Girgizar Ƙasa sun yi ɓarna a Tsibiri, Ɗaruruwa Sun Mutu

rows.source: In the aftermath of the Lombok earthquake, for instance, foreign nongovernmental organizations were told they were not needed.
rows.output: Bayan girgizar Lombok, misali, an gaya wa ƙungiyoyin baƴaɗe na waje ba su da buƙata.
rows.reference: A bayan girgizar ƙasa ta Lombok, ga misali, an ce wa ƙungiyoyin ƙasashen waje da ba na gwamnati ba cewa ba a buƙatarsu.

rows.source: Even though more than 10 percent of Lombok's population had been dislocated, no national disaster was declared, a prerequisite for catalyzing international aid.
rows.output: Koda yake sama da kashi 10 cikin 100 na yawan jama'ar Lombok sun rasa matsugunansu, ba a bayyana bala'in kasa ba, wanda ya zama dole don kara karfafa taimakon kasa da kasa.
rows.reference: Duk da cewa kusan fiye da kashi 10 na yawan jama’ar Lombok sun rasa matsugunansu, ba a furta hadari na kasa ba, wani sharadi da zai janyo samun taimakon kasa-da-kasa.

rows.source: "In many cases, unfortunately, they've been very clear that they're not requesting international assistance, so it's a bit challenging," Ms. Sumbung said.
rows.output: "A cikin yawancin lokutan, abin takaici, sun bayyana sosai cewa ba sa neman taimakon kasa da kasa, don haka yana da wahala kadan," Ms. Sumbung ta ce.
rows.reference: “A misalai da yawa, abin takaici, sun nuna a fili cewa ba sa neman taimako na ƙasa-da-ƙasa, don haka wani abu ne mai ƙan ƙalubale,” inji Misis Sumbung.

rows.source: While Save the Children is putting together a team to travel to Palu, it is not yet sure whether foreign staff can work on the ground.
rows.output: Yayin da Save the Children ke tattara tawaga don tafiya zuwa Palu, har yanzu ba a tabbatar da ko ma'aikatan kasashen waje za su iya aiki a kasa ba.
rows.reference: A lokacin da Save the Children ke haɗa wata ƙungiya da za ta tafi Palu, ba ta da tabbacin ko ma’aikatan ƙasashe waje za su iya aiki a ƙasa.

rows.source: Mr. Sutopo, the national disaster agency spokesman, said Indonesian officials were assessing the situation in Palu to see whether international agencies would be allowed to contribute to the aid effort.
rows.output: Mista Sutopo, mai magana da yawun hukumar bala'in kasar, ya ce jami'an Indonesia suna tantance halin da ake ciki a Palu don ganin ko za a ba hukumomin kasa da kasa damar taimakawa wajen bayar da agajin.
rows.reference: Mista Sutopo, mai magana da yawun hukumar haɗura ta ƙasa, ya ce jami’an Indonesiya suna auna yanayin na cikin Palu don ganin ko za a bari wakilan ƙasa-da-ƙasa su ba da gudunmawa ga ƙoƙarin tallafi.

rows.source: Given the earth shaking that Indonesia constantly endures, the country remains woefully underprepared for nature's wrath.
rows.output: A cikin wannan yanayin na girgizar ƙasa da Indonesia ke fuskanta a kullum, ƙasar na cikin haɗari mai tsanani na rashin shiri don fushin yanayi.
rows.reference: Ganin jijjigar ƙasa da Indonesiya ta saba gani, ƙasar ta zama ta yi mummunan rashin shiryawa don bala’in rayuwa.

rows.source: While tsunami shelters have been built in Aceh, they are not a common sight on other coastlines.
rows.output: A yayin da aka gina sansanonin tsunami a Aceh, ba a ganin su a kan sauran gabar teku.
rows.reference: Duk da cewa an gina matsugunan Tsunami a cikin Aceh, ba su zama abin da ake iya gani a yankunan da ke kusa da bakin ruwa ba.

rows.source: The apparent lack of a tsunami warning siren in Palu, even though a warning had been in effect, is likely to have contributed to the loss of life.
rows.output: Rashin ganiyar siren na tsunami a Palu, duk da cewa an yi gargadi, mai yiwuwa ya ba da gudummawa ga asarar rayuka.
rows.reference: Rashin jiniyar gargarɗin tsunami da ya fito a fili a cikin Palu, duk da cewa wani gargaɗi yana aiki, zai iya yiwuwa shi ne ya ba da gudunmawa ga rasa rayuwa.

rows.source: At the best of times, traveling between Indonesia's many islands is challenging.
rows.output: A mafi kyawun lokuta, tafiya tsakanin tsibiran Indonesia da yawa tana da wahala.
rows.reference: A lokuta mafiya kyau, bulaguro tsakanin tsibiran Indonesiya masu yawa yana da ƙalubale.

rows.source: Natural disasters make logistics even more complicated.
rows.output: Bala'o'in da suka faru na halitta sun sa aikin sufuri ya fi wahala.
rows.reference: Haɗuran da Allah ya aiko sukan sa rabe-raben kayan buƙata ya zama da wahala sosai.

rows.source: A hospital ship that had been stationed in Lombok to treat earthquake victims is making its way to Palu, but it will take at least three days to reach the site of the new calamity.
rows.output: Jirgin asibiti da aka sanya a Lombok domin kula da wadanda suka jikkata a cikin girgizar kasa, yana kan hanyarsa zuwa Palu, amma zai ɗauki akalla kwanaki uku kafin ya isa wurin da sabon bala'in ya faru.
rows.reference: Wani asibitin jirgin ruwa da aka ajiye a cikin Lombok yana kan hanyarsa ta zuwa Palu don kula da waɗanda girgizar ƙasar ta shafa, amma zai ɗauki aƙalla kwanaki uku kafin isa wurin sabon bala’in.

rows.source: President Joko Widodo made improving Indonesia's tattered infrastructure a centerpiece of his election campaign, and he has lavished money on roads and railways.
rows.output: Shugaban Joko Widodo ya mai da hankali kan inganta abin da ya faru a Indonesia, wanda ya kasance wani muhimmin ɓangare na yakin neman zabensa, kuma ya kashe kuɗi mai yawa a kan hanyoyin mota da layukan dogo.
rows.reference: Shugaba Ƙasa Joko Widodo ya maida inganta gine-ginen Indonesiya da suka lalace abin da ya sa a gaba na kamfe ɗin zaɓensa, kuma ya zuba kuɗi mai yawa a kan hanyoyi da hanyoyin jirgin ƙasa.

rows.source: But funding shortfalls have plagued Mr. Joko's administration as he faces re-election next year.
rows.output: Amma rashin kuɗi ya yi wa gwamnatin Mista Joko.
rows.reference: Amma rashin isassun kuɗaɗe ya addabi gwamnatin Mista Joko a lokacin da yake fuskantar sake zaɓe a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.source: Mr. Joko is also facing pressure from lingering sectarian tensions in Indonesia, where members of the Muslim majority have embraced a more conservative form of the faith.
rows.output: Mista Joko kuma yana fuskantar matsi daga rashin jituwa da ke ci gaba a Indonesia, inda mambobin rinjaye na Musulunci suka rungumi wani nau'in addinin da ya fi tsauri.
rows.reference: Haka kuma Mista Joko yana fuskantar matsi daga tashin-tashina bambanci addini da ya-ƙi-ci-ya-ƙi-cinyewa, inda mamobin Musulmai da suka fi rinjaye suka karɓi nau’in addini tsatstsaura.

rows.source: More than 1,000 people were killed and tens of thousands dislocated from their homes as Christian and Muslim gangs battled on the streets, using machetes, bows and arrows, and other crude weapons.
rows.output: Fiye da mutane 1,000 ne suka mutu, kuma dubban mutane sun rasa matsugunansu yayin da gungun Kiristoci da Musulmin suka yi artabu a kan titi, suna amfani da wukake, kibau, da kuma wasu makamai na gargajiya.
rows.reference: An kashe fiye da mutane 1,000 kuma dubun-dubata sun rasa matsugunai daga gidajensu kamar yadda ‘yan daba Kirista da Musulmai ke ta yaƙi a kan tituna, suna masu yin amfani da adduna, kwari da baka, da sauran muggan makamai.

rows.source: Watch: Liverpool's Daniel Sturridge dips deep equalizer vs. Chelsea
rows.output: Kalli: Kwallon Liverpool ta Daniel Sturridge ta yi daidai da Chelsea
rows.reference: Kalli: Daniel Sturridge na Liverpool ya jawo kunnen doki da  Chelsea

rows.source: Daniel Sturridge saved Liverpool from a Premier League loss to Chelsea with a score in the 89th minute on Saturday at Stamford Bridge in London.
rows.output: Daniel Sturridge ya ceci Liverpool daga rashin nasara a gasar Premier da Chelsea da ci a minti na 89 a ranar Asabar a filin wasa na Stamford Bridge da ke Landan.
rows.reference: Daniel Sturridge ya kare Liverpool daga wani wasa kofin ƙalubale na Premier League inda ya yi hasara ga Chelsea tare da ci a cikin mintina na 89 a ranar Asabar a Stamford Bridge a cikin Landan.

rows.source: Sturridge received a pass from Xherdan Shaqiri while about 30 yards out from the Chelsea goal with his team trailing 1-0.
rows.output: Sturridge ya karbi wando daga Xherdan Shaqiri yayin da yake kusan mita 30 daga kwallon Chelsea tare da kungiyarsa tana bin 1-0.
rows.reference: Sturridge ya karɓi wani turo ƙwallo daga Xherdan Shaqiri kusan yadina 30 a waje daga cin Chelsea tare da ‘yan ƙungiyarsa da suke biye ci 1 da 0.

rows.source: He tapped the ball to his left before scooping a shot toward the far post.
rows.output: Ya buga ƙwallon zuwa hagu kafin ya yi tsalle ya harbi mai nisa.
rows.reference: Ya taɓa ƙwallon zuwa hagun ɗinsa kafin ya yi wani bugu zuwa matsaya mai nisa.

rows.source: The attempt sailed high above the box as it drifted toward the right top corner of the net.
rows.output: Ƙoƙarin ya yi sama da akwatin yayin da yake tafiya zuwa hagu sama da kusurwar hagun.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarin ya ɗagu sama da akwatin inda ya gangara zuwa saman kusurwar dama na ragar.

rows.source: The ball eventually dropped over a leaping Kepa Arrizabalaga and fell into the net.
rows.output: Kwallon ta faɗi a kan tsalle-tsalle Kepa Arrizabalaga sannan ta faɗi cikin ragon.
rows.reference: Daga ƙarshe ƙwallon ta faɗo a saman Kepa Arrizabalaga mai tsalle inda kuma ta faɗa cikin ragar.

rows.source: "It was just trying to get into that position, to get on the ball and players like Shaq always play it forward as much as possible, so I just tried to create myself as much time as possible," Sturridge told LiverpoolFC.com.
rows.output: "Kawai na yi ƙoƙarin shiga wannan matsayi, don samun ƙwallon kuma 'yan wasa kamar Shaq koyaushe suna buga gaba da yawa gwargwadon yiwuwa, don haka kawai na yi ƙoƙarin samar da lokaci mai yawa a gare ni."
rows.reference: Sturridge ya faɗa a LiverpoolFC.com cewa “Kawai wani ƙoƙari ne na shiga wannan wurin, na samun ƙwallon kuma ‘yan wasa kamar Shaq koyaushe wasa suke yi a gaba yadda zai yiwu, don haka na yi kawai ƙoƙari ne na ƙirƙira wa kaina wani lokaci yadda zai yiwu.”

rows.source: "I saw Kante coming and took one touch and didn't think about it too much and just took the shot on."
rows.output: "Na ga Kante yana zuwa sai na ɗauki wani abu na yi tunanin ba sosai na kuma kawai na dau mataki."
rows.reference: “Na ga Kante yana zuwa kuma ya taɓa sau ɗaya kuma ban yi tunani game da shi sosai ba don haka sai na yi bugun kawai.”

rows.source: Chelsea led 1-0 at halftime after getting a score in the 25th minute from Belgian star Eden Hazard.
rows.output: Chelsea ta jagoranci 1-0 a rabin lokaci bayan da Eden Hazard, dan wasan Belgium ya ci a minti na 25.
rows.reference: Chelsea ita ce a gaba da ci 1 da 0 a farkon rabin lokaci bayan ta sami wani ci a cikin minti na 25 daga tauraron Belgium Eden Hazard.

rows.source: The Blues striker heeled a pass back to Mateo Kovacic on that play, before spinning off near midfield and sprinting into the Liverpool half.
rows.output: Dan wasan Blues ya yi wando ya dawo da kwallon ga Mateo Kovacic a wannan wasan, kafin ya juya daga tsakiyar filin wasa ya yi gudu cikin rabin Liverpool.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasa mai kai hari na Blues ya sake miƙa ƙwallo zuwa ga Mateo Kovacic a wasan, kafin ya ruga zuwa tsakiyar filin da kuma dira a cikin rabin Liverpool ɗin.

rows.source: Kovacic did a quick give-and-go at midfield.
rows.output: Kovacic ya yi sauyawa da sauri a tsakiyar filin wasa.
rows.reference: Nan da nan kuna Kovacic ya yi wata miƙawa ya ruga a tsakiyar filin.

rows.source: He then fired a beautiful through ball, leading Hazard into the box.
rows.output: Sannan ya harbe kwallo mai kyau, yana jagorantar Hazard cikin akwatin.
rows.reference: Sa’an nan sai ya yi wani kyakkyawan buga ƙwallon, inda ya tura Hazard cikin akwatin.

rows.source: Hazard outran the defense and finished into the far post netting with a left footed shot past Liverpool's Alisson Becker.
rows.output: Hazard ya zarce tsaron kuma ya ci gaba da harbin da ya yi da kafarsa ta hagu a cikin ragon Liverpool Alisson Becker.
rows.reference: Hazard ya wuce masu tsaron gida kuma ya gama zuwa matsayar raga mai nisa da sauri da wata ƙafar hagun inda ya wuce Alisson Becker na Liverpool.

rows.source: Liverpool battles Napoli in the group stage of the Champions League at 3 p.m. on Wednesday at Stadio San Paolo in Naples, Italy.
rows.output: Liverpool ta yi faɗan Napoli a matakin rukunin gasar zakarun Turai a ranar Laraba da misalin ƙarfe 3 na yamma a filin wasa na San Paolo a Naples, Italiya.
rows.reference: Liverpool ta yi yaki da Napoli a cikin matakin gungu na Zakarun Kalubalen da karfe 3 na yamma a ranar Laraba a Stadio San Paolo da ke cikin Naples, Italiya.

rows.source: Chelsea faces Videoton in the UEFA Europa Leaguge at 3 p.m. on Thursday in London.
rows.output: Chelsea za ta yi wasa da Videoton a gasar UEFA Europa League da misalin karfe 3 na rana a ranar Alhamis a birnin Landan.
rows.reference: Chelsea za ta kara da Videoton a cikin kofin ƙalubale na  UEFA Europa Leaguge da ƙarfe 3 na yamma a ranar Alhamis a cikin Landan.

rows.source: Death toll from Indonesia tsunami rises to 832
rows.output: An samu mutuwar mutane 832 daga tsunami da ya afku a Indonesia
rows.reference: An sami ƙarin mutuwa a tsunami na Indonesiya zuwa 832

rows.source: The death toll in Indonesia's earthquake and tsunami has climbed to 832, the country's disaster agency said early Sunday.
rows.output: An samu mutuwar mutane 832 a cikin girgizar kasa da tsunami da suka afku a Indonesia, a cewar hukumar bala'i ta kasar da safiyar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Ƙididdigar mutuwar a girgizar ƙasar ta Indonesiyan ya haura zuwa 832, inji hukumar kula da bala’i ta ƙasar a farkon ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: Many people were reported trapped in the rubble of buildings brought down in the 7.5 magnitude earthquake which struck Friday and triggered waves as high as 20 feet, agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho told a news conference.
rows.output: An ruwaito cewa mutane da dama sun makale a cikin tarkacen gine-gine da aka fasa da girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.5 da ta afku a ranar Juma'a, wadda ta haifar da igiyoyin ruwa har zuwa ƙafa 20, in ji mai magana da yawun hukumar Sutopo Purwo Nugroho a wani taron manema labarai.
rows.reference: Abin ya ritsa da mutane masu yawa a cikin burbushin gine-gine da girgizar ƙasar mai ƙarfi na 7.5 ta rusa wadda ta auku ranar Juma’a da kuma ta jawo tashin jijiyoyin ruwa har tsawon taku 20, inji mai magana da yawun hukumar Sutopo Purwo Nugroho a lokacin da yake bayani a taron manema labarai.

rows.source: The city of Palu, which has more than 380,000 people, was strewn with debris from collapsed buildings.
rows.output: Birnin Palu, wanda ke da fiye da mutane 380,000, ya cika da tarkace daga gine-ginen da suka ruguje.
rows.reference: Birnin Palu, mai mutane fiye da 380,000, ka kasance da ɓaraƙuzan rusassun gine-gine birjit.

rows.source: Police arrest man, 32, on suspicion of murder after woman is stabbed to death
rows.output: An kama mutum mai shekaru 32 a kan zargin kisan gilla bayan an kashe wata mata da wuka
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun kama mutum, mai shekaru 32, a kan tuhuma bayan kashe mata ta hanyar caka mata wuƙa

rows.source: A murder investigation has been launched after woman's body was found in Birkenhead, Merseyside this morning.
rows.output: An bude bincike kan kisan gilla bayan an gano gawar mace a Birkenhead, Merseyside a safiyar yau.
rows.reference: An ƙaddamar da wani bincike bayan an sami gawar wata mata a cikin Birkenhead, Merseyside wannan safiyar.

rows.source: The 44-year-old was found at 7.55am with stab wounds on Grayson Mews on John Street, with a 32-year-old man being arrested on suspicion of murder.
rows.output: An gano mutum mai shekaru 44 a cikin wani yanayi na harbin bindiga a Grayson Mews a kan titin John da misalin karfe 7.55 na safe, inda aka kama wani mutum mai shekaru 32 da laifin kisan kai.
rows.reference: An sami mai shekaru 44 ne da karfe 7:55 na safe da raunuka na caka wuka a kan Grayson Mews da ke kan Titin John, tare da kama wani mutum mai shekaru 32 da ake tuhuma da kisan.

rows.source: Police have urged people in the area who saw or heard anything to come forward.
rows.output: Jami'an 'yan sanda sun yi kira ga mutanen yankin da suka ga ko ji wani abu, su gabato.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun nemi mutane da ke yankin da suka gani ko kuma suka ji wani abu da su garzayo.

rows.source: Detective Inspector Brian O'Hagan said: 'The investigation is in the early stages but I would appeal to anyone who was in the vicinity of John Street in Birkenhead who saw or heard anything suspicious to contact us.
rows.output: Jami'in Bincike Brian O'Hagan ya ce: 'Binciken yana cikin farkon mataki amma zan yi kira ga duk wanda yake cikin yankin John Street a Birkenhead wanda ya ga ko ya ji wani abu da ba a sani ba ya tuntube mu.
rows.reference: Sufeto Mai Bincike Brian O'Hagan ya ce: ‘Binciken yana matakan farko-farko ne amma zan yi kira ga duk wanda ke kewayen Layin John a Birkenhead wanda ya gani ko kuma ya ji wani abu da bai yarda da shi ba da ya tuntuɓe mu.

rows.source: I would also appeal to anyone, particularly taxi drivers, who may have captured anything on dashcam footage to contact us as they may have information which is vital to our investigation.'
rows.output: Kuma zan yi kira ga duk wanda, musamman direbobin taksi, wanda zai iya samun wani abu a kan fayil ɗin dashcam, ya tuntube mu domin zai iya samun bayanai masu muhimmanci ga bincikenmu.
rows.reference: Har ila yau zan sake kira ga kowa, musamman direbobin tasi, waɗanda ƙila sun ɗauki hoto a kyamarar da ke cikin gaban mota da su tuntuɓe mu don ba mamaki ƙila suna da bayani da ke da muhimmanci ga bincikenmu.'

rows.source: A police spokesman has confirmed the woman whose body was found is local to Birkenhead and she was found inside a property.
rows.output: Wani jami'in 'yan sanda ya tabbatar da cewa matar da aka samu gawarwaki tana cikin garin Birkenhead kuma an samu ta a cikin wani gida.
rows.reference: Wani mai magana da yawun ‘yan sanda ya tabbatar da cewa matar da aka sami gawar tata ‘yar yankin na Birkenhead ne kuma an same ta ne a cikin wani gini.

rows.source: This afternoon friends who believe they know the woman have arrived at the scene to ask questions about where she was found this morning.
rows.output: Yau da yamma, abokai da suka yi imani sun san matar sun iso wurin da ake yi wa tambayoyi game da inda aka samu ta a safiyar yau.
rows.reference: Yau da rana abokai waɗanda suka yi imani sun san matar sun je wurin da abin ya faru don yin tambayoyi game da inda aka same ta wannan safiyar.

rows.source: Investigations are ongoing as police have said they are in the process of informing the victim's next of kin.
rows.output: Ana ci gaba da bincike yayin da 'yan sanda suka bayyana cewa suna cikin tsarin sanar da 'yan uwa na wanda aka azabtar.
rows.reference: Ana ci gaba da bincike-bincike kamar yadda ‘yan sanda suke cewa suna cikin shirin gaya wa ‘yan uwan wadda abin ya shafa.

rows.source: A taxi driver who lives in Grayson Mews has just tried to get back into his flat but is being told by police no one is allowed in or out of the building.
rows.output: Mai tuka motocin haya da ke zaune a Grayson Mews ya yi ƙoƙarin komawa gidan sa, amma ‘yan sanda sun gaya masa cewa babu wanda aka ba da izinin shiga ko fita daga ginin.
rows.reference: Wani direban tasi da ke zaune a Grayson Mews ya yi ƙoƙarin ya koma cikin gidansa amma ‘yan sanda sun gaya masa cewa ba a yarda wani ya shiga ciki ko fita daga ginin ba.

rows.source: He was speechless when he discovered what happened.
rows.output: Ya yi shuru lokacin da ya gano abin da ya faru.
rows.reference: Ya gagara magana a lokacin da ya gano abin da ya faru.

rows.source: Residents are now being told it will be hours until they are allowed back in.
rows.output: Mazauna yanzu ana gaya musu cewa za a yi sa'o'i kafin a bar su su dawo ciki.
rows.reference: An gaya wa mazaunan cewa zai ɗauki sa’o’i kafin a bari su koma ciki.

rows.source: A police officer was heard telling one man that the entire area is now being treated as a crime scene.
rows.output: Wani jami'in 'yan sanda ya ji yana gaya wa wani mutum cewa dukkan yankin yanzu ana daukarsa a matsayin wurin da ake gudanar da bincike.
rows.reference: An ji wani jami’in ‘yan sanda yana gaya wa wani mutum cewa ana ɗaukan gaba ɗaya wurin a matsayin wani wuri da aka aikata laifi.

rows.source: A woman appeared at the scene in tears.
rows.output: Wani mutum ya bayyana a wurin yana kuka.
rows.reference: Wata mata ta bayyana a wurin a tana cike da hawaye.

rows.source: She keeps repeating 'it's so awful'.
rows.output: Tana ci gaba da cewa 'yana da ban tsoro sosai'.
rows.reference: Ta ci gaba da maimaita ‘Abin da ban tsoro’.

rows.source: At 2pm two police vans were inside the cordon with another van just outside.
rows.output: Da misalin karfe 2 na rana, motocin ‘yan sanda guda biyu sun kasance a cikin shingen, tare da wata motar ‘yan sanda a waje.
rows.reference: Da karfe 2 na rana motoci guda biyu na ‘yan sanda sun killece tare da wata babbar mota guda kawai a waje.

rows.source: A number of officers were stood inside the cordon monitoring the block of flats.
rows.output: An yi wa wasu jami'ai a cikin katangar da ke kewaye da blok ɗin na'urorin.
rows.reference: Wasu jami’an sun tsaya a cikin killecewar suna duba yanki na gidajen.

rows.source: Anyone with information is asked to DM @MerPolCC, call 101 or contact Crimestoppers anonymously on 0800 555 111 quoting log 247 of 30th September.
rows.output: Kowa da ke da bayanai ana rokon ya tuntubi @MerPolCC, ya kira 101, ko ya tuntubi Crimestoppers a cikin sirri a 0800 555 111, yana ambaton log 247 na 30 ga Satumba.
rows.reference: An buƙaci duk wanda ke da bayani da ya aika ta DM @MerPolCC, kira 101 ko tuntuɓi masu hana laifuka a sirrince a kan 0800 555 111 ta amfani da ambaton jeri na 247 na ranar 30 ga Satumba.

rows.source: Parliament's statue of Cromwell becomes latest memorial hit by 'rewriting history' row
rows.output: An yi wa majalisar Cromwell sabon abin tunawa da aka fi so a cikin muhawara kan sake rubuta tarihin
rows.reference: Mutum-mutumi na Majalisar Dokoki ta Cromwell ta zama abin da ake tunawa na baya-bayan nan da ya faɗa ‘rikicin sake rubuta tarihi’

rows.source: Its banishment would be poetic justice for his Taliban-like destruction of so many of England's cultural and religious artefacts carried out by his fanatical Puritan followers.
rows.output: Zaman ban-din shi zai zama adalci na waƙa ga lalata da Taliban ya yi wa al'adun Ingila da abubuwan addini da yawa da magoya bayansa na Puritan masu tsattsauran ra'ayi suka yi.
rows.reference: Kore shin zai zama sakamakon alhaki don irin salon rushe wuraren tarihi, al’ada da addini na Ingila kamar na ‘yan Taliban yadda mabiyansa masu tsatstsauran ra’ayi suka yi.

rows.source: But the Cromwell Society described Mr Crick's suggestion as "folly" and "attempting to rewrite history."
rows.output: Amma kungiyar Cromwell ta bayyana shawarar Mista Crick a matsayin "folly" kuma "yunkurin sake rubuta tarihi."
rows.reference: Amma Al’ummar Cromwell sun bayyana shawarar ta Mista Crick a matsayin “wauta” da “ƙoƙari na sake rubuta tarihi.”

rows.source: John Goldsmith, chairman of the Cromwell Society, said: "It was inevitable in the present debate about the removal of statues that the figure of Oliver Cromwell outside the Palace of Westminster would become a target.
rows.output: John Goldsmith, shugaban kungiyar Cromwell Society, ya ce: "Ya zama tilas a cikin muhawara ta yanzu game da cire hotunan mutane cewa siffar Oliver Cromwell a wajen fadar Westminster za ta zama makoma.
rows.reference: John Goldsmith, shugaban Al’ummar Cromwell, ya ce: “Ba za a iya gujewa a cikin mahawarar da ake yi yanzu ba game da cire mutum-mutumi cewa surar Oliver Cromwell a wajen Fadar Westminster za ta zama wani abin da ake hari.

rows.source: The iconoclasm of the English civil wars was neither ordered nor carried out by Cromwell.
rows.output: An yi wa Cromwell alƙawari, amma bai yi ba.
rows.reference: Yin hari a kan fitattun abubuwa na yaƙe-yaƙen basasar Ingila ba Cromwell na ba da oda a yi ko ya aikata ba.

rows.source: Perhaps the wrong Cromwell would be sacrificed for the actions of his ancestor Thomas in the previous century.
rows.output: Wataƙila an yi wa Cromwell da ba daidai ba aka yi wa Cromwell da ya gabata a ƙarni na baya.
rows.reference: Watakila abu mummunan da za a ga bayan Cromwell a kansa shi ne ayyukan da kakansa Thomas ya yi a cikin ƙarni da ya wuce.

rows.source: Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft's magnificent representation of Cromwell is evidence of 19th century opinion and part of the historiography of a figure who many believe is still worth celebrating.
rows.output: Babbar wakilci ta Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft ta Cromwell shi ne shaida na ra'ayin karni na 19 da kuma wani bangare na tarihin tarihin wani mutum da da yawa ke ganin har yanzu yana da daraja a yi murnar shi.
rows.reference: Akwai babbar bayani game da Cromwell na Sa William Hamo Thorneycroft da ke zama hujjar ra’ayi na karni na 19 wanda kuma ɓangare na ilimin bayanan tarihin na wani sananne wanda mafi yawa suka yi imani har yanzu ya kamata a yi murna a kansa.

rows.source: Mr Goldsmith told The Sunday Telegraph: "Cromwell is regarded by many, perhaps more in the late 19th century than today, as a defender of parliament against external pressure, in his case of course the monarchy.
rows.output: Mista Goldsmith ya faɗa wa The Sunday Telegraph: "Cromwell ana ganin shi da yawa, wataƙila a ƙarshen ƙarni na 19 fiye da yau, a matsayin mai kare majalisar dokokin kasar daga matsin lamba daga waje, a cikin yanayin sa na musamman, sarauta.
rows.reference: Mista Goldsmith ya faɗa a jaridar The Sunday Telegraph: “Mutane da yawa suna ɗaukan Cromwell, watakila sosai a shekarun karshe na karni na 19 fiye da yau, a matsayin mai kare majalisar dokoki daga matsi na waje, a cikin rikicin ba makawa da mulkin sarauta.

rows.source: Whether that is a wholly accurate representation is the subject of continuing historical debate.
rows.output: Shin hakan da gaske yana wakiltar gaskiya gaba ɗaya ne, batu ne na muhawara ta tarihi da ke ci gaba.
rows.reference: Ko wancan bayanin zai zama wani abu gaba ɗaya daidai ya zama batun na ci gaba da mahawara ta fuskar tarihi.

rows.source: What is certain is that the conflict of the mid 17th century has shaped the subsequent development of our nation, and Cromwell is an individual recognisable figure who represents one side of that divide.
rows.output: Abin da ya tabbatar shi ne, rikici na tsakiyar karni na 17 ya tsara ci gaban da ya biyo baya na kasar mu, kuma Cromwell mutum ne mai iya ganewa wanda ke wakiltar daya daga cikin rarrabuwar kawuna.
rows.reference: Abin da ke da tabbaci shi ne rikicin na tsakiyar ƙarni na 17 ya gyara ci gaba na ƙasarmu da aka samu daga baya, kuma Cromwell wani mutum ne sananne da aka sani wanda ke wakiltar sashe ɗaya na wancan rikicin.

rows.source: His achievements as Lord Protector are also worth celebrating and commemorating."
rows.output: Gwanjon da ya yi a matsayin Mai Karewa ma suna da muhimmanci a yi murnar su da kuma tunawa da su."
rows.reference: Abubuwan da ya cimma a matsayin Lord Protector ya kuma kamata a yi bikinsu da tunawa da su.”

rows.source: Killer Pig Mauls Chinese Farmer to Death
rows.output: Aljanin da ya kashe ya kashe manomi kasar Sinawa
rows.reference: Makashi Alade ya Turmushe Manomi Dan China har Lahira

rows.source: A farmer was attacked and killed by a pig in a market in southwest China, according to local media reports.
rows.output: Wani manomi ya samu hari ya mutu a hannun aladen da ke kasuwa a kudu maso yammacin kasar Sin, a cewar rahotanni na yankunan.
rows.reference: Wani alade ya kai hari da kuma kashe wani manomi a cikin wata kasuwa da ke cikin kudu-maso-yamma na China, a cewar rahotanni daga kafofin watsa labarai na gida.

rows.source: The man, identified only by his surname "Yuan," was found dead with a severed artery, covered in blood near a sty at the market in Liupanshui in Guizhou province, the South China Morning Post reported Sunday.
rows.output: Mutumin, wanda aka gano da sunan karshe "Yuan," an samu shi ya mutu da jijiyoyin jijiya, an rufe shi da jini kusa da wani shago a kasuwar Liupanshui a lardin Guizhou, kamar yadda jaridar South China Morning Post ta ruwaito a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: An gano mutumin kawai da sunan laƙabinsa na "Yuan," wanda aka samu a mace tare da jijiyar wuya a yanke, duk jini ya rufe kusa da wani sty a kasuwar da ke cikin Liupanshui a cikin lardin Guizhou province, kamar yadda jaridar South China Morning Post ta kawo rahoto.

rows.source: A pig farmer prepares to inject vaccines into pigs at a hoggery on May 30, 2005 in Xining of Qinghai Province, China.
rows.output: Manomi mai kiwon aladen yana shirya yin allurar rigakafi ga aladen a gonar aladen a ranar 30 ga Mayu, 2005 a Xining na lardin Qinghai, Sin.
rows.reference: Wani manomin alade ya shirya yin allura ga aladu a ɗakin kiwon aladu a ranar 30 ga Mayu, 2005 a cikin Xining da Lardin Qinghai, China.

rows.source: He had reportedly travelled with his cousin from the neighboring Yunnan province Wednesday to sell 15 pigs at the market.
rows.output: Ya yi tafiya tare da kawunsa daga lardin makwabta na Yunnan a ranar Laraba domin sayar da aladen 15 a kasuwa.
rows.reference: An ba da rahoton cewa ya yi bulaguro ne da ɗan uwansa daga makwaɓcin lardin Yunnan a ranar Laraba don sayar da aladu 15 a kasuwar.

rows.source: The following morning, his cousin found him dead, and discovered a door to a neighbouring pig sty open.
rows.output: Washe gari, dan uwansa ya samu shi ya mutu, ya kuma gano kofa da ke kan wani kanti na alade a bude.
rows.reference: Da safiyar washegari, ɗan uwan nasa ya same a mace, kuma ya ga wata ƙofa zuwa ga wani makwaɓcin wurin aladu na sty a buɗe.

rows.source: He said that in the sty was a large male pig with blood on its mouth.
rows.output: Ya ce a cikin gidan kiwo akwai babban aladen namijin da jini a bakinsa.
rows.reference: Ya ce a cikin sty ɗin an sami wani babban alade namiji da jini a kan bakinsa.

rows.source: A forensic examination confirmed that the 550 pound hog had mauled the farmer to death, according to the report.
rows.output: An tabbatar da binciken dakin gwaje-gwaje cewa aladen da ya kai kilo 550 ya kashe manomi, a cewar rahoton.
rows.reference: Wani binciken kimiyya na abin da ya faru ya tabbatar da cewa aladen mai nauyi 550 ya murƙushe manomin har lahira, a cewar rahoton.

rows.source: "My cousin's legs were bloody and mangled," the cousin, referred to by his surname "Wu," said, as quoted by the Guiyang Evening News.
rows.output: "Ƙanwata ya yi jini da kuma rauni," kawunta, wanda aka kira da sunan "Wu," ya ce, kamar yadda jaridar Guiyang Evening News ta ruwaito.
rows.reference: “Ƙafafun dan uwana sun kasance a cikin jini kuma a lanƙwashe,” ɗan uwan ya ambaci sunan laƙabinsa da “Wu” inji shi, kamar yadda Guiyang Evening News ta fada.

rows.source: Security camera footage showed Yuan entering the market at 4.40 am Thursday to feed his pigs.
rows.output: Fitar da bidiyo na tsaron ya nuna Yuan yana shiga kasuwa da misalin ƙarfe 4.40 na safe ranar Alhamis don ciyar da aladen sa.
rows.reference: Bidiyo daga kyamarar tsaro ta nuna Yuan yana shiga kasuwar da ƙarfe 4:40 na safe a ranar Alhamis don ba da abinci ga aladunsa.

rows.source: His body was found about an hour later.
rows.output: An gano gawar sa kusan sa'a guda bayan haka.
rows.reference: An sami gawarsa kusan bayan sa’a guda.

rows.source: The animal who killed the man did not belong to Yuan or his cousin.
rows.output: Dabbar da ta kashe mutumin ba ta kasance na Yuan ko kawunsa ba.
rows.reference: Dabbar da ta kashe mutumin ba mallakar Yuan ko ɗan uwan nasa  ba ne.

rows.source: A market manager told the Evening News that the pig had been locked away to prevent it attacking anyone else, while police gathered evidence at the scene.
rows.output: Wani mai kula da kasuwa ya gaya wa Labaran Yamma cewa an kulle aladen ne domin hana shi kai wa wani hari, yayin da ‘yan sanda suka tattara shaidar a wurin.
rows.reference: Wani manajan kasuwa ya gaya wa Evening News cewa an rufe aladen don hana shi kai hari a wani mutum daban, a lokacin da ‘yan sanda kuma ke tara bayanan hujja a wurin da abin ya faru.

rows.source: Yuan's family and market authorities are reportedly negotiating compensation for his death.
rows.output: Iyalan Yuan da hukumar kasuwa suna tattaunawa kan diyyan mutuwar sa.
rows.reference: An ba da rahoton cewa iyalan Yuan da hukumomin kasuwar suna tattaunawar biyan diyyar don mutuwarsa.

rows.source: Though rare, cases of pigs attacking humans have been recorded before.
rows.output: Kodayaushe, ana samun rahotanni na al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka shafi al'adu da suka
rows.reference: Ko da yake ba yawa, a da an ga misalai na harin aladu a kan ‘yan Adam.

rows.source: In 2016, a pig attacked a woman and her husband at their farm in Massachusetts, leaving the man with critical injuries.
rows.output: A shekara ta 2016, aljanu ya kai hari ga wata mata da mijinta a gonar da suke da ita a Massachusetts, wanda hakan ya sa mutum ya samu munanan raunuka.
rows.reference: A cikin 2016, wani alade ya kai hari ga wata mata da mijinta a gonarsu da ke Massachusetts, inda ya bar mutumin a cikin munanan raunuka.
