rows.source: Ten years previously, a 650 pound pig pinned a Welsh farmer to his tractor until his wife scared the animal away.
rows.output: Shekaru goma da suka wuce, wani aladen kilo 650 ya tsage wani manomi na Welsh zuwa injin noman nasa har sai matarsa ta tsoratar da dabbar.
rows.reference: Shekaru goma da suka wuce, wani alade mai nauyi 650 ya tsire wani manomi dan Welsh zuwa ga tantan ɗinsa har sai da matarsa ta tsoritar da dabbar ta gudu.

rows.source: After an Oregon farmer was eaten by his pigs in 2012, one Manitoba farmer told CBC News that pigs are not normally aggressive but the taste of blood can act as a "trigger."
rows.output: Bayan da wani manomi a Oregon ya ci shi a 2012, wani manomi a Manitoba ya gaya wa CBC News cewa al'ada ce karnuka ba su da hargitsi amma dandanon jini na iya zama "mabuɗin."
rows.reference: Bayan wani manomi mutumin Oregun aladunsa sun cinye shi a 2012, wani manomi guda ɗan Manitoba ya faɗa a CBC News cewa aladu ba su cika faɗa ba amma dandanon jini zai iya zama wani “abu da zaburar.”

rows.source: "They're just being playful.
rows.output: Suna yin wasa kawai.
rows.reference: “Kawai suna da wasa ne.

rows.source: They're nippers, very inquisitive ... they aren't out to hurt you.
rows.output: Suna da ƙwari, suna da sha'awa sosai ... ba su da niyyan cutar da ku.
rows.reference: Su masu kamu ne, suna da son su san abu... ba su fito ne don su cutar ba.

rows.source: You just have to pay them the right amount of respect," he said.
rows.output: Kawai ka bi su da girmamawa mai kyau," ya ce.
rows.reference: Kawai dole ne ka mutunta su yadda ya kamata,” inji shi.

rows.source: Hurricane Rosa's remnants to bring widespread heavy rain to southwest US
rows.output: Guguwar Rosa ta bar wani yanayi mai tsanani da ya mamaye kudu maso yammacin Amurka
rows.reference: Ragowar iskar guguwar Rosa za su haifar da ruwan sama mai yawa ga kudu-maso-yamma na Amurka

rows.source: As forecast, Hurricane Rosa is weakening as it moves over the cooler waters of the northern coast of Mexico.
rows.output: Kamar yadda aka annabta, guguwar Hurricane Rosa na raunana yayin da take tafiya kan ruwan sanyi na bakin tekun arewa na Mexico.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda hasashe ya nuna, Guguwar Rosa tana samun rauni kamar yadda take motsawa ta saman ruwa mai sanyi na bakin teku na Mexico.

rows.source: However, Rosa will bring flooding rains across northern Mexico and the southwest U.S. over the coming days.
rows.output: Amma, Rosa za ta kawo ambaliyar ruwa a arewa maso yammacin Mexico da kuma kudu maso yammacin Amurka a cikin kwanaki masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Amma, Rosa za ta haifar da ambaliyar ruwan sama a faɗin arewacin Mexico da kudu-maso-yamma na Amurka a kwanaki masu zuwa.

rows.source: Rosa had winds of 85 mph, a Category 1 Hurricane, as of 5 a.m. Eastern time Sunday, and was located 385 miles southwest of Punta Eugenia, Mexico.
rows.output: Rosa tana da iska mai saukin gaske na mil 85 a cikin sa'a, wani typhoon na Category 1, da misalin karfe 5 na safe a lokacin Gabacin Gabacin, ranar Lahadi, kuma tana da nisan mil 385 kudu maso yamma da Punta Eugenia, Mexico.
rows.reference: Rosa tana da iska ta mil 85 a cikin sa’a, wani Nau’i na 1 na Guguwar, a lokaci na ƙarfe 5 na safe a ranar Lahadi lokaci na Gabashi, kuma an gan ta a mil 385 na kudu-maso-yamma na Punta Eugenia, Mexico.

rows.source: Rosa is expected to move north on Sunday.
rows.output: Rosa za ta yi tafiya zuwa arewa a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin Rosa za ta motsa zuwa arewa a ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: Meanwhile, a trough is beginning to take shape over the Pacific Ocean and move east toward the West Coast of the U.S. As Rosa approaches the Baja California peninsula on Monday as a tropical storm it will begin to push deep tropical moisture northward into the southwest U.S.
rows.output: A halin yanzu, wani rafi yana fara bayyana a kan Tekun Pasifik kuma yana tafiya gabas zuwa gabar tekun yamma na Amurka. Yayinda Rosa ke gabatowa kan tsibirin Baja California a ranar Litinin a matsayin guguwar tropikal, za ta fara tura zurfin danshin tropikal zuwa arewa zuwa kudu maso yammancin Amurka.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake cikin nan, wata akalar ruwan ta fara kankama a saman Tekun Pacific inda ta motsa gabas zuwa Bakin Teku na Yamma na Amurka. Kamar yadda Rosa ke tunkaran zirin Baja California a ranar Litinin a matsayin wani babban haɗari za ta fara tura laimar zafi zuwa yankin arewaci cikin kudu-maso-yamma na Amurka.

rows.source: Rosa will bring up to 10 inches of rain in parts of Mexico on Monday.
rows.output: Rosa za ta kawo ruwan sama mai yawa har zuwa inci 10 a wasu sassan Mexico a ranar Litinin.
rows.reference: Rosa za ta haifar da har kusan inci 10 na ruwan sama a sassan Mexico a ranar Litinin.

rows.source: Then, tropical moisture interacting with the approaching trough will create widespread heavy rainfall in the Southwest over the coming days.
rows.output: Sannan, danshi na wurare masu zafi yana mu'amala da gangar jikin da ke gabatowa zai haifar da ruwan sama mai yawa a duk faɗin yankin Kudu maso Yamma a cikin 'yan kwanaki masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Sa’an nan, laimar zafin idan ta haɗu tare da akalar ruwa da ke fuskantowa za ta ƙirƙiri wani ruwan sama da zai isa wurare masu yawa a cikin kudu-maso-yamma a kwanaki masu zuwa.

rows.source: Locally, 1 to 4 inches of rain will cause dangerous flash flooding, debris flows and possibility landslides in the desert.
rows.output: A cikin gida, inci 1 zuwa 4 na ruwa za su haifar da ambaliya mai haɗari, guntun ruwa, da kuma yiwuwar ambaliya a cikin hamada.
rows.reference: A cikin gida, inci 1 zuwa 14 na ruwan sama zai haifar da mummunan ambaliya, kwararar burbushi da kuma yiwuwar zaizayar ƙasa a cikin hamadar.

rows.source: Deep tropical moisture will cause rainfall rates to approach 2 to 3 inches per hour in spots, especially in parts of southern Nevada and Arizona.
rows.output: Zazzabin danshi mai tsanani zai sa yawan ruwan sama ya kai inci 2 zuwa 3 a sa'a guda a wasu wurare, musamman a sassan kudu maso yammacin Nevada da Arizona.
rows.reference: Matsananciyar laimar zafi za ta iya haifar da kimomin ruwan sama da zai fuskanci incina 2 zuwa 3 a kowace sa’a a cikin wuraren, musamman a cikin sassa na kudancin Nevada da Arizona.

rows.source: As much as 2 to 4 inches of rain is expected in parts of the Southwest, especially over much of Arizona.
rows.output: Kusan inci 2 zuwa 4 na ruwa na iya saukowa a wasu sassan Kudu maso Yamma, musamman a kan mafi yawan yankin Arizona.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin inci 2 zuwa 4 na ruwan sama a sassan kudu-maso-yamma, musamman a mafi yawanci na Arizona.

rows.source: Flash flooding is possible with rapidly deteriorating conditions due to the scattered nature of tropical rain.
rows.output: Hadarar ambaliya na iya faruwa tare da yanayi mai sauri ya tabarbare saboda yanayin da ba a iya gani ba na ruwan damina na tropikal.
rows.reference: Akwai yiwuwar samun ambaliya ruwa ba ƙaƙƙautawa saboda yanda lalacewar yanayi ke ci gaba da ta'azzara saboda irin yadda ruwan sama ke sauka a yanki mai zafi yake jifa-jifa.

rows.source: It would be extremely ill advised to venture out into the desert on foot with the threat of tropical rainfall.
rows.output: Zai zama da matuƙar rashin hikima a yi tafiya cikin hamada a kan ƙafafu tare da barazana na ruwan damina na wurare masu zafi.
rows.reference: Mummunan shawara ne a fita zuwa cikin hamada da kafa ganin barazanar ruwan saman na wuri mai zafin.

rows.source: Heavy rain could cause canyons to become raging rivers and thunderstorms will bring locally gusty winds and blowing dust.
rows.output: Ruwan sama mai nauyi zai iya sa kogon ya zama kogi mai cikar ruwa kuma guguwar ruwa za ta kawo iska mai karfi a wasu wurare da kuma busa yashi.
rows.reference: Ruwan sama mai yawan zai iya haifar da kwazazzabai su zama koguna masu gudu kuma cidar ruwa za ta haifar da iska mai ƙura da kaɗa ƙura.

rows.source: The approaching trough will bring some locally heavy rain to parts of the Southern California coastline.
rows.output: Tafkuna masu zuwa za su kawo ruwan sama mai yawa a wasu sassan gabar tekun Kudu na California.
rows.reference: Akalar ruwan saman da ke fuskantowa za ta jawo ruwan sama mai yawa ta gida zuwa ga sassa na bakin teku na Kudancin California.

rows.source: Rainfall totals of over half an inch are possible, which could cause minor debris flows and slick roadways.
rows.output: Ruwan sama na sama da inci rabin na iya faruwa, wanda zai iya haifar da ƙananan guntun ruwa da kuma hanyar da ba ta da kyau.
rows.reference: Akwai yiwuwar samun jimillar ruwan sama na sama da wani inci, wanda zai haifar da ɗan ƙaramin kwararar burbushi kuma hanyoyin mota su yi santsi.

rows.source: This would be the region's first rainfall of their wet season.
rows.output: Wannan zai zama farkon ruwan sama a wannan yankin a lokacin damuna.
rows.reference: Wannan zai zama ruwan sama na farko na lardin na lokacinsu na damuna.

rows.source: Some scattered tropical rain showers will begin to approach Arizona late Sunday and early Monday, before the rain becomes more widespread late Monday and Tuesday.
rows.output: Wasu ruwan sama na ruwa na wurare masu zafi za su fara kusantar Arizona da daddare ranar Lahadi da farko ranar Litinin, kafin ruwan sama ya yadu sosai da daddare ranar Litinin da Talata.
rows.reference: Wani ruwan sama jifa-jifa na wurin zafi zai fara fuskantowa Arizona a makare ranar Lahadi da farkon ranar Litinin, kafin ruwan saman zai zama ya bazu da yawa ranar Litinin a makare da Talata.

rows.source: Heavy rain will spread into the Four Corners on Tuesday and last through Wednesday.
rows.output: Ruwan sama mai nauyi zai bazu zuwa Mafaka Hudu a ranar Talata kuma ya dore har zuwa Laraba.
rows.reference: Ruwan sama mai yawa zai bazu a cikin Kusurwowi Huɗu a ranar Talata har ya kai cikin Laraba.

rows.source: October can see some intense temperature swings across the U.S. as the Arctic gets cooler, but the tropics remain quite warm.
rows.output: Oktoba na iya ganin manyan canje-canje na zafin jiki a duk faɗin Amurka yayin da Arctic ke sanyaya, amma tropics na da zafi sosai.
rows.reference: Watan Oktoba zai iya ganin wani tsananin yanayi mai juyawa a faɗin Amurka kamar yadda Arctic ke ƙara sanyi, amma kuma wurare masu zafin za su ci gaba da kasancewa da dumi.

rows.source: Sometimes this leads to dramatic changes in temperature over short distances.
rows.output: Wani lokaci wannan yana haifar da gagarumin canje-canje a cikin zafin jiki a cikin gajeruwar nesa.
rows.reference: A wasu lokutan wannan zai kai ga canje-canje masu ban mamaki a cikin yanayi na wasu lokuta gajeru.

rows.source: There is a great example of dramatic temperature differences through the central U.S. on Sunday.
rows.output: Akwai babban misali na ban mamaki na bambance-bambancen zafin jiki a tsakiyar Amurka a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Akwai wani babban misali na bambance-bambancen yanayi mai ban mamaki ta cikin tsakiyar Amurka a ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: There is nearly a 20-degree temperature difference between Kansas City, Missouri, and Omaha, Nebraska, and between St. Louis and Des Moines, Iowa.
rows.output: Akwai kusan bambancin digiri 20 na zafin jiki tsakanin Kansas City, Missouri, da Omaha, Nebraska, da kuma tsakanin St. Louis da Des Moines, Iowa.
rows.reference: Akwai kusan wani bambancin yanayi na digiri 20 tsakanin  Birnin Kansas, Missouri, da Omaha, Nebraska, da tsakanin  St. Louis da Des Moines, Iowa.

rows.source: Over the next few days, lingering summer warmth will try to build and expand again.
rows.output: A cikin 'yan kwanaki masu zuwa, zafi na bazara da ya rage zai yi ƙoƙarin gina da fadada kai.
rows.reference: A ‘yan kwanaki masu zuwa, ɗumin lokacin zafi zai yi ƙoƙari ya ginu da sake faɗaɗa.

rows.source: Much of the central and eastern U.S. is expected to see a warm start to October with widespread 80s from the Southern Plains to parts of the Northeast.
rows.output: Yawanci na tsakiyar da gabashin Amurka ana sa ran za su ga farkon watan Oktoba mai dumi tare da yawaitar 80s daga Gabashin Karkara zuwa sassan Arewa maso Gabashin.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin yawancin tsakiya da gabashin Amurka za ta ga wani ɗumi da zai fara zuwa Oktoba tare da bazuwar 80s daga Sararin Kudanci zuwa ga sassa na Arewa-maso-gabas.

rows.source: New York City could reach 80 degrees on Tuesday, which would be approximately 10 degrees above average.
rows.output: Birnin New York zai kai 80 digiri a ranar Talata, wanda zai kasance kusan 10 digiri sama da matsakaicin.
rows.reference: Birnin New York zai iya kai wa digiri 80a ranar Talata, wanda aƙalla ya kai digiri 10 a sama matsakaici.

rows.source: Our long term climate forecast is indicating high chances for above-average temperatures for the eastern U.S. through the first half of October.
rows.output: Hasashen yanayi na dogon lokaci yana nuna yawan yiwuwar zafin jiki sama da matsakaicin zafin jiki ga gabashin Amurka a cikin rabin farko na Oktoba.
rows.reference: Hasashen yanayin namu mai tsawo yana nuna babban kintace yiwuwar matsakaicin yanayi na sama don gabashin Amurka a cikin farkon rabin Oktoba.

rows.source: More than 20 million people watched Brett Kavanaugh hearing
rows.output: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 sun kalli shari'ar Brett Kavanaugh
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 ne suka kalli jin bahasi na Brett Kavanaugh

rows.source: More than 20 million people watched Thursday's gripping testimony by Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh and the woman who accused him of a sexual assault that allegedly occurred in the 1980s, Christine Blasey Ford, on six television networks.
rows.output: Fiye da miliyan 20 na mutane sun kalli shahadar da aka yi a ranar Alhamis da kotun koli ta zabo, Brett Kavanaugh da kuma mace da ta zargi shi da cin zarafi, Christine Blasey Ford, a kan hanyoyi shida na talabijin.
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 ne suka kalli shaida mai riƙewa daga wanda aka tura sunan don kujerar Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh da matar da ke ƙararsa a kan cin zarafi na jima’i da ake cewa ya faru a cikin shekaru na 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, a kan hanyoyin sadarwar gidajen talabijin guda shida.

rows.source: Meanwhile, the political standoff continued, with broadcasters interrupting regular programming for Friday's last-minute twist: an agreement engineered by Arizona Sen. Jeff Flake for the FBI to conduct a one-week investigation of the charges.
rows.output: A halin yanzu, rikicin siyasa ya ci gaba, tare da masu watsa shirye-shirye suna katse shirye-shiryen yau da kullun don juyawar da ta gabata a ranar Juma'a: wani yarjejeniyar da Sanatan Arizona Jeff Flake ya tsara don FBI ta gudanar da bincike na mako guda kan zarginsa.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake cikin haka, rikicin siyasar ya ci gaba, tare da masu yada labarai suna katsse shirin da ake yi na kullum don wani sauyi da aka yi na ranar Jumu’a a makare: wata yarjejeniya da Sanatan Arizona Jeff Flake ya haifar don Hukumar FBI ta yi wani bincike na mako guda na tuhume-tuhumen.

rows.source: Ford told the Senate Judiciary Committee that she's 100 percent certain that Kavanaugh groped her drunkenly and tried to take off her clothes at a high school party.
rows.output: Ford ta gaya wa Majalisar Shari'a ta Majalisar Dattijai cewa tana da tabbas 100 cikin ɗari cewa Kavanaugh ya taɓa ta a cikin wani bacci da kuma ƙoƙarin cire mata kayan sawa a wani biki na makaranta.
rows.reference: Ford ya faɗa a Kwamitin Shari’a na Majalisar Dattijai cewa tana da tabbaci kashi 100 cewa Kavanaugh ta cakume ta yana cikin maye kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin cire mata tufafinta a wani biki na makarantar sakandare.

rows.source: Kavanaugh, in impassioned testimony, said he's 100 percent certain that it didn't happen.
rows.output: Kavanaugh, a cikin shahadar da ya yi, ya ce yana da kashi 100 na tabbatuwa cewa hakan bai faru ba.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh, a cikin shaida mai ɓacin rai, ya ce yana tabbaci kashi 100 cewa abin bai faru ba.

rows.source: It's likely that more than the 20.4 million people reported by Nielsen on Friday watched it.
rows.output: Yana da kyau a yi tunanin cewa sama da mutane miliyan 20.4 da Nielsen ya ba da rahoton a ranar Juma'a sun kallonsa.
rows.reference: Ba mamaki fiye da mutane miliyan 20.4 ne a rahoton Nielsen suka kalli abin.

rows.source: The company was counting average viewership on CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel and MSNBC.
rows.output: Kungiyar tana ƙidayar masu kallo a CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel da MSNBC.
rows.reference: Kamfanin ya lasafta matsakaicin yawan masu kallo ne ta CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel da MSNBC.

rows.source: Figures weren't immediately available for other networks that showed it, including PBS, C-SPAN and the Fox Business Network.
rows.output: Ba a samu bayanan da ake buƙata ba don sauran hanyoyin da suka nuna shi, ciki har da PBS, C-SPAN da Fox Business Network.
rows.reference: Ba a sami alƙaluma ba nan da nan ga sauran hanyoyin sadarwa da suka nuna abin, da suka haɗa da PBS, C-SPAN da Fox Business Network ɗin.

rows.source: And Nielsen usually has some trouble measuring people who watch in offices.
rows.output: Kuma Nielsen yawanci yana da wasu matsaloli wajen auna mutane da ke kallo a ofisoshi.
rows.reference: Kuma Nielsen yawanci yana samun matsala ta auna mutane da suka kalla a cikin ofisoshinsu.

rows.source: To put that in perspective, that's an audience size similar to that for a playoff football game or the Academy Awards.
rows.output: Don sanya haka a cikin hangen nesa, wannan masu sauraro iri ɗaya ne da na wasan karshe na ƙwallon ƙafa ko Kyautar Kwaleji.
rows.reference: Don a fito da abin a fili, wancan shi ne kamar girman yawan masu kallo a wasan ƙwallo na wa ka ci ka tashiko ba da Kyaututtukan Academy.

rows.source: Fox News Channel, whose opinion hosts have strongly backed Kavanaugh's appointment, led all networks with an average of 5.69 million viewers during the all-day hearing, Nielsen said.
rows.output: Tashoshin Fox News, wanda masu gabatar da ra'ayoyi sun goyi bayan nadin Kavanaugh sosai, ya jagoranci dukkan tashoshin tare da masu kallo miliyan 5.69 a lokacin zaman da aka yi, a cewar Nielsen.
rows.reference: Tashar Fox News, wadda masu gabatar da ra’ayi sun matukar goyi bayan ɗaukan na Kavanaugh, inda ya jagoranci dukkan hanyoyin sadarwa da ke da matsakaicin masu kallo miliyan 5.69 a lokacin jin bahasin da duk ranar, inji Nielsen.

rows.source: ABC was second with 3.26 million viewers.
rows.output: ABC ta kasance ta biyu da masu kallo miliyan 3.26.
rows.reference: ABC ita ce ta biyu mai masu kallo miliyan 3.26.

rows.source: CBS had 3.1 million, NBC had 2.94 million, MSNBC had 2.89 million and CNN had 2.52 million, Nielsen said.
rows.output: An ce CBS tana da miliyan 3.1, NBC miliyan 2.94, MSNBC miliyan 2.89, CNN kuma miliyan 2.52, in ji Nielsen.
rows.reference: CBS tana da miliyan 3.1, NBC miliyan 2.94, MSNBC miliyan 2.89 da CNN mai miliyan 2.52, inji Nielsen.

rows.source: Interest remained high after the hearing.
rows.output: An ci gaba da sha'awar bayan sauraron karar.
rows.reference: Sha’awa ta kasance ta yi sama bayan sauraron.

rows.source: Flake was the central figure in Friday's drama.
rows.output: Flake ita ce babban mutum a cikin wasan kwaikwayo na Juma'a.
rows.reference: Flake shi ne sananne a tsakiya a cikin diramar Juma’ar.

rows.source: After the moderate Republican's office issued a statement that he would be voting in favor of Kavanaugh, he was caught be CNN and CBS cameras Friday morning being shouted at by protesters as he tried to ride an elevator to a Judiciary Committee hearing.
rows.output: Bayan ofishin mai ra'ayin Republican mai matsakaici ya fitar da wata sanarwa cewa zai yi wa Kavanaugh kuri'a, an kama shi da kyamarorin CNN da CBS a ranar Juma'a da safe yana cikin zagi yayin da yake ƙoƙarin hawa lif zuwa wani taron kwamitin shari'a.
rows.reference: Bayan ofishin ‘yan Republican mai matsakaicin ra’ayi ya fitar da wata jawabi cewa zai zaɓi Kavanaugh, kyamarorin CNN da CBS sun nuna shi a ranar Jumu’a yana ihu a masu zanga-zanga a lokacin da yake ƙoƙarin hawa na’urar ɗaukan mutane zuwa saman bene zuwa ga wurin taron Kwamiti a kan Shari’a.

rows.source: He stood with eyes downcast for several minutes as he was berated, televised live on CNN.
rows.output: Ya tsaya da idanunsa a ƙasa na wasu mintuna da dama yayin da yake samun tsawa, an watsa shi kai tsaye a CNN.
rows.reference: Ya tsaya da idanuwa a ƙasa na tsawon mintina masu yawa a yayin da ake yi masa ihu, ana nunawa a talabijin na CNN.

rows.source: "I'm standing right here in front of you," one woman said.
rows.output: "Ina tsaye a nan kusa da kai," wata mata ta ce.
rows.reference: “Ina tsaye a nan a gabanka,” inji wata mata.

rows.source: "Do you think he's telling the truth to the country?
rows.output: "Kina tunanin yana faɗa wa ƙasar gaskiya?
rows.reference: “Kana jin yana faɗan gaskiya ne ga ƙasar?

rows.source: He was told, "you have power when so many women are powerless.""
rows.output: An faɗa masa, "kana da iko idan da yawa mata ba su da iko."
rows.reference: An gaya masa, “kana da dukkan ƙarfi a lokacin da mata da yawa ba su da ƙarfi.””

rows.source: Flake said that his office had issued a statement and said, before the elevator closed, that he would have more to say at the committee hearing.
rows.output: Flake ya ce ofishinsa ya fitar da wata sanarwa, kuma ya ce kafin lif ya rufe, zai kara magana a zaman majalisar kwamitin.
rows.reference: Flake ya ce ofishinsa ya fitar wani bayani kuma ya ce, kafin na’urar ɗaukan mutanen ta rufe, cewa yana da abu mai yawa da zai faɗa a wurin bahasin kwamitin.

rows.source: The cable and broadcast networks were all covering live hours later, when the Judiciary Committee was to vote to advance Kavanaugh's nomination to the full Senate for a vote.
rows.output: An yi wa masu watsa shirye-shirye na wayar hannu da na watsa shirye-shirye na rediyo rahoto a kai a kai, sa'o'i bayan haka, lokacin da kwamitin shari'a zai yi zaɓe don ci gaba da ba da shawarar Kavanaugh ga majalisar dattijai don yin zaɓe.
rows.reference: Hanyoyin sadarwa na kebul da masu watsawa dukka suna yaɗa abin lokacin da ake yi sa’o’i daga baya, a lokacin da Kwamitin Shari’ar ke kaɗa kuri’a don tura ba da sunan Kavanaugh zuwa ga cikekkiyar Majalisar Dattawan don wani kaɗa kuri’ar.

rows.source: But Flake said he would only do so with the understanding that the FBI would look into the allegations against the nominee for the next week, which minority Democrats have been urging.
rows.output: Amma Flake ya ce zai yi haka ne kawai idan FBI ta duba zarge-zargen da ake yi wa mai neman mukamin na mako mai zuwa, wanda 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat na kananan hukumomi suka yi kira.
rows.reference: Amma Flake ya ce zai yi kawai hakan ne tare da fahimtar cewa hukumar bincike ta FBI za ta duba kagen a kan wanda aka ba da sunan nasa a mako mai zuwa, wanda ‘yan tsiraru jam’iyyar Democrat suke ta fata.

rows.source: Flake was convinced in part by conversations with his friend, Democratic Sen. Chris Coons.
rows.output: Flake ya yi imani, a wani bangare, da tattaunawa da abokinsa, Sanatan Dimokuraɗiya Chris Coons.
rows.reference: Flake ya gamsu ɗan kaɗa da hirarraki tare da abokinsa, Sanatan jam’iyyar Democrat Chris Coons.

rows.source: After a conversation with Coons and several senators afterwards, Flake made his decision.
rows.output: Bayan tattaunawa da Coons da wasu Sanatoci da dama bayan haka, Flake ya yanke shawarar.
rows.reference: Bayan wata hira tare da Coons da sanatoci masu yawa daga baya, Flake ya yanke hukuncinsa.

rows.source: Flake's choice had power, because it was evident Republicans would not have the votes to approve Kavanaugh without the investigation.
rows.output: Zabin Flake yana da karfi, saboda ya bayyana cewa 'yan Republican ba za su sami kuri'u don a amince da Kavanaugh ba tare da binciken ba.
rows.reference: Zabin Flake yana da ƙarfi, saboda a bayyane yake ‘yan jam’iyyar Republican ba za su sami kuri’u don yarda da Kavanaugh ba tare da bincike ba.

rows.source: President Trump has opened an FBI investigation into the allegations against Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Shugaba Trump ya bude bincike na FBI kan zargin da ake yi wa Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Shugaba Trump ya buɗe wani binciken FBI game da ƙage a kan Kavanaugh ɗin.

rows.source: British PM May accuses critics of 'playing politics' over Brexit
rows.output: Firaminisar Birtaniya May ta zargi masu sukar ta da "yin siyasa" game da Brexit.
rows.reference: Firaministan Birtaniyya May ta kushe masu suka a kan Brexit da ‘yin siyasa’

rows.source: Prime Minister Theresa May accused critics of her plans to leave the European Union of "playing politics" with Britain's future and undermining the national interest in an interview with the Sunday Times newspaper.
rows.output: Firaminista Theresa May ta zargi masu sukar shirin barin Tarayyar Turai da "wasan siyasa" da makomar Birtaniya da kuma lalata muradun kasa a wani hirar da ta yi da jaridar Sunday Times.
rows.reference: Firaminista Theresa May ta soki masu suka na shirye-shiryenta na barin Tarayyar Turai da “maida abin siyasa” da makomar Birtaniyya da kuma zagon ƙasa ga abin da ƙasa ke sha’awa a cikin wata tattaunawa tare da jaridar Sunday Times.

rows.source: Britain's Prime Minister Theresa May arrives for the Conservative Party Conference in Birmingham, Britain, September 29, 2018.
rows.output: Birtaniya ta Fira Minisita Theresa May ta iso taron jam'iyyar Conservative a Birmingham, Birtaniya, 29 ga Satumba, 2018.
rows.reference: Firaministan Birtaniyya Theresa May ta zo Taron Jam’iyyar Conservative a cikin Birmingham, Birtaniyya, a ranar 29 ga Satumba, 2018.

rows.source: In another interview next to the one with her on the newspaper's front page, her former foreign minister Boris Johnson pressed his attack of her so-called Chequers plan for Brexit, saying a proposal that Britain and the EU should collect each other's tariffs was "entirely preposterous."
rows.output: A wani hirar da aka yi a gefen wani da ta yi a shafin farko na jaridu, tsohon ministar harkokin waje Boris Johnson ya ci gaba da kai wa ta hari kan shirin da aka kira Chequers na Brexit, inda ya ce wata shawara da ta nuna cewa Birtaniya da EU za su tara haraji ga juna "ba ta da ma'ana."
rows.reference: A cikin wata tattaunawar a gaba da wadda aka yi da ita a kan shafin gaba na jaridar, tsohon ministanta kan harkokin ƙasashen waje Boris Johnson ya tirjewa a kan harinsa na shirin Chequers ɗin nata don Brexit, yana cewa wani ƙudurin da ke cewa ya kamata Birtaniyya da Tarayyar Turai su karɓi kuɗaɗen fito na juna ya kasance “gaba ɗaya shirme ne.”

rows.source: Wayde Sims shooting: Police arrest suspect Dyteon Simpson in LSU player's death
rows.output: An kama wanda ake zargin Dyteon Simpson a cikin mutuwar Wayde Sims, dan wasan LSU.
rows.reference: Harbin Wayde Sims ‘Yan sanda sun kama Dyteon Simpson da ake tuhuma a kan kisan ɗan wasan LSU.

rows.source: Police have arrested a suspect in the fatal shooting death of Wayde Sims, a 20-year-old basketball player at LSU.
rows.output: An kama wani da ake zargin kashe Wayde Sims, dan wasan kwallon kwando mai shekara 20 a LSU.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun kama wani da ake tuhuma a cikin mummunan harbi da ya kashe Wayde Sims, wani mai shekaru 20 kuma dan wasan ƙwallon kwando a LSU.

rows.source: Dyteon Simpson, 20, has been arrested and booked into prison on a second-degree murder charge, the Baton Rouge Police Department said.
rows.output: Dyteon Simpson, mai shekaru 20, an kama shi kuma an sanya shi a kurkuku bisa zargin kisan kai na biyu, a cewar Sashen 'Yan sanda na Baton Rouge.
rows.reference: An kama Dyteon Simpson, mai shekaru 20 kuma an kai shi kurkuku a kan wata tuhumar kisa mai mataki na biyu, inji Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sandan Baton Rouge.

rows.source: Officials released video of the confrontation between Sims and Simpson, and police said Sims lost his glasses during the fight.
rows.output: Jami'an sun fitar da bidiyon da ya nuna tsaka-tsaki tsakanin Sims da Simpson, kuma 'yan sanda sun ce Sims ya rasa gilashin sa a lokacin fadan.
rows.reference: Jami’ai sun saki bidiyo na takardamar tsakanin Sims da Simpson, kuma ‘yan sanda sun ce Sims ya rasa gilashinsa a lokacin fadan.

rows.source: Police recovered the glasses from the scene and said they found Simpson's DNA on them, CBS affiliate WAFB reports.
rows.output: An dawo da gilashin daga wurin da aka yi wa lalurar, kuma 'yan sanda sun ce sun sami DNA na Simpson a kan su, a cewar CBS ta WAFB.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun sami gilashin daga wurin da aka aikata laifin inda suka kuma ce sun sami abin halittar DNA na Simpson a kansu, kamar yadda rahoton WAFB mai alaƙa da CBS ya faɗa.

rows.source: After questioning Simpson, police said he admitted to fatally shooting Wayde.
rows.output: Bayan an yi wa Simpson tambayoyi, ‘yan sanda sun ce ya amince da kashe Wayde.
rows.reference: Bayan tambayan Simpson, ‘yan sanda sun ce ya amsa laifi na mummunan harbin Wayde.

rows.source: His bond has been set at $350,000, the Advocate reports.
rows.output: An saita belin sa a kan dala 350,000, a cewar jaridar The Advocate.
rows.reference: An sa kuɗin belinsa a dala 350,000, a cewar rahoton Advocate.

rows.source: The East Baton Rouge Parish Coroner's Office released a preliminary report Friday, saying the cause of death is a gunshot wound to the head into the neck.
rows.output: Ofishin Coroner na East Baton Rouge Parish ya fitar da rahoton farko a ranar Juma'a, yana mai cewa dalilin mutuwar shi ne raunukan bindigar da aka yi a kai da wuyansa.
rows.reference: Ofishin Mai Binciken a kan Musabbabin Kisa na Baton Rouge ta Gabas ya saki wani rahoton farko ranar Jumu’a, yana cewa musabbabin mutuwar wani harbin bindiga ne zuwa ga ka da ya wuce cikin wuya.

rows.source: The department is crediting the Louisiana State Police fugitive task force, the state police crime lab, Southern University police and area citizens in assisting in the investigation leading to the arrest.
rows.output: Sashen ya ba da kima ga rundunar 'yan sanda ta Louisiana, ƙungiyar gurfanar da masu gudun hijira ta jihar, dakin bincike na 'yan sanda na jihar, jami'ar kudu maso yamma, da 'yan kasuwa na yankin da suka taimaka wajen binciken da ya kai ga kama.
rows.reference: Ma’aikatar ta yabi jami’an ‘yan sanda na Jihar Louisiana masu aikin kama wanda ya gudu, da ɗakin ‘yan sanda na gwajin kimiyyar aikata lafi na jihar, da ‘yan sandan Jami’ar Kudanci da mazauna yanki don taimakawa a binciken da ya kai ga kamen.

rows.source: LSU athletic director Joe Alleva thanked area law enforcement for its "diligence and pursuit of justice."
rows.output: Jami'in wasanni na LSU Joe Alleva ya yaba wa hukumar tsaro ta yankin bisa "dokar ta yi aiki da kuma bin diddigin adalci."
rows.reference: Daraktan wasan tsalle-tsalle na LSU Joe Alleva ya gode wa ma’aikatan doka na yankin don irin aikinsu na “jajircewa da ganin an yi adalci.”

rows.source: Sims was 20 years old.
rows.output: Sims yana da shekaru ashirin.
rows.reference: Shekarun Sims 20 ne.

rows.source: The 6-foot-6 forward grew up in Baton Rouge, where his father, Wayne, also played basketball for LSU.
rows.output: Baya na ƙafa 6-6 ya girma a Baton Rouge, inda mahaifinsa, Wayne, ya buga ƙwallon kwando ma don LSU.
rows.reference: Mai tsawon tattaki 6 da 6 ya girma ne a cikin Baton Rouge, inda mahaifinsa, Wayne, shi ma ya buga wasan ƙwallon kwando ga LSU.

rows.source: He averaged 5.6 points and 2.6 rebounds a game last season.
rows.output: Ya yi maki 5.6 da 2.6 a kowane wasan a kakar da ta gabata.
rows.reference: Yana da matsakaicin maki 5.6 da sake dawo da ƙididdigar ci na 2.6 a wani na lokacin da shuɗe.

rows.source: On Friday morning, LSU basketball coach Will Wade said the team is "devastated" and "in shock" by Wayde's death.
rows.output: A ranar Juma'a, mai horar da kwallon kwando na LSU, Will Wade, ya ce ƙungiyar ta "cikin baƙin ciki" kuma "ta yi mamaki" da mutuwar Wayde.
rows.reference: A ranar Juma’a da safe, mai horar da ‘yan wasan ƙwallon kwandon na LSU Will Wade ya ce ƙungiyar ta sami “tashin hankali” da “girgiza” da mutuwar ta Wayde.

rows.source: "This is what you worry about at all times," Wade said.
rows.output: "Wannnan shine abin da kake damuwa da shi a kowane lokaci," in ji Wade.
rows.reference: “Wannan shi ne abin mutum yake damuwa game da shi a dukkan lokaci,” inji Wade.

rows.source: Volcano spews ash on Mexico City
rows.output: Wuta ta harbe da toka a birnin Mexico
rows.reference: Babban dutsi mai amon wuta ya fesa toka a kan Birnin Mexico

rows.source: Ash spewing from the Popocatepetl volcano has reached the southern neighborhoods of Mexico's capital.
rows.output: Tsumman da ke fitowa daga Popocatepetl ya kai ga unguwannin kudu na babban birnin Mexico.
rows.reference: Toka da ke fesuwa daga babban dutsi mai amon wuta na Popocatepetl ta isa makwaɓta na kudancin babban birnin Mexico.

rows.source: The National Center for Disaster Prevention warned Mexicans on Saturday to stay away from the volcano after activity picked up in the crater and it registered 183 emissions of gas and ash over 24 hours.
rows.output: Cibiyar Kasa don Hana Bala'i ta yi gargadi ga 'yan Mexico a ranar Asabar da su guji tuntubar tsauni bayan da aka samu karuwar aiki a cikin kogon da kuma samun 183 na iskar gas da toka a cikin sa'o'i 24.
rows.reference: Cibiyar Hana Haɗura ta Ƙasa ta gargaɗi ‘yan Mexico a ranar Asabar kar su kusanci dutsin bayan abin ya kai koli a farfashewar inda kuma a ka yi rijistar fitar da hayaƙi na iskar gas 183 da kuma toka ta fiye da sa’o’i 24.

rows.source: The center was monitoring multiple rumblings and tremors.
rows.output: Cibiyar tana kula da motsin ƙasa da girgizar ƙasa da yawa.
rows.reference: Cibiyar tana kula da cidodi da girgize-girgizen ƙasa.

rows.source: Images on social media showed thin layers of ash coating car windshields in neighborhoods of Mexico City such as Xochimilco.
rows.output: Hotunan da ke kan kafofin watsa labarai sun nuna yadda ƙananan guntun ash ke rufe tagogin motocin a unguwojin birnin Mexico kamar Xochimilco.
rows.reference: Hotuna a hanyar sadarwa ta zumunta sun nuna mashimfiɗu marassa kauri na toka suna danƙare a jikin gilasan mota a cikin makwaɓta na Birnin Mexico kamar su Xochimilco.

rows.source: Geophysicists have noticed an increase in activity at the volcano that sits 45 miles (72 kilometers) southeast of the capital since a 7.1-magnitude earthquake rocked central Mexico in September 2017.
rows.output: An yi hasashen cewa an samu karuwar aikin a cikin tsauni da ke da nisan mil 45 (72 km) kudu maso gabas da babban birnin kasar tun bayan girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.1 da ta afku a tsakiyar kasar a watan Satumba na shekarar 2017.
rows.reference: Masana kimiyyar yanayi sun lura da wani karin aiki a dutsin da ke zaune a mil 45 (kilomita 72) kudu-maso-gabas na babban birnin tun daga wata girgizar kasa da aka yi mai girman 7.1 da ta raguza tsakiyar Mexico a Satumba 2017.

rows.source: The volcano known as "Don Goyo" has been active since 1994.
rows.output: Tsaunin da ake kira "Don Goyo" ya kasance mai aiki tun daga 1994.
rows.reference: Dutsi mai amon wutar da ake kira "Don Goyo" ya daɗe yana tashi tun 1994.

rows.source: Police clash with Catalan separatists ahead of independence vote anniversary
rows.output: Rundunar ‘yan sanda sun yi artabu da masu fafutukar ‘yancin kai na Catalan a ranar da ta gabata da bikin yin zabe na ‘yancin kai
rows.reference: ’Yan sanda sun yi arangama da masu neman ɓallewa na Catalan kafin zagayowar bikin neman ‘yanci

rows.source: Six people were arrested in Barcelona on Saturday after pro-independence protesters clashed with riot police, and as thousands joined rival demonstrations to mark the first anniversary of Catalonia's polarizing vote on secession.
rows.output: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan da masu goyon bayan 'yancin kai suka yi artabu da 'yan sanda, yayin da dubunnan mutane suka shiga zangon adawa don tunawa da ranar farko da aka gudanar da zaben raba gardama kan rabuwa da Catalonia.
rows.reference: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan masu zanga-zangar nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi fito-na-fito tare da ‘yan sandan kwantar da tarzoma, kuma kamar yadda dubun-dubata suka shiga zanga-zanga ta adawa da juna don bikin zagayowar ranar kaɗa kuri’a da ta raba Catalonia a kan ɓallewa.

rows.source: A group of masked pro-separatists held back by riot police pelted them with eggs and hurled powder paint, creating dark clouds of dust in streets that would usually be thronged with tourists.
rows.output: Wani gungun masu kare kai na masu goyon bayan 'yanci sun yi wa 'yan sanda masu tsaron jama'a da ƙwanƙwasa da kuma jifa da fenti, wanda ya haifar da duhu mai duhu a kan titi da aka saba da masu yawon bude ido.
rows.reference: Wani gungu masu goyon bayan ɓallewar da suka rufe idanuwansu da ‘yan sanda suka riƙe sun jefe su da koyaye da kuma watsa musu fentin foda, inda suka ƙirƙiri wasu gajimare mai duhu a cikin titunan da yawanci sukan cika maƙil da ‘yan yawon shaƙatawa.

rows.source: Scuffles also broke out later in the day with police using their batons to contain the fighting.
rows.output: An yi artabu da dama a baya baya, inda 'yan sanda suka yi amfani da sanduna wajen sarrafa tarzomar.
rows.reference: Faɗace-faɗace sun ɓarke a ranar daga baya inda ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da kulaƙensu don hana faɗan.

rows.source: Over several hours pro-independence groups chanting "No forgetting, no forgiveness" faced off with unionist protesters shouting, "Long live Spain."
rows.output: A cikin sa'o'i da dama, ƙungiyoyin masu son 'yancin kai suna ihu "Ba za a manta ba, ba za a gafarta ba," sun yi faɗa da masu zanga-zangar masu ra'ayin hadin kai suna ihu, "Rayuwa a Spain."
rows.reference: Har fiye da tsawon sa’o’i masu yawa gungu-gungun masu goyon bayan ɓallewar suna amshi “Babu mantuwa, babu yafiya” sun yi rikici da masu zanga-zanga ‘yan son haɗewa suna ihu, Allah ya ja kwanan Spain.”

rows.source: Fourteen people received treatment for minor injuries received in the protests, local press reported.
rows.output: Mutanu goma sha hudu sun samu magani saboda raunukan da suka samu a yayin zangon, a cewar jaridu na gida.
rows.reference: An yi magani a mutane goma sha huɗu don ƙananan raunuka da suka ji a zanga-zangogi, kamar yadda kafofin watsa labarai na gida suka ba da rahoto.

rows.source: Tensions remain high in the independence-minded region a year after the October 1 referendum deemed illegal by Madrid but celebrated by separatist Catalans.
rows.output: Tashin hankali ya ci gaba da kasancewa a yankin da ke son 'yanci shekara guda bayan ranar 1 ga Oktoba, wanda Madrid ta yi la'akari da shi a matsayin haramun, amma 'yan kasar Catalonia na separatis sun yi bikin.
rows.reference: Har yanzu da tashin hankali sosai a lardin da ya sa ‘yanci a zuciyarsa shekara ɗaya bayan zaɓen raba gardama na 1 ga Oktoba wanda Madrid ke ɗauka ba ya bisa doka amma ‘yan Catalan masu neman ɓallewa ke ta yin murna da shi.

rows.source: Voters chose overwhelmingly to become independent, though turnout was low with those against secession largely boycotting the vote.
rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a sun zabi da yawa su zama masu zaman kansu, duk da haka, an samu ƙarancin fitowarsu, saboda wadanda suka ki rabuwa da su sun ki yin zabe.
rows.reference: Masu jefa kuri’ar sun yi zaɓe sosai inda suka zaɓi ‘yanci kodayake ba a fito sosai ba inda waɗanda ba sa son ɓallewa suka ƙauracewa zaɓen.

rows.source: According to Catalan authorities almost 1000 people were injured last year after police tried to stop the vote going ahead at polling stations across the region in violent clashes.
rows.output: A cikin shekarar da ta gabata, sama da mutane 1000 ne suka samu rauni bayan 'yan sanda sun yi ƙoƙarin hana gudanar da zaben a rumfunan zaɓe a duk yankin, a yayin da ake fama da tashin hankali.
rows.reference: A cewar hukumomin Catalan an aƙalla raunata mutane 1000 ne shekarar da ta wuce bayan ‘yan sanda sun yi ƙoƙarin su tsaida kaɗa kuri’ar da ake yi a wuraren jefa kuri’ar a dukkan faɗin lardin a cikin gumurzun tashin hankali.

rows.source: Pro-independence groups had camped out overnight on Friday to prevent a demonstration in support of the national police.
rows.output: Kungiyar masu son cin gashin kansu sun yi sansani a daren Juma'a don hana zanga-zangar goyon bayan 'yan sanda na kasa.
rows.reference: Gungu-gungu na masu nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi dandazo waje da dare suna goyon baya na ‘yan sandan ƙasa.

rows.source: The demonstration went ahead but was forced to take a different route.
rows.output: An yi zanga-zangar amma an tilasta musu su ɗauki wani hanya daban.
rows.reference: Zanga-zangar ta ci gaba amma an tilasta mata ɗaukan wata hanya daban.

rows.source: Narcis Termes, 68, an electrician attending the separatist protest with his wife said he was no longer hopeful about the prospects of Catalonia gaining independence.
rows.output: Narcis Termes, 68, wani mai aikin lantarki da ke halartar zanga-zangar masu son kai da matarsa, ya ce ya rasa fatarar samun 'yancin kai na Catalonia.
rows.reference: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, wani latirisha da ke halartar zanga-zangar ‘yan neman ɓallewar tare da matarsa ya ce ba ya kuma fatan ganin yiwuwar Catalonia ta sami ‘yanci.

rows.source: "Last year we lived through one of our best moments.
rows.output: "A bara mun rayu ta cikin daya daga cikin mafi kyawun lokutanmu."
rows.reference: “Shekarar da ta wuce mun rayu a cikin ɗaya daga cikin lokacinmu mafi kyau.

rows.source: I watched my parents cry with joy at being able to vote but now we are stuck," he said.
rows.output: Na kalli iyayena suna kuka da farin ciki saboda suna da damar yin zaɓe amma yanzu mun makale," ya ce.
rows.reference: Na kalli iyayena suna kukan murna saboda damar jefa kuri’a amma yanzu mun tsaya ciki,” inji shi.

rows.source: Despite managing a vital if narrow victory in regional elections last December, Catalan pro-independence parties have struggled to retain momentum this year with many of their best known leaders either in self imposed exile or in detention awaiting trial for their role in organizing the referendum and subsequent declaration of independence.
rows.output: Duk da cewa sun yi nasara a zaben yankin a watan Disamba na baya, jam'iyyun 'yanci na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya wajen ci gaba da samun karfin guiwa a wannan shekarar, yayin da yawancin shahuran shugabanninsu ko dai sun yi hijira da kansu ko kuma a tsare su suna jiran shari'a bisa zarginsu da shiryawa da kuma shelar 'yanci.
rows.reference: Duk da gudanar da wata muhimmiyar nasara ko da tsukekkiya ce a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan yankin a Disamba da ta wuce, jam’iyyun da ke goyon bayan ‘yanci na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya don su ci gaba da hazaƙar wannan shekarar tare da yawancin sanannun fitattun shugabanninsu ko dai sun tafi neman mafakar da suka sa kansu ko an kame su suna jiran shari’a don rawarsu da suka taka a cikin shirya zaɓen raba gardamar da furuci na ‘yanci da suka yi daga baya.

rows.source: Joan Puig, a 42-year-old mechanic recording the protest in support of the police on his phone, said the conflict had been stoked by politicians on both sides.
rows.output: Joan Puig, mai shekaru 42 mai aikin gyarawa, wanda ke rubuta zanga-zangar da ke goyon bayan ‘yan sanda a wayarsa, ya ce rikicin ya tsaru ne saboda ‘yan siyasa a bangarorin biyu.
rows.reference: Joan Puig, wani makanike mai shekaru 42 da ke daukan zanga-zanga a cikin goyon baya na ‘yan sanda a kan tarho dinsa, ya ce rikicin ya sami ruruwa ne daga ‘yan siyasa da ke dukkan bangarorin.

rows.source: "It's getting more and more tense," he said.
rows.output: "Ya zama mai tsanani sosai," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Yana ƙara ƙazanta sosai,” inji shi.

rows.source: On Saturday, Oriol Junqueras, one of nine Catalan leaders in pre-trial jail since late last year, announced he would run in European Parliament elections next year.
rows.output: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, ɗaya daga cikin mambobi tara na Catalan da aka tsare tun ƙarshen shekarar da ta gabata, ya sanar da cewa zai tsaya takarar zaben majalisar Turai a shekarar da ke tafe.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, ɗaya daga shugabanni tara na Catalan da ke tsare kafin a fara shari’a tun ƙarshen shekarar da ta wuce, ya sanar cewa zai tsaya zaɓuɓɓukan Majalisar Dokoki ta Turai a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.source: "Standing as a candidate for the European elections is the best way to denounce the regression in democratic values and repression we have seen from the Spanish government," he said.
rows.output: "Tsayuwa a matsayin dan takara a zaben Turai hanya ce mafi kyau ta nuna adawa da raguwar dabi'un dimokuradiyya da kuma zaluncin da gwamnatin Spain ta nuna," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Tsayawa a matsayin wani ɗan takara don zaɓuɓɓukan Turai shi ne hanya mafi kyau ta kin koma baya a kimomin dimokuraɗiyya da zalunci da muka gani daga gwamnatin Spain,” inji shi.

rows.source: Londonderry: Men arrested after house rammed by car
rows.output: Londonderry: An kama mutane bayan an yi wa gidan da mota ta yi kutsawa
rows.reference: Londonderry: An kama masu maza bayan an doka mota a gida

rows.source: Three men, aged 33, 34 and 39, have been arrested after a car was repeatedly rammed into a house in Londonderry.
rows.output: An kama mutane uku, masu shekaru 33, 34, da 39, bayan an yi wa mota hari a wani gida a Londonderry.
rows.reference: An kama wasu maza, masu shekaru 33, 34 da 29, bayan an ta maimaita doka wata ƙaramar mota zuwa cikin wani gida a da ke Londonderry.

rows.source: The incident unfolded in Ballynagard Crescent on Thursday at about 19:30 BST.
rows.output: Lamarin ya faru ne a Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da misalin karfe 19:30 na yamma.
rows.reference: Abin ya faru ne a cikin Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da kusan ƙarfe 19:30 BST.

rows.source: Det Insp Bob Blemmings said damage was caused to the gates and the building itself.
rows.output: Det Insp Bob Blemmings ya ce an lalata ƙofofin kuma ginin da kansa.
rows.reference: Mataimakin Sufeto Bob Blemmings ya ce an lalata ƙofofi da ma gidan kansa.

rows.source: A crossbow may also have been fired at the car at some point.
rows.output: Wani katon bawul na iya harbin motar a wani lokaci.
rows.reference: An kuma harba ƙila kwari da baka a kan ƙaramar motar a wani lokaci.

rows.source: Menga strike gives Livingston 1-0 win over Rangers
rows.output: Menga ya ci wa Livingston 1-0 a kan Rangers
rows.reference: Cin da Menga ya yi ba wa Livingston nasara 1 da 0 a kan Rangers

rows.source: Dolly Menga's first goal for Livingston secured victory
rows.output: Kwallon farko da Dolly Menga ta ci wa Livingston ta tabbatar da nasara
rows.reference: Cin ƙwallon Dolly Menga ya ba wa Livingston samun nasara

rows.source: Promoted Livingston stunned Rangers to consign Steven Gerrard to just his second defeat in 18 games as manager of the Ibrox club.
rows.output: An yi wa Livingston tallafi ya yi wa Rangers mamaki, ya sanya Steven Gerrard ya yi rashin nasara na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 da ya yi a matsayin manajan kulob din Ibrox.
rows.reference: Livingston da aka ƙara wa girma ta ba da mamaki ga Rangers inda ta ajiye Steven Gerrard kawai zuwa ga cinsa da aka yi karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 a matsayinsa na manaja na kulob ɗin Ibrox.

rows.source: Dolly Menga's strike proved to be the difference as Gary Holt's side moved level with Hibernian in second.
rows.output: Kwallon da Dolly Menga ta yi ya nuna cewa ita ce ta bambanta, yayin da Gary Holt ta yi nasara da Hibernian a matsayi na biyu.
rows.reference: Harin da Dolly Menga ya yi ya kasance abin da kawo bambanci saboda ɓangaren Gary Holt ya motsa lebur tare da Hibernian a cikin mataki na biyu.

rows.source: Gerrard's side remain without an away win in the Premiership this season and face leaders Hearts, who they trail by eight points, next Sunday.
rows.output: Kungiyar Gerrard ta ci gaba da rashin nasara a wajen a gasar Premiership a wannan kakar kuma za ta yi da Hearts, wanda ke kan gaba da maki takwas, a ranar Lahadi mai zuwa.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren Gerrard yana nan ba tare da wata nasara da zai ta fi da ita ba a cikin wasan Premiership ɗin wannan lokacin kuma zai fuskanci Leaders Hearts, waɗanda suke bi da digo takwas, Lahadi mai zuwa.

rows.source: Before then, Rangers host Rapid Vienna in the Europa League on Thursday.
rows.output: Kafun nan, Rangers na karbar bakuncin Rapid Vienna a gasar Europa a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: Kafin nan, Rangers sun karɓi Rapid Vienna a cikin wasan Europa League a ranar Alhamis.

rows.source: Livingston, meanwhile, extend their unbeaten run in the division to six games, with head coach Holt still to taste defeat since replacing Kenny Miler last month.
rows.output: A halin yanzu, Livingston ta kara yawan wasanni da ba ta yi rashin nasara a gasar zuwa shida, inda koci Holt bai yi rashin nasara ba tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miler a watan da ya gabata.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake ciki hakan, Livinsgton, sun kara matsayinsu na ba wanda ya doke su a cikin shiyyar zuwa wasanni shida, tare da shugaban horar da wasa Holt har yanzu don ɗanɗana dokewa tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miler wata da ya wuce.

rows.source: Livingston miss chances against blunt visitors
rows.output: Livingston sun rasa damarmaki da masu ziyartar da ba su da kaifi
rows.reference: Livingston sun rasa damammaki a kan maziyartansu da ba su dama

rows.source: Holt's team should have been ahead long before they scored, with their directness causing Rangers all manner of problems.
rows.output: Tawaga ta Holt ya kamata ta kasance a gaba tun da dadewa kafin ta ci, saboda hanyar da ta ke bi ta haifar da matsaloli da dama ga Rangers.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a ce ƙungiyar Holt suna gaba ne kafin su ci, tare da fuskantar tasu wanda ke haifar wa Rangers matsaloli iri-iri.

rows.source: Scott Robinson broke through but dragged his effort across the face of goal, then Alan Lithgow could only direct his effort wide after sliding in to meet Craig Halkett's header across goal.
rows.output: Scott Robinson ya yi nasara, amma ya ja harbin a fuskar kwallon, sannan Alan Lithgow ya iya kai hari kawai bayan ya yi gudu don haduwa da kwallon da Craig Halkett ya yi a cikin raga.
rows.reference: Scott Robinson ya shige ciki amma ya ja ƙoƙarinsa ta gaban fuska ta cin nasara, shi ke nan Alan Lithgow kawai zai iya fuskantar da ƙoƙarinsa bayan yin ƙasa don haɗuwa da bugu da ka na cin Craig Halkett.

rows.source: The hosts were content to let Rangers play in front of them, knowing they could trouble the visitors at set pieces.
rows.output: Masu masaukin baki sun yi farin ciki su bar Rangers su yi wasa a gaban su, suna sane da cewa za su iya damun baƙi a lokacin da za a yi wasa.
rows.reference: Masu saukan bakin sun yarda su bar Rangers su buga wasa a gabansu, suna sane da cewa za su iya wahalar da masu ziyarar a jerin ɗaiɗaiku.

rows.source: And that was the manner in which the crucial goal came.
rows.output: Kuma haka ne aka samu muhimmiyar kwallo.
rows.reference: Kuma wancan shi ne yadda ci mai muhimmancin ya gudana.

rows.source: Rangers conceded a free-kick and Livingston worked an opening, Declan Gallagher and Robinson combining to set up Menga, who took a touch and scored from the centre of the box.
rows.output: Rangers sun yi rashin nasara a bugun daci, kuma Livingston ya yi aiki, Declan Gallagher da Robinson sun haɗa kai don saita Menga, wanda ya ɗauki wani dan lokaci ya ci daga tsakiyar filin.
rows.reference: Rangers sun amince da bugun da ba tarewa kuma Livingston suka yi aiki da wata dama, Declan Gallagher da Robinson suka haɗe suka tsara Menga, wanda ya taɓa da kuma ci daga tsakiya ta akwatin.

rows.source: By that stage, Rangers had dominated possession but had found the home defence impenetrable and goalkeeper Liam Kelly was largely untroubled,
rows.output: A wannan mataki, Rangers sun yi mulki a kan mallaka amma sun sami tsaron gida mai karfi kuma mai tsaron gida Liam Kelly ba a damu da shi sosai.
rows.reference: A wannan mataki, Rangers ta mamaye riƙe ƙwallo amma ta sami tsaron gidan ba zai ba da damar wucewa ba kuma mai kama ƙwallo Liam Kelly kuma gaba ɗaya bai damu ba.

rows.source: That pattern continued into the second half, though Alfredo Morelos did force a save from Kelly.
rows.output: Wannan tsarin ya ci gaba zuwa rabin na biyu, duk da haka Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wa Kelly ya yi tsalle.
rows.reference: Wannan yanayi ya ci gaba har rabi na biyu, kodayake Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wani ceto daga Kelly.

rows.source: Scott Pittman was denied by the feet of Rangers goalkeeper Allan McGregor and Lithgow flicked wide from another Livingston set play.
rows.output: An hana Scott Pittman daga ƙwallon da mai tsaron raga na Rangers Allan McGregor ya yi, kuma an yi wa Lithgow kwalliyar daga wani wasan da aka yi wa Livingston.
rows.reference: Scott Pittman bai samu dama ba daga ƙafa ta mai kama ƙwallo na Rangers Allan McGregor kuma Lithgow ya buɗa sosai daga wani wasan da Livingston ya tsara.

rows.source: Crosses continually came into the Livingston box and were continually cleared, while two penalty claims - after Halkett's challenge on substitute Glenn Middleton, and one for handball - were waved away.
rows.output: Kwallayen suna ci gaba da shiga cikin akwatin Livingston kuma ana ci gaba da share su, yayin da aka yi ikirarin biyu na bugu - bayan kalubalen Halkett kan mai maye gurbin Glenn Middleton, da kuma daya don hannu - an yi watsi da su.
rows.reference: Sai kuma bugu ta ko’ina da suka riƙa zuwa cikin akwatin Livingston inda kuma a ci gaba da maganinsu, a yayin da aka samu bugu daga kai sai gola - bayan ƙalubalantar Halkett a kan maye gurbin Glenn Middleton, kuma ɗaya don taɓawa da hannu - inda aka ture gefe.

rows.source: 'Phenomenal' from Livingston - analysis
rows.output: 'Phenomenal' daga Livingston - nazari
rows.reference: ‘Abin mamaki’ daga Livingston - nazari

rows.source: BBC Scotland's Alasdair Lamont at the Tony Macaroni Arena
rows.output: BBC Scotland's Alasdair Lamont a filin wasa na Tony Macaroni
rows.reference: Alasdair Lamont Scotland a Yanki na Tony Macaroni

rows.source: A phenomenal performance and result for Livingston.
rows.output: Wani wasan da ya yi ban mamaki kuma sakamakon da ya samu ga Livingston.
rows.reference: Wani wasa mai ban mamaki da sakamako don Livingston.

rows.source: To a man, they were excellent, continuing to exceed expectations on this upward trajectory.
rows.output: Ga kowa, sun kasance masu kyau, suna ci gaba da wuce tsammanin a kan wannan hanyar hawainiya.
rows.reference: Ga wani mutum, sun burge sosai, suna ci gaba da wuce abin da ake tsammani a kan wannan abin da ya yi saman.

rows.source: Their style of play and personnel has scarcely changed since their return to the top flight, but great credit has to go to Holt for the way he has galvanised the team since his arrival.
rows.output: Salon wasan su da kuma 'yan wasan ba su canzawa sosai tun bayan dawo da su zuwa gasar farko ba, amma babban yabo ya kamata a ba Holt saboda yadda ya ƙarfafa ƙungiyar tun lokacin da ya iso.
rows.reference: Irin salonsu na wasa da ma’aikata ya dan canza tun da dawowarsu zuwa saman matsayi, amma babban yabo ya kamata ya je ne ga Holt da irin hanyar da ya haɗa ƙungiyar tun zuwansa.

rows.source: He had so many heroes.
rows.output: Ya yi wa mutane da yawa jarumta.
rows.reference: Yana da gwarzaye da yawa.

rows.source: Captain Halkett was immense, marshalling a superbly-organised defence, while Menga kept Connor Goldson and Joe Worrall on their toes throughout.
rows.output: Kyaftin Halkett ya kasance mai girma, yana jagorantar wani tsaron da ya yi kyau, yayin da Menga ya ci gaba da Connor Goldson da Joe Worrall a duk lokacin.
rows.reference: Kyaftin Halkett ya shirya, inda ya yi ta tsara wani tsaro mai kyau, a lokacin da Menga ya sa Connor Goldson da Joe Worrall suka kasance a kan ƙafafunsu gaba ɗaya.

rows.source: Rangers were short of inspiration, though.
rows.output: Rangers sun yi rashin wahayi, duk da haka.
rows.reference: Rangers sun kusan rasa ƙarfin gwiwa, kusan.

rows.source: As good as they have been at times under Gerrard, they fell well short of those standards.
rows.output: A matsayinta na mai kyau kamar yadda suka kasance a wasu lokuta a karkashin jagorancinsa, sun yi kasa da ma'aunin da suka kafa.
rows.reference: Duk da irin yadda suke da kyau a lokutan a ƙarƙashin Gerrard, sun gaza samun irin wadannan daidaituwar.

rows.source: Their final ball was lacking - only once did they cut the home side open - and it is something of a wake-up call for Rangers, who find themselves in mid-table.
rows.output: Kwallonsa na ƙarshe ya yi rashin nasara - kawai sau ɗaya suka yi rauni a gefen gida - kuma hakan wani gargaɗi ne ga Rangers, waɗanda suke cikin matsayi na tsakiya.
rows.reference: Ƙwallonsu ta ƙarshe ba ta isa ba - kawai sau ɗaya ne suka yanke gefen gidan a buɗe - kuma wani abu ne na wartsakarwar kira ga Rangers, waɗanda suka sami kansu a cikin tsakiyar teburi.

rows.source: Erdogan get mixed reception in Cologne
rows.output: An yi wa Erdogan maraba da raha a Cologne
rows.reference: Erdogan ya sami wata irin karɓa a Cologne

rows.source: There were smiles and blue skies on Saturday (September 29) as the leaders of Turkey and Germany met for breakast in Berlin.
rows.output: An yi murmushi da sararin sama a ranar Asabar (29 ga Satumba) yayin da shugabannin Turkiyya da Jamus suka gana don karin kumallo a Berlin.
rows.reference: An ga murmurshi iri-iri da shuɗin sararin samaniya a ranar Asabar (29 ga Satumba) inda shugabannin Turkiyya da Jamus suka haɗu don cin kumallon safe a cikin Berlin.

rows.source: It's the last day of President Erdogan's controversial visit to Germany - which is aimed at repairing relations beteen the NATO allies.
rows.output: Yau ne ranar karshe ta ziyartar shugaban kasar Erdogan mai jayayya a Jamus, wadda ke da nufin gyara dangantakar da ke tsakanin abokan tarayya na NATO.
rows.reference: A cikin ranarta ta ƙarshen ziyarar Shugaba Erdogan mai rikitarwa zuwa Jamus - wanda aka tsara don gyara hulɗoɗi tsakanin ƙawayen NATO din.

rows.source: They've fallen out over issues including human rights, press freedom and Turkey's accession to the EU.
rows.output: Sun yi rikici a kan batutuwa da suka haɗa da 'yancin ɗan adam, 'yancin 'yan jarida, da kuma shiga Turkiyya cikin Tarayyar Turai.
rows.reference: Sun sami rashin jituwa a kan wasu batutuwa da suka haɗa da ‘yancin ɗan Adam, ‘yancin ‘yan jarida da shigar Turkiyyar zuwa Tarayyar Turai.

rows.source: Erdogan then headed for Cologne to open a giant new mosque.
rows.output: Erdogan ya ci gaba da tafiya zuwa Cologne don bude wani babban masjid.
rows.reference: Erdogan daga nan ya wuce Cologne don buɗe wani ƙaton sabon masallaci.

rows.source: The city is home to the largest Turkish population outside Turkey.
rows.output: Birnin yana da mafi yawan al'ummar Turkiyya a waje da Turkiyya.
rows.reference: Birnin gida ne ga mutanen Turkiyya da suka fi yawa a wajen Turkiyyar.

rows.source: Police cited security reasons to block a 25,000-strong crowd from gathering in front of the mosque, but plenty of supporters turned out nearby to see their president.
rows.output: Jami'an 'yan sanda sun yi amfani da dalilin tsaro wajen hana taruwar mutane 25,000 a gaban masallacin, amma akwai masu goyon baya da yawa da suka taru kusa don ganin shugaban su.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun kawo maganar dalilan tsaro don toshe wani dandazon jama’a na kusan 25,000 daga taro da ke gaban masallacin, amma masu goyon baya da yawa sun bayyana a kusa don ganin shugaban nasu.

rows.source: Hundreds of anti-Erdogan protesters - many of them Kurdish - also made their voices heard, condemning both Erdogan's policies and the German government's decision to welcome him to the country.
rows.output: Dubban masu adawa da Erdogan - da yawa daga cikinsu 'yan kabilar Kurdi - suma sun yi kira, suna suka da manufofin Erdogan da kuma shawarar gwamnatin Jamus ta karba shi a kasar.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwan masu zanga-zanga da ke adawa da Erdogan - mafi yawansu Kurɗawa - sun bayyana muryoyinsu, suna Allah-wa-dai gaba ɗaya da ƙudurorin Erdogan da hukuncin da gwamnatin Jamus ta yanke ɗin na maraba da shi zuwa ƙasar.

rows.source: The dueling protests reflect the divisiveness of a visitor hailed as a hero by some German Turks and reviled as an autocrat by others.
rows.output: Taron zanga-zangar da ke nuna rarrabuwar kawuna na wani baƙo da wasu 'yan ƙasar Jamusawa ke ganin jarumi ne kuma wasu kuma suna ganin shi ne mai mulkin kama-karya.
rows.reference: Zanga-zangogin na wurin suna nuna fasalin rabuwa na zuwan wani maziyarci da Turkawan Jamus ke yaba a matsayin wani gwarzo da kuma tsana a matsayin mai-kama-karya ga sauran.

rows.source: Deptford road crash: Cyclist dies in collision with car
rows.output: Hanya ta Deptford: Mai tuka keken ya mutu a cikin hatsarin da ya yi da motar
rows.reference: Haɗarin hanya na Deptford : Matukin keke ya mutu a sanadin karo da mota

rows.source: A cyclist has died in a collision involving a car in London.
rows.output: Wani mai tuka keken ya mutu a wani hatsari da ya shafi mota a birnin Landan.
rows.reference: Wani matuƙin keke ya mutu a cikin wani karo da ya haɗa da wata ƙaramar mota a cikin Landan.

rows.source: The crash happened near the junction of Bestwood Street and Evelyn Street, a busy road in Deptford, in the south-east of the city, at about 10:15 BST.
rows.output: An yi hatsari kusa da kusurwar titunan Bestwood da Evelyn, wani wuri mai cike da jama'a a Deptford, a kudu maso gabashin birnin, da misalin karfe 10:15 na safe.
rows.reference: Karon ya faru ne kusa da mahaɗar Titin Bestwood da Titin  Evelyn, wata hanya mai cunkoso a cikin Deptford, a cikin kudu-maso-gabas na birnin, da kusan ƙarfe 10:15 BST.

rows.source: The driver of the car stopped and paramedics attended, but the man died at the scene.
rows.output: Direban motar ya tsaya ya kuma yi aiki da ma’aikatan jinya, amma mutumin ya mutu a wurin.
rows.reference: Direban motar ya tsaya kuma ma’aikatan kawo ɗaukin jinya sun zo, amma mutumin ya mutu a wurin da abin ya faru.

rows.source: The crash comes months after another cyclist died in a hit-and-run on Childers Street, about a mile away from Saturday's crash.
rows.output: An yi hatsari watanni bayan wani mai tuka keken ya mutu a wani hatsari da wani direba ya yi a kan titin Childers, kimanin mil daya daga wurin da aka yi hatsari a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Karon ya faru ne watanni bayan wani matuƙin keken ya mutu a cikin wani haɗarin kaɗi-a-gudu a kan Titin Childers, kusan wani mil guda daga wurin karon na ranar Asabar.

rows.source: The Metropolitan Police said officers were working to identify the man and inform his next-of-kin.
rows.output: Rundunar ‘yan sanda ta ce ‘yan sanda suna aiki don gano mutumin da kuma sanar da ‘yan uwan ​​sa.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sandan Birni sun ce jami’ai suna aiki don gane mutumin da sanar da danginsa.

rows.source: Road closures and bus diversions are in place and motorists have been advised to avoid the area.
rows.output: An rufe hanyoyin mota kuma an sake su, kuma an shawartar masu mota da su guji wannan yanki.
rows.reference: An rufe hanyoyi da sauya hanyar bas kuma an ba da shawara ga matukan motoci su guje wa yankin.

rows.source: Long Lartin prison: Six officers hurt in disorder
rows.output: Gidan yari na Long Lartin: An ji rauni ga jami'ai shida a cikin rashin zaman lafiya
rows.reference: Kurkukun Long Lartin:  Jami’ai shida sun ji rauni a rikici

rows.source: Six prison officers have been injured in a disturbance at a high security men's jail, the Prison Office has said.
rows.output: An samu raunuka shida a cikin tashin hankali a gidan yari mai tsauri ga maza, a cewar ofishin gidan yari.
rows.reference: An ji rauni a jami’ai shida a cikin tashin hankali a wani kurkukun maza mai tsaro sosai, inji Ofishin Kurkukun.

rows.source: Disorder broke out at HMP Long Lartin in Worcestershire at about 09:30 BST on Sunday and is ongoing.
rows.output: An yi tarzoma a HMP Long Lartin a Worcestershire da misalin karfe 9:30 na safiyar Lahadi kuma har yanzu tana ci gaba.
rows.reference: Tashin hankalin ya ɓarke ne a HMP Long Lartin a cikin Worcestershire da kusan ƙarfe 09:30 BST a ranar Lahadi kuma yana ci gaba.

rows.source: Specialist "Tornado" officers have been brought in to deal with the disturbance, which involves eight inmates and is contained to one wing.
rows.output: Jami'an "Tornado" na musamman an kai su ne domin magance tashin hankali, wanda ya shafi fursunoni takwas kuma an takaita shi ga wani reshe.
rows.reference: An kawo ƙwararrun jami’an "Tornado" don su magance tashin hankalin, wanda ya ƙunshi fursunoni takwas kuma an taƙaita shi zuwa ga ɓangare ɗaya.

rows.source: The officers were treated for minor facial injuries at the scene.
rows.output: Jami'an sun samu magani kan raunukan fuska a wurin.
rows.reference: An yi magani ga jami’an don raunukan fuska a wurin da abin ya faru.

rows.source: A Prison Service spokesperson said: "Specially trained prison staff have been deployed to deal with an ongoing incident at HMP Long Lartin.
rows.output: Wani mai magana da yawun Sabis na kurkuku ya ce: "Ma'aikatan kurkuku da aka horar da su musamman sun turo domin magance wani lamari da ke ci gaba a HMP Long Lart.
rows.reference: A cewar mai magana da yawun Ma’aikatar Kurkuku: “An tura ƙwararrun ma’aikatan da aka horar don magance wani abin da ke faruwa a HMP Long Lartin.

rows.source: Six members of staff have been treated for injuries.
rows.output: Mambobi shida na ma'aikatan sun sami magani saboda raunuka.
rows.reference: An yi magani a mambobi na ma’aikatan shida don raunuka da suka samu.

rows.source: We do not tolerate violence in our prisons, and are clear that those responsible will be referred to the police and could spend longer behind bars."
rows.output: Ba mu yarda da tashin hankali a kurkuku ba, kuma mun bayyana cewa wadanda ke da alhakin hakan za a tura su ga ‘yan sanda kuma za su iya ci gaba da zama a kurkuku.
rows.reference: Ba ma zuba ido ga tashin hankali a cikin kurkukunmu, kuma sun bayyana cewa za a tura waɗanda ke da hannu kuma akwai yiwuwar su jima a bayan kantoci.”

rows.source: HMP Long Lartin holds more than 500 prisoners, including some of the country's most dangerous offenders.
rows.output: HMP Long Lartin tana riƙe da fiye da 500 fursunoni, ciki har da wasu daga cikin masu laifi mafi hatsari a ƙasar.
rows.reference: HMP Long Lartin ɗin yana riƙe da fiye da fursunoni 500, da suka haɗa da wasu daga cikin masu laifi mafiya haɗari na ƙasar.

rows.source: In June it was reported that the prison's governor received hospital treatment after being attacked by a prisoner.
rows.output: A watan Yuni ne aka ruwaito cewa gwamnan gidan yari ya samu kulawar asibiti bayan an kai masa hari da wani fursuna.
rows.reference: A cikin watan Yuni an kawo rahoto cewa gwamnan kurkukun ya karɓi kulawar asibiti bayan wani fursuna ya kai masa hari.

rows.source: And in October last year riot officers were called to the prison to deal with a serious disturbance in which staff were attacked with pool balls.
rows.output: Kuma a watan Oktoba na shekarar da ta gabata, an kira jami'an tsaron jama'a zuwa gidan yari domin su magance wani rikici mai tsanani inda ma'aikatan suka kai wa 'yan sanda hari da kwallayen tafki.
rows.reference: Kuma a cikin watan Oktoba na shekarar da ta wuce jami’an kwantar da tarzoma sun magance wani mummunan tashin hankali inda aka farma hari a kan ma’aikata da ƙwallayen wasa.

rows.source: Hurricane Rosa Threatening Phoenix, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City With Flash Flooding (Drought Areas May Benefit)
rows.output: Guguwar Rosa tana barazanar Phoenix, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City da ambaliya (yankunan fari na iya amfana)
rows.reference: Babbar Guguwar Rosa Tana Barazana a Phoenix, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City Da Ambaliyar Ruwa Mai Tasowa (Yankuna Masu Fari Za Su Ƙila More)

rows.source: It's rare for a tropical depression to hit Arizona, but that's exactly what's likely to happen early happen early next week as Hurricane Rosa's remaining energy tracks across the Desert Southwest, delivering flash flooding risks.
rows.output: Ba a saba da fari mai zafi ya afka Arizona ba, amma wannan shi ne abin da zai iya faruwa da wuri da wuri a mako mai zuwa yayin da ragowar karfin guguwar Rosa ta bi ta cikin yankin Hamadar Kudu maso Yamma, tare da kawo hadurran ambaliya.
rows.reference: Bai cika faruwa a ce wani raguwar zafi ya tasamma Arizona ba, amma wannan shi ne abin da ƙila ya faru da wuri mako mai zuwa kamar yadda sauran ƙarfin Guguwar Rosan ke bin diddigi a faɗin Hamadar Kudu-maso-gabas, inda take samar da haɗuran ambaliyar ruwa mai tasowa.

rows.source: The National Weather Service has already issued flash flood watches for Monday and Tuesday for western Arizona into southern and eastern Nevada, southeastern California and Utah, including the cities of Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, and Salt Lake City.
rows.output: Sabis na Yanayi na Kasa ya riga ya fitar da gargadi kan ambaliya ga Litinin da Talata ga yammacin Arizona zuwa kudu da gabas na Nevada, kudu maso gabashin California da Utah, ciki har da biranen Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, da Salt Lake City.
rows.reference: Ma’aikatar Hasashen Yanayi ta Ƙasa ta riga ta fitar da bayanan kallo game da ambaliyar mai tasowa ta Litinin da Talata don Arizona a cikin kudanci da gabashin Nevada, kudu-maso-gabas na California da Utah, da ya haɗa da birane na  Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, da Salt Lake City.

rows.source: Rosa is expected to take a direct path over Phoenix on Tuesday, approaching late Monday with rain.
rows.output: Ana sa ran Rosa za ta bi hanya kai tsaye a kan Phoenix a ranar Talata, tare da kusancin ranar Litinin da ruwan sama.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin Rosa ɗin za ta ɗauki wata hanya ta saman Phoenix a ranar Talata, tana turawa zuwa ƙarshen Litinin tare da ruwan sama.

rows.source: The National Weather Service in Phoenix noted in a tweet that only "ten tropical cyclones have maintained tropical storm or depression status within 200 miles of Phoenix since 1950!
rows.output: Sabis na Yanayi na Kasa a Phoenix ya lura a wani tweet cewa kawai "guguwar ruwa goma sun kula da matsayin guguwar ruwa ko matsugunni a cikin mil 200 na Phoenix tun daga 1950!
rows.reference: Ma’aikatar Hasashen Yanayi ta Ƙasa da ke cikin Phoenix ta lura a cikin wani bayani da ta fitar ta Twitter cewa kawai “Munanan haɗarin iska guda goma sun samar da cidar lokacin zafi ko matsayin raguwa tsakanin mil 200 na Phoenix  tun daga shekarun 1950!

rows.source: Katrina (1967) was a hurricane within 40 miles of the AZ border."
rows.output: Katrina (1967) ta kasance gobarar da ta kasance cikin mil 40 daga iyakar AZ.
rows.reference: Katrina (1967) da wata guguwa ce tsakanin mil 40 na iyakar Arizona.”

rows.source: The latest National Hurricane Center models predict 2 to 4 inches of rainfall, with isolated amounts up to 6 inches in the Mogollon Rim of Arizona.
rows.output: Sabbin samfuran Cibiyar Hurricane ta Kasa sun yi hasashen ruwan sama na inci 2 zuwa 4, tare da adadin da ba a iya gani ba har zuwa inci 6 a gefen Mogollon Rim na Arizona.
rows.reference: Samfurorin Cibiyar Guguwar Iska ta Ƙasa mafi sabunta sun yi kintacen incina 2 zuwa 4 na ruwan sama, tare da ‘yan incina har kusan 6 da ba sa ciki a cikin Mogollon Rim na Arizona.

rows.source: Other areas of the Desert Southwest including the central Rockies and the Great Basin are likely to get 1 to 2 inches, with isolated totals up to 4 inches possible.
rows.output: Sauran yankuna na yankin Hamadar Kudu da suka haɗa da tsakiyar Rockies da Babban Basin na iya samun inci 1 zuwa 2, tare da jimlar da za ta kai inci 4.
rows.reference: Sauran yankunan na Desert Southwest da suka hada da tsakiyar Rockies da Great Basin ba mamaki su sami incina 1 zuwa 2 tare da jimillar da ba ta ciki har kusan incina 4 da zai yiwu.

rows.source: For those out of flash flood risk, Rosa's rain may be a blessing since the region is drought-stricken.
rows.output: Ga waɗanda ba su cikin haɗarin ambaliya, ruwan Rosa na iya zama albarka tun da yankin yana fama da fari.
rows.reference: Ga waɗanda ba sa cikin haɗarin ambaliyar mai tasowar, ruwan saman na Rosa ɗin ƙila ya zama wata rahama tun da yankin yana fama da fari.

rows.source: Although flooding is a very serious concern, some of this rainfall will likely be beneficial since the Southwest is currently experiencing drought conditions.
rows.output: Duk da cewa ambaliya babbar matsala ce, wasu daga cikin wannan ruwan sama za su yi amfani da su saboda kudu maso yammacin kasar na fama da fari.
rows.reference: Kodayake ambaliyar ruwa wani abin damuwa ne sosai, wani daga cikin wannan ruwan saman zai fa’idantar tun da Kudu-maso-yamma a yanzu yana ganin yanayi na fari.

rows.source: According to the U.S. Drought Monitor, just over 40 percent of Arizona is experiencing at least extreme drought, the second highest category," weather.com reported.
rows.output: Bisa ga U.S. Drought Monitor, sama da kashi 40 na Arizona na fuskantar aƙalla matsanancin fari, mafi girman nau'in," weather.com ya ba da rahoton.
rows.reference: A cewar Hukumar Kula da Fari ta Amurka, kawai sama da kashi 40 cikin ɗari ne na Arizona ke ganin aƙalla matsanancin fari, nau’i mafi girma na biyu,” inji rahoto na weather.com.

rows.source: First, Hurricane Rosa's path leads to landfall across the Baja California peninsula of Mexico.
rows.output: Da farko, hanyar guguwar Rosa tana haifar da ta sauka a gabar tekun Baja California na Mexico.
rows.reference: Da farko, hanyar Guguwar Rosa ta wuce ne zuwa faɗuwa a ƙasa ta cikin zirin Baja California na Mexico.

rows.source: Rosa, still at hurricane strength Sunday morning with maximum winds of 85 miles per hour, is 385 miles south of Punta Eugenia, Mexico and moving north at 12 miles per hour.
rows.output: Rosa, har yanzu tana da ƙarfi a ranar Lahadi tare da iskar da ta kai mil 85 a sa'a, tana da nisan mil 385 kudu da Punta Eugenia, Mexico kuma tana tafiya arewa a mil 12 a sa'a.
rows.reference: Rosa, har yanzu tana da ƙarfin ba babbar iskar guguwa da safiyar Lahadi tare da gayar iskoki na mil 85 a kowace sa’a, shi ne mil 385 kudu da Punta Eugenia, Mexico kuma tana matsawa a mil 12 kowace sa’a.

rows.source: The storm is encountering cooler waters in the Pacific and therefore powering down.
rows.output: Guguwar tana fuskantar ruwa mai sanyi a cikin Tekun Pasifik kuma saboda haka tana rage ƙarfin ta.
rows.reference: Cidar tana haɗuwa da ruwa mai sanyi a cikin tekun Pacific don haka tana sauka.

rows.source: Thus, it's expected to make landfall in Mexico at tropical storm strength in the afternoon or evening on Monday.
rows.output: Don haka, ana sa ran za a yi ta a bakin teku a Mexico a matsayin guguwar ruwa a cikin yamma ko dare a ranar Litinin.
rows.reference: A saboda haka, ana tsammani za ta sauka a ƙasa a cikin Mexico a ƙarfin cidar lokacin zafi da cikin rana ko yamma a ranar Litinin.

rows.source: Rainfall across portions of Mexico could be heavy, posing a significant flooding risk.
rows.output: Ruwan sama a wasu sassan Mexico na iya zama mai nauyi, wanda ke haifar da babban haɗari na ambaliya.
rows.reference: Ba mamaki ruwan sama a faɗin sassa na Mexico ya zama da yawa, yana mai haifar da wani haɗarin ambaliya mai yawa.

rows.source: "Rainfall totals of 3 to 6 inches are expected from Baja California into northwestern Sonora, with up to 10 inches possible," weather.com reported.
rows.output: "Ana sa ran ruwan sama na inci 3 zuwa 6 a cikin Baja California zuwa arewa maso yammacin Sonora, tare da har zuwa inci 10 mai yiwuwa," weather.com ya ruwaito.
rows.reference: “Ana tsammanin jimillar ruwan sama na incina 3 zuwa 6 daga Baja California zuwa cikin kudu-maso-yammacin Sonora,” a cewar rahoton weather.com.

rows.source: Rosa will then track north across Mexico as a tropical storm before reaching the Arizona border in the early morning hours Tuesday as a tropical depression, which will then track up through Arizona and into southern Utah by late Tuesday night.
rows.output: Rosa za ta bi arewa a cikin Mexico a matsayin guguwar ruwa kafin ta isa kan iyakar Arizona da safe a ranar Talata a matsayin gurguwar ruwa, wanda daga baya za ta bi ta Arizona da zuwa kudu maso yammacin Utah da dare a ranar Talata.
rows.reference: Daga nan Rosa za ta bi arewa ta faɗin Mexico a matsayin cidar iskar zafi kafin isa iyakar Arizona a cikin farkon sa’o’in safiyar Talata a matsayin raguwar lokacin zafi, inda daga nan za ta bi sama ta cikin Arizona da kuma zuwa cikin kudancin Itah da ƙarshen Talata da dare.

rows.source: "The main hazard expected from Rosa or its remnants is very heavy rainfall in Baja California, northwestern Sonora, and the U.S. Desert Southwest," the National Hurricane Center said.
rows.output: "Babban haɗari da ake sa ran daga Rosa ko ragowar sa shi ne ruwan sama mai yawa a Baja California, arewa maso yammacin Sonora, da kuma yankin hamin kashewar Amurka," Cibiyar Kula da Guguwar Ruwa ta kasa ta ce.
rows.reference: “Babban haɗari da ake tsammani daga Rosa ko abubuwanta da za su saura shi ne ruwan sama sosai a cikin Baja California, arewa-maso-yammacin Sonora, da Amurka Desert Southwest," inji Cibiyar Iskar Guguwa ta Ƙasa.

rows.source: These rains are expected to produce life-threatening flash flooding and debris flows in the deserts, and landslides in mountainous terrain.
rows.output: Ana sa ran waɗannan ruwan sama za su haifar da ambaliya mai haɗari ga rayuwa da kuma guntun duwatsu a cikin hamadobin, da kuma ambaliya a cikin tsaunuka masu tsayi.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin wannan ruwayen su samar da ambaliyar ruwan sama mai tasowa da zubar burbushi a cikin hamada, da yankewar ƙasa a cikin yankunan tsaunuka.

rows.source: Midsomer Norton attack: Four attempted murder arrests
rows.output: An kama mutane hudu da laifin yunƙurin kisan kai a Midsomer Norton
rows.reference: Harin Midsomer Norton:  Kame mutane huɗu da suka yi ƙoƙarin kisa

rows.source: Three teenage boys and a 20-year-old man have been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after a 16-year-old was found with stab wounds in Somerset.
rows.output: An kama wasu yara maza uku da suka kai shekara 17 da namijin da ya kai shekaru 20 bisa zargin yunƙurin kisan kai bayan an samu wani yaro mai shekara 16 da raunuka a Somerset.
rows.reference: An kame wasu yara su uku da wani mutum mai shekaru 20 a kan zargin ƙoƙarin yin kisa bayan an sami wani mai shekaru 16 da raunukan caka wuka a cikin Somerset.

rows.source: The teenage boy was found injured in the Excelsior Terrace area of Midsomer Norton, at about 04:00 BST on Saturday.
rows.output: Wani matashi ya samu rauni a yankin Excelsior Terrace na Midsomer Norton, da misalin karfe 04:00 na safe ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An sami yaron ne da raunin a cikin yankin Farfajiyar Excelsior na Midsomer Norton, da kusan ƙarfe 04:00 BST na ranar Asabar.

rows.source: He was taken to hospital where he remains in a "stable" condition.
rows.output: An kai shi asibitin da yake cikin "matsayi mai kyau".
rows.reference: An ɗauke zuwa asibiti inda yake cikin wani yanayi “mai ƙarko.”

rows.source: A 17-year-old, two 18-year-olds and a 20-year-old man were arrested overnight in the Radstock area, Avon and Somerset Police said.
rows.output: Wani mutum mai shekaru 17, mutane biyu masu shekaru 18, da mutum mai shekaru 20 an kama su a cikin yankin Radstock, a cewar hukumar ‘yan sanda ta Avon da Somerset.
rows.reference: An kama wani mai shekaru 17, biyu masu shekaru 18 da wani mutum mai shekaru 20 da dare a cikin yankin Radstock, Avon inji ‘Yan Sandan Somerset.

rows.source: Officers have appealed for anyone who may have any mobile phone footage of what happened to come forward.
rows.output: Jami'an sun yi kira ga duk wanda zai iya samun bidiyon wayoyin salula na abin da ya faru ya zo gaba.
rows.reference: Jami’ai sun roƙi duk wani wanda ƙila ke da ƙaramin bidiyo na wayar hannu na abin da ya faru da ya zo.
