rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii weghara ugogbe anya ahụ n'ebe ahụ ma kwuo na ha hụrụ DNA Simpson n'ugogbe anya ahụ, dị ka CBS na-eme ka ọ bụrụ WAFB.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii weghachitere ugogbe anya ahụ n’okirikiri ahụ ma kwuo na ha hụrụ DNA nke Simpson na ha, ndị mmekọ CBS bụ WAFB kwuru.

rows.source: After questioning Simpson, police said he admitted to fatally shooting Wayde.
rows.output: Mgbe e mesịrị jụọ Simpson, ndị uwe ojii kwuru na o kwetara na o gburu Wayde.
rows.reference: Ka ajụchara Simpson ajụjụ, ndị uwe ojii kwuru na ọ kwenyere na ịgbagbu Wayde.

rows.source: His bond has been set at $350,000, the Advocate reports.
rows.output: Ego mgbapụta ya bụ $350,000, ka akwụkwọ akụkọ The Advocate si kwuo.
rows.reference: Atọrọ bọndụ ya na $350,000, Advocate kwuru.

rows.source: The East Baton Rouge Parish Coroner's Office released a preliminary report Friday, saying the cause of death is a gunshot wound to the head into the neck.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ onye ọka iwu obodo East Baton Rouge Parish wepụtara akụkọ izizi na Fraịdee, na-ekwu na ihe kpatara ọnwụ ahụ bụ mgbọ egbu egbu n'isi na olu.
rows.reference: Ụlọ Ọrụ Onye Nyocha nke East Baton Rouge Parish buputere mkpeza izizi na Fraịde, na ekwu na ihe buputere ọnwụ ahụ bụ egbe ọgbụgba agbara n’isi ruo n’olu.

rows.source: The department is crediting the Louisiana State Police fugitive task force, the state police crime lab, Southern University police and area citizens in assisting in the investigation leading to the arrest.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-enye ndị Louisiana State Police Fugitive Task Force, ụlọ nyocha ndị uwe ojii steeti, ndị uwe ojii Southern University, na ndị bi na mpaghara aka maka inyere aka na nyocha ahụ mere ka a nwude ya.
rows.reference: Ngalaba ahụ na eto ndị ọrụ ike nke Ndị Uwe Ojii Steeti Louisiana, ụlọ nyocha ndị uwe ojii nke steeti ahụ, ndị uwe ojii Southern University yana ndị amaala mpaghara n’ịnyere aka na nnyocha ahụ butere njide ahụ.

rows.source: LSU athletic director Joe Alleva thanked area law enforcement for its "diligence and pursuit of justice."
rows.output: Onye isi egwuregwu LSU Joe Alleva kelere ndị ọrụ nchekwa mpaghara maka "ịrụpụta ihe na ịgbachitere ikpe ziri ezi."
rows.reference: Onye ndu egwuregwu LSU Joe Alleva kelere ndị uwe ojii maka “uchu yana nchuso akwụmọtọ ya.”

rows.source: Sims was 20 years old.
rows.output: Sims dị afọ iri abụọ.
rows.reference: Sims dị afọ 20.

rows.source: The 6-foot-6 forward grew up in Baton Rouge, where his father, Wayne, also played basketball for LSU.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe n'ihu nke dị 6-6 si n'obodo Baton Rouge, ebe nna ya, Wayne, na-egwu basketball maka LSU.
rows.reference: Onye ihu ahụ dị 6-ụkwụ-6 toro na Baton Rouge, ebe nna ya, Wayne, bụkwa onye egwu basketbọọlụ nke LSU.

rows.source: He averaged 5.6 points and 2.6 rebounds a game last season.
rows.output: Ọ na-ekwukwa ihe dị ka isi 5.6 na 2.6 na-alọta n'otu egwuregwu n'oge gara aga.
rows.reference: Ọ na enweta akara 5.6 n’ọkara yana nkụpụta 2.6 kwa egwuregwu n’oge gara aga.

rows.source: On Friday morning, LSU basketball coach Will Wade said the team is "devastated" and "in shock" by Wayde's death.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Fraịdee, onye nkuzi basketball nke LSU, Will Wade, kwuru na otu ahụ "na-ewute" na "na-ajụ" ọnwụ Wayde.
rows.reference: N’ụtụtụ Fraịde, onye ndu basketbọọlụ LSU bụ Will Wade kwuru na otu ahụ nọ na “mgbu” yana “nkụja” n’ihi ọnwụ Wayde.

rows.source: "This is what you worry about at all times," Wade said.
rows.output: "Nke a bụ ihe ị na-echegbu onwe gị mgbe niile," ka Wade kwuru.
rows.reference: “Nke a bụ ihe ị na eche oge niile,” Wade kwuru.

rows.source: Volcano spews ash on Mexico City
rows.output: Mgbọriri na-asụ asụ na Mexico City
rows.reference: Volkano gbọpụtara ntụ na Mexico City

rows.source: Ash spewing from the Popocatepetl volcano has reached the southern neighborhoods of Mexico's capital.
rows.output: Ikpọku si na ugwu Popocatepetl eruola n'ime mpaghara ndịda nke isi obodo Mexico.
rows.reference: Mgbọpụta ntụ sitere na volkano Popocatepetl eruola agbatobi ndị nọ na ndịda nke isi ala Mexico.

rows.source: The National Center for Disaster Prevention warned Mexicans on Saturday to stay away from the volcano after activity picked up in the crater and it registered 183 emissions of gas and ash over 24 hours.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ mba ụwa maka igbochi ihe mberede dọọ ndị Mexico aka ná ntị na Satọde ka ha ghara ịbata n'ugwu ahụ ka ọrịa na-arị elu n'ime ya ma dekọọ mgbasa nke gas na ájá 183 n'ime awa 24.
rows.reference: Ọdụ Mba maka Mgbochi Ọdachi Mba dọrọ ndị Mexico aka na ntị na Satọde iji nọpụ na volkano ahụ ka achọpụtara mmereme na kreta, ọ debanyere mbupute 183 nke gas na ntụ n’ofe aka elekere 24.

rows.source: The center was monitoring multiple rumblings and tremors.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-eleba anya n'ọtụtụ mkpagharị na ntụgharị.
rows.reference: Ọdụ ahụ na enyocha ọtụtụ ụda na ọma jiji.

rows.source: Images on social media showed thin layers of ash coating car windshields in neighborhoods of Mexico City such as Xochimilco.
rows.output: Foto ndị dị na mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta ọha na eze gosiri na obere ihe na-acha aja aja na-acha aja aja na windo ụgbọ ala na mpaghara obodo Mexico City dị ka Xochimilco.
rows.reference: Onyonyo ndị dị n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze gosiri ntakịrị nyiwe ntụ na ekpuchi ụgbọ ala n’agbataobi nke Mexico City dị ka Xochimilco.

rows.source: Geophysicists have noticed an increase in activity at the volcano that sits 45 miles (72 kilometers) southeast of the capital since a 7.1-magnitude earthquake rocked central Mexico in September 2017.
rows.output: Ndị na-ahụ maka geophysics achọpụtala mmụba n'ọrụ na ugwu ahụ nke dị kilomita iri anọ na ise (72) n'ebe ndịda ọwụwa anyanwụ nke isi obodo ahụ kemgbe ala ọma jijiji nke dị 7.1 n'ogologo ala Mexico n'ọnwa Septemba 2017.
rows.reference: Ndị na enyocha ala chọpụtara mmalite na mmereme n’ime volkano ahụ nọ maịlụ 45 (kilomita 72) ọwụwa anyanwụ na ndịda nke isi ala kemgbe ala ọmajiji ruru 7.1 mere n’etiti Mexico na Septemba 2017.

rows.source: The volcano known as "Don Goyo" has been active since 1994.
rows.output: Mgbọrọgwụ a na-akpọ "Don Goyo" na-arụ ọrụ kemgbe 1994.
rows.reference: Volkano ahụ ama ka “Don Goyo” dị ire kemgbe 1994.

rows.source: Police clash with Catalan separatists ahead of independence vote anniversary
rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii na-aluso ndị na-akwado nnwere onwe Catalonia ọgụ tupu ụbọchị nke nnwere onwe.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii na ndị nkewa Catalonia lụrụ ọgụ tupu ụbọchị ncheta ntuli aka nnwere onwe

rows.source: Six people were arrested in Barcelona on Saturday after pro-independence protesters clashed with riot police, and as thousands joined rival demonstrations to mark the first anniversary of Catalonia's polarizing vote on secession.
rows.output: Mmadụ isii ka a nwudoro na Barcelona na Satọde ka ndị na-akwado nnwere onwe na ndị uwe ojii na-alụ ọgụ, na ndị puku ndị ọzọ na-esonyekwa na ngagharị ihe na-eme n'otu oge ahụ iji mee mmemme nke afọ mbụ nke Catalonia na-ewelite ajụjụ maka ịwepụ onwe ya.
rows.reference: Ejidere ndị mmadụ isii na Barcelona na Satọde ka ndị ngagharị iwe na akwado nnwere onwe lụsara ndị uwe ojii ọgụ, ka puku kwụrụ puku ndị mmadụ sonyere na ngagharị nke ọzọ iji dowe ụbọchị izizi ncheta nke ntuli aka gbasara nsepụ aka nke Catalonia na akpọtụ akpọtụ.

rows.source: A group of masked pro-separatists held back by riot police pelted them with eggs and hurled powder paint, creating dark clouds of dust in streets that would usually be thronged with tourists.
rows.output: Otu ndị na-eyi mkpara na-akwado nnwere onwe na ndị uwe ojii na-eme ngagharị iwe na-ejigide ha na-egbu egbu, na-atụba ha na àkwá, na-atụba ha na ntụ ntụ, na-emepụta ọkụ na-adịghị mma n'okporo ụzọ ndị na-emekarị na ndị njem nleta na-ejupụta.
rows.reference: Otu nke na akwado nkewa kpuchiri ihu ha nke ndị uwe ojii na egbochi tụrụ ha akwa ma tụkwaa agba ntụ, na emepụta urukpuru ojii nke ntụ n’okporo ụzọ na abụkarị ndị njem na eju.

rows.source: Scuffles also broke out later in the day with police using their batons to contain the fighting.
rows.output: Mgbọrọgwụ ndị ọzọ mere n'oge e mesịrị n'ụbọchị ahụ, ndị uwe ojii ji osisi ha na-achịkwa ndị na-alụ ọgụ.
rows.reference: Ọgụ mechaa dapụta n’ụbọchị ahụ ebe ndị uwe ojii ji osisi iji kwụsịtụ ọgụ ahụ.

rows.source: Over several hours pro-independence groups chanting "No forgetting, no forgiveness" faced off with unionist protesters shouting, "Long live Spain."
rows.output: N'ime awa ole na ole, ndị otu na-akwado nnwere onwe na-eti "Enweghi echiche, enweghi mgbaghara" zutegoro ndị na-akwado njikọ aka na-eti "Dị ndụ Spain."
rows.reference: N’ofe ọtụtụ aka elekere ndị otu na akwado nnwere onwe nọ na eti “Agaghị echezọ, agaghị agbahara” n’ihu ndị ngagharị iwe ndị ịdị n’otu nọ na eti, “Ndụ dịịrị Spain.”

rows.source: Fourteen people received treatment for minor injuries received in the protests, local press reported.
rows.output: Mmadị iri na anọ nwetara ọgwụgwọ maka mmerụ ahụ dị obere nke ha nwetara n'oge ngagharị iwe, akwụkwọ akụkọ obodo kwuru.
rows.reference: Ndị mmadụ iri na anọ nwetere ọgwụgwọ maka obere mmerụ ahụ enwetara na ngagharị iwe ahụ, ndị mgbasa ozi mpaghara kwuru.

rows.source: Tensions remain high in the independence-minded region a year after the October 1 referendum deemed illegal by Madrid but celebrated by separatist Catalans.
rows.output: Mmetụta dị elu na mpaghara nwere ọchịchọ nnwere onwe otu afọ ka e mere ntụli aka nke October 1, nke Madrid chere na ọ bụ ihe na-adịghị mma ma na-eme ememe ndị Catalans na-ahọpụta onwe ha.
rows.reference: Obi mgbali elu dị n’ime mpaghara ahụ na akwado nnwere onwe n’ime otu afọ ka emechara nhọpụta Ọktoba 1 nke Madrid hụrụ ka ihe gabigara iwu mana nke ndị nkewa Catalonia nwụrịrị.

rows.source: Voters chose overwhelmingly to become independent, though turnout was low with those against secession largely boycotting the vote.
rows.output: Ndị na-ahọpụta ndị nnọchi anya họọrụ n'ụzọ dị ukwuu ka ha bụrụ ndị na-achị onwe ha, n'agbanyeghị na ntụli aka dị ala, ebe ndị na-emegide ịwepụ onwe ha na-azọpụta n'ụzọ dị ukwuu.
rows.reference: Ndị ntuli aka họpụtara dum ịnọrọ na nnwere onwe, agbanyeghị na ndị pụtara dị obere ebe ndị na achọghị nkewa ledara ntuli aka ahụ.

rows.source: According to Catalan authorities almost 1000 people were injured last year after police tried to stop the vote going ahead at polling stations across the region in violent clashes.
rows.output: N'afọ gara aga, ihe dị ka mmadụ 1000 merụrụ ahụ mgbe ndị ọrụ Catalan na ndị uwe ojii na-alụ ọgụ na-eweghachi ntuli aka n'ebe a na-eme ntuli aka n'ofe mpaghara ahụ.
rows.reference: Site na ndị ikikere Catalonia ihe rutere ndị mmadụ 1000 merụrụ ahụ n’afọ ikpeazụ ka ndị uwe ojiii nwara ịkwụsị ntuli aka ahụ ịga n’ihu n’ọdụ ntuli aka dị n’ofe mpaghara nke nnukwu ọgụ ndị ahụ.

rows.source: Pro-independence groups had camped out overnight on Friday to prevent a demonstration in support of the national police.
rows.output: Ndị otu na-akwado nnwere onwe nọdụrụ ala n'abalị Fraịde iji gbochie ngagharị iwe nkwado ndị uwe ojii mba.
rows.reference: Ndị otu na akwado nnwere onwe larụrụ n’ilo na Fraịde iji gbochie ngagharị iwe na nkwado nke ndị uwe mba ahụ.

rows.source: The demonstration went ahead but was forced to take a different route.
rows.output: Mgbapụta ahụ gara n'ihu mana ọ dị mkpa ka ọ were ụzọ dị iche.
rows.reference: Ngagharị iwe ahụ gara n’ihu mana akwanyere ha iji ụzọ ọzọ.

rows.source: Narcis Termes, 68, an electrician attending the separatist protest with his wife said he was no longer hopeful about the prospects of Catalonia gaining independence.
rows.output: Narcis Termes, 68, onye na-arụ ọrụ eletrik na-eme ngagharị iwe maka nnwere onwe na nwunye ya kwuru na ọ nweghịzi olileanya maka olileanya Catalonia ga-enweta nnwere onwe.
rows.reference: Narcis Termes, 68, onye na arụ ọkụ bịara ngagharị iwe nkewa ahụ du nwunye ya kwuru na ọ nweghịzị olile anya maka atụmanya nke Catalonia ịnweta nnwere onwe.

rows.source: "Last year we lived through one of our best moments.
rows.output: "N'afọ gara aga, anyị biri n'otu n'ime oge kacha mma ná ndụ anyị."
rows.reference: “Afọ gara aga anyị hụrụ otu oge kachasị mma na ndụ anyị.

rows.source: I watched my parents cry with joy at being able to vote but now we are stuck," he said.
rows.output: Achọrụ m ndị mụrụ m ka ha na-ata ahụhụ n’ụjọn na ha nwere ike ịtụ vootu, ma ugbu a, anyị na-akụda.
rows.reference: Elelere m nne na nna m bee akwa ka ha nwere ohere ịtụ ntuli aka mana ugbu a anyị kwudoro akwudo,” o kwuru.

rows.source: Despite managing a vital if narrow victory in regional elections last December, Catalan pro-independence parties have struggled to retain momentum this year with many of their best known leaders either in self imposed exile or in detention awaiting trial for their role in organizing the referendum and subsequent declaration of independence.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na ha jisiri ike nweta mmeri dị mkpa, n'agbanyeghị na ọ bụ obere, na ntuli aka mpaghara n'ọnwa Disemba gara aga, pati ndị na-akwado nnwere onwe Catalonia na-agbasi mbọ ike ka ha na-edobe ume n'afọ a, ebe ọtụtụ n'ime ndị isi ha a ma ama na-anọghị n'ụlọ mkpọrọ ma ọ bụ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ na-eche ikpe maka ọrụ ha na nhazi referendum na nkwupụta nnwere onwe na-esote.
rows.reference: Tụmadị ijikwa mmeri dị mkpa dị mkpụmkpụ na ntuli ala nke mpaghara emere na Disemba gara aga, ndị otu na akwado Catalonia agbaala mbọ idowe agbamume n’afọ a ebe imirikiri ndị isi ha ama ama kachasị mma gbara ọsọ ndụ ma ọ bụ nọrọ n’ụlọ mkpọrọ na eche ikpe maka ọrụ ha na ịhazi nhọpụta ahụ yana nkwupute nke nnwere onwe sotere ya.

rows.source: Joan Puig, a 42-year-old mechanic recording the protest in support of the police on his phone, said the conflict had been stoked by politicians on both sides.
rows.output: Joan Puig, onye na-arụ ọrụ ụgbọ ala dị afọ iri anọ na abụọ, na-edekọ ihe ngosi nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwupụta nkwup
rows.reference: Joan Puig, onye na arụ ụgbọ ala dị afọ 42 na edekọ ngagharị iwe ahụ n’ekwentị ya na nkwado nke ndị uwe ojii, kwuru na ndị ndọrọndọrọ n’akụkụ abụọ ahụ kpalitere esemokwu ahụ.

rows.source: "It's getting more and more tense," he said.
rows.output: "Ọ na-adịkwu na-ewute ya," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: O kwuru “obi ndị mmadụ na agbali nke ukwuu,”.

rows.source: On Saturday, Oriol Junqueras, one of nine Catalan leaders in pre-trial jail since late last year, announced he would run in European Parliament elections next year.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọdee, Oriol Junqueras, otu n'ime ndị isi Catalonia itoolu nọ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ tupu ikpe ikpe kemgbe njedebe nke afọ gara aga, kwuputara na ọ ga-azọ ọkwa ntuli aka European Parliament n'afọ na-abịa.
rows.reference: Na Satọde, Oriol Junqueras, otu n’ime ndị isi Catalonia nọ n’ụlọ mkpọrọ na eche ikpe kemgbe ebe ngwụcha afọ gara aga, kwuru na ọ ga-apụta maka ntuli aka Nzụkọ Omeiwu nke Europe.

rows.source: "Standing as a candidate for the European elections is the best way to denounce the regression in democratic values and repression we have seen from the Spanish government," he said.
rows.output: "Ịnọdụ n'ọkwa onye na-azọ ọkwa maka ntuli aka Europe bụ ụzọ kacha mma isi katọọ mbelata nke ụkpụrụ ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na mmachi ndị anyị hụrụ n'aka gọọmentị Spanish," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ịkwụpụta ka onye nhọpụta maka ntuli aka nke Europe bụ ụzọ kachasị mma iji kagbuo nlaghachi azụ n’uru ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya yana mkpagbu anyị hụgoro na gọọmentị ndị Spain,” ka o kwuru.

rows.source: Londonderry: Men arrested after house rammed by car
rows.output: Londonderry: Ejidere ndị mmadụ ka ụgbọ ala dakwasịrị ụlọ
rows.reference: Londonderry: Ejidere ụmụ nwoke ka ụgbọ ala sụbanyere n’ụlọ

rows.source: Three men, aged 33, 34 and 39, have been arrested after a car was repeatedly rammed into a house in Londonderry.
rows.output: Mmadụ atọ, dị afọ iri atọ na atọ, iri atọ na anọ na iri atọ na itoolu, ka ejidere mgbe ụgbọ ala na-awụpụ ụlọ na Londonderry.
rows.reference: Ụmụ nwoke atọ, afọ 33, 34, na 39, ka ejidere ka eji ụgbọ ala sụbanye n’ụlọ ugboro ugboro na Londonderry.

rows.source: The incident unfolded in Ballynagard Crescent on Thursday at about 19:30 BST.
rows.output: Ihe mere na Ballynagard Crescent na Tọzdee n'ihe dị ka elekere 19:30 nke abalị.
rows.reference: Ihe ahụ mere na Ballynagard Crescent na Tọsde n’ihe dị ka 19:30 BST.

rows.source: Det Insp Bob Blemmings said damage was caused to the gates and the building itself.
rows.output: Onye nchọpụta Bob Blemmings kwuru na mmebi mere n'ụzọ ụzọ na ụlọ ahụ n'onwe ya.
rows.reference: Ịnspektọ Ndị Uwe Ojii Bob Blemmings kwuru na emebiri ọnụ ụzọ yana ụlọ ahụ n’onwe ya.

rows.source: A crossbow may also have been fired at the car at some point.
rows.output: Otu mgbọrọgwụ nwere ike ikesa n'ụgbọ ala n'oge ụfọdụ.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere ike ịbụ na agbara ụgbọ ala ahụ ụta n’otu oge.

rows.source: Menga strike gives Livingston 1-0 win over Rangers
rows.output: Mbenga kụrụ gool na-enye Livingstone mmeri 1-0 megide Rangers
rows.reference: Goolu Menga nyere Livingston mmeri 1-0 n’elu Rangers

rows.source: Dolly Menga's first goal for Livingston secured victory
rows.output: Goolụ Dolly Menga nke mbụ maka Livingston mere ka ha merie
rows.reference: Goolu izizi nke Dolly Menga nke Livingston wetere mmeri

rows.source: Promoted Livingston stunned Rangers to consign Steven Gerrard to just his second defeat in 18 games as manager of the Ibrox club.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị iche, Livingston tụgharịrị Rangers n'ụzọ dị egwu, na-eme ka Steven Gerrard nwee naanị mmeri nke abụọ ya n'ime egwuregwu 18 ọ na-ahazikarị n'ụlọ Ibrox.
rows.reference: Livingston akwagotere kụjara Rangers iji tinye Steven Gerrard na ọdịda nke abụọ ya n’egwuregwu 18 ka onye ndu nke otu Ibrox.

rows.source: Dolly Menga's strike proved to be the difference as Gary Holt's side moved level with Hibernian in second.
rows.output: Mgbapụta Dolly Menga gosipụtara ka ọ dị iche ka ọ na-eme ka ndị otu Gary Holt na-aga n'ihu Hibernian na nke abụọ.
rows.reference: Goolu Dolly Menga kwụpụtara ka ndịiche ka ndị otu Gary Holt gbagoro n’otu ọkwa ka Hibernia n’ọkwa nke abụọ.

rows.source: Gerrard's side remain without an away win in the Premiership this season and face leaders Hearts, who they trail by eight points, next Sunday.
rows.output: Ndị otu Gerrard ka na-enweghị mmeri n'ụlọ n'egwuregwu Premier League n'afọ a ma na-eche ndị isi Heart of Midlothian ihu, bụ ndị ha na-eso isi asatọ, n'izu na-abịa.
rows.reference: Ndị otu Gerrard na enweghị mmeri n’ụzọ na Premiership n’afọ a ga-ezute ndị nọ n’isi bụ Hearts, ndị ha ji akara asatọ achụ, na Sọnde na esote.

rows.source: Before then, Rangers host Rapid Vienna in the Europa League on Thursday.
rows.output: Tupụ tupu nke ahụ, Rangers na-anabata Rapid Vienna na asọmpi Europa League na Tọzdee.
rows.reference: Tupu nke ahụ, Rangers ga-ezute Rapid Vienna na Europa League na Tọsde.

rows.source: Livingston, meanwhile, extend their unbeaten run in the division to six games, with head coach Holt still to taste defeat since replacing Kenny Miler last month.
rows.output: Livingston, n'otu oge ahụ, na-eme ka ọganihụ ha na-agbadata na ngalaba ahụ ruo egwuregwu isii, ebe onye isi nchịkwa Holt ka na-agbadata n'agbanyeghị na ọ dochie Kenny Miler ọnwa gara aga.
rows.reference: Livingston, otu aka ọzọ, dọtịrị mmeri ha na enweghị nsaghachi na ngalaba ahụ ruo egwuregwu isii, ebe onye isi ndu Holt enwebeghị ọdịda kemgbe ọ nọchiri Kenny Miller n’ọnwa gara aga.

rows.source: Livingston miss chances against blunt visitors
rows.output: Livingston tụfuru ohere megide ndị ọbịa na-adịghị mma
rows.reference: Livingston tufuru ohere ha n’aka ndị mbịambịa na adịghị nkọ

rows.source: Holt's team should have been ahead long before they scored, with their directness causing Rangers all manner of problems.
rows.output: Ndị otu Holt kwesịrị ịbụ isi ogologo oge tupu ha agbaa, na ụzọ ha si aga na-eme ka Rangers nwee ọtụtụ nsogbu.
rows.reference: Ndị otu Holt kwesịrị ịnọ n’ihu tupu ha enye goolu, egwuregwu ike ha buteere ndị Rangers ụdịrị nsogbu niile.

rows.source: Scott Robinson broke through but dragged his effort across the face of goal, then Alan Lithgow could only direct his effort wide after sliding in to meet Craig Halkett's header across goal.
rows.output: Scott Robinson gbara n'okirikiri, wee jiri aka ya kụọ bọọlụ ahụ n'ihu, mgbe Alan Lithgow gbara bọọlụ ahụ n'akụkụ mgbe ọ na-agba ọsọ ịzute isi Craig Halkett n'akụkụ bọọlụ ahụ.
rows.reference: Scott Robinson gafere mana ọ gbafuru mbọ ya n’ihu goolu ahụ, mgbe ahụ Alan Lithgow nwenwuru ike ịgbafu mbọ ya ka ọ mịchara iji nweta bọọlụ isi nke Craig Halkett gafere n’ihu goolu.

rows.source: The hosts were content to let Rangers play in front of them, knowing they could trouble the visitors at set pieces.
rows.output: Ndị na-anabata ndị ahụ nwere obi ụtọ ịhapụ Rangers ka ha gwuo n'ihu ha, ma mara na ha nwere ike ime ka ndị ọbịa ahụ nwee nsogbu n'oge egwuregwu.
rows.reference: Ndị anọ be ha nwere afọ ojuju ịhapụ Rangers ịgba bọọlụ n’ihu ha, buru n’obi na ha ga-enye ndị mbịambịa ahụ nsogbu na bọọlụ atụsara otu ebe.

rows.source: And that was the manner in which the crucial goal came.
rows.output: Na nke ahụ bụ ụzọ e si nweta ihe mgbaru ọsọ dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Ma nke ahụ bụ ụzọ ha ji nye goolu ahụ dị mkpa.

rows.source: Rangers conceded a free-kick and Livingston worked an opening, Declan Gallagher and Robinson combining to set up Menga, who took a touch and scored from the centre of the box.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers nyere goolu n'efu, ndị Livingston rụrụ ọrụ, Declan Gallagher na Robinson jikọtara ọnụ iji tọọ Menga, onye were otu aka wee gbaba n'isi bọọlụ site n'etiti igbe ahụ.
rows.reference: Rangers nyere frikik, ndị Livingston mepere oghere, Declan Gallagher na Robinson jikọrọ aka iji tọlite Menga, onye metụrụ ya otu ugboro wee si n’etiti bọksị ahụ wee nye goolu.

rows.source: By that stage, Rangers had dominated possession but had found the home defence impenetrable and goalkeeper Liam Kelly was largely untroubled,
rows.output: N'oge ahụ, Rangers na-achịkọtakwu ihe, ma ha hụrụ na nchebe ụlọ ahụ na-esiri ike, na onye na-ejigide ihe, Liam Kelly, na-enwekarị nsogbu.
rows.reference: N’oge ahụ, ndị Rangers ji bọọlụ niile mana ha enwenwughi ike ịgafe defensị ndị ahụ anọ be ha yana onye nche post Liam Kelly enweghị nsogbu ọ bụla,

rows.source: That pattern continued into the second half, though Alfredo Morelos did force a save from Kelly.
rows.output: Nke ahụ na-aga n'ihu na ọkara nke abụọ, n'agbanyeghị na Alfredo Morelos mere ka Kelly nwee ihe.
rows.reference: Usoro ahụ gara n’ihu ruo ọkara nke abụọ, mana Alfredo Morelos mere ka Kelly rụọ ọrụ ya.

rows.source: Scott Pittman was denied by the feet of Rangers goalkeeper Allan McGregor and Lithgow flicked wide from another Livingston set play.
rows.output: E wepụrụ Scott Pittman site n'aka onye nche Rangers Allan McGregor na Lithgow gafere n'akụkụ site na egwuregwu ọzọ nke Livingston.
rows.reference: Ụkwụ nke onye nche post Rangers Allan McGregor jụrụ Scott Pittman, Lithgow gbafuru bọọlụ nke Livingston ọzọ atụsara otu ebe.

rows.source: Crosses continually came into the Livingston box and were continually cleared, while two penalty claims - after Halkett's challenge on substitute Glenn Middleton, and one for handball - were waved away.
rows.output: N'ime igbe Livingston, okpokoro na-aga n'ihu na-abata ma na-apụ, ebe a na-ekpochapụ ha. A na-ekpochapụ arịrịka abụọ - mgbe Halkett gbara onye na-anọchi anya Glenn Middleton, na otu maka ịgba bọọlụ - ka a na-efegharị ha.
rows.reference: Bọọlụ bịara ugboro ugboro n’ime bọksị Livingston, nke agbafuru ha niile, ebe enwere penaltị abụọ ajụrụ - ka Halkett gbachara Glenn Middleton ewebatara ụkwụ, otu maka ịmetụ bọọlụ aka - ajụrụ ha.

rows.source: 'Phenomenal' from Livingston - analysis
rows.output: 'Phenomenal' from Livingston - nyocha
rows.reference: ‘Ihe dị egwu’ sitere n’aka Livingston - nchịkọta

rows.source: BBC Scotland's Alasdair Lamont at the Tony Macaroni Arena
rows.output: BBC Scotland's Alasdair Lamont na Tony Macaroni Arena
rows.reference: Alasdair Lamont nke BBC Scotland na Ogige Tony Macaroni

rows.source: A phenomenal performance and result for Livingston.
rows.output: Ihe ngosi dị egwu na nke ga-eme ka a na-ekwu maka Livingstone.
rows.reference: Omume na nsonaazụ dị egwu maka Livingston.

rows.source: To a man, they were excellent, continuing to exceed expectations on this upward trajectory.
rows.output: Nwoke ọ bụla, ha dị ezigbo mma, na-aga n'ihu na-agafe ihe a tụrụ anya na ụzọ a na-arị elu.
rows.reference: Na nhụta otu nwoke, ha mere nke ọma, ha gara n’ihu na emefe ihe ndị atụrụ anya na mgbago ha.

rows.source: Their style of play and personnel has scarcely changed since their return to the top flight, but great credit has to go to Holt for the way he has galvanised the team since his arrival.
rows.output: Ụdị egwuregwu ha na ndị otu ha agbanwebeghị nke ukwuu kemgbe ha lọghachiri n'ọkwa kacha elu, ma nnukwu otu e nyere Holt bụ otu o si mee ka otu ahụ nwee mmụọ kemgbe ọ bịarutere.
rows.reference: Ụzọ egwuregwu na ndị otu ha agbanweghị nke ukwuu kemgbe ha laghachitere n’isi, mana otito ga-aga n’aka Holt maka ụzọ o si dozie otu ahụ kemgbe ọ bịara.

rows.source: He had so many heroes.
rows.output: O nwere ọtụtụ ndị dike.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere ọtụtụ odogwu.

rows.source: Captain Halkett was immense, marshalling a superbly-organised defence, while Menga kept Connor Goldson and Joe Worrall on their toes throughout.
rows.output: Onye isi Halkett buru ibu, na-eduzi nchebe nke ọma, ebe Menga na-eme ka Connor Goldson na Joe Worrall na-ehi ụra n'oge niile.
rows.reference: Kaptịn Halkett gbara oke mbọ, jikwara defensị kpọrọ akpọ, ebe Menga dowere Connor Goldson na Joe Worrall n’ọrụ n’egwuregwu ahụ niile.

rows.source: Rangers were short of inspiration, though.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers enweghị mmụọ, n'agbanyeghị.
rows.reference: Ndị Rangers enweghị ihe na akpalite ha.

rows.source: As good as they have been at times under Gerrard, they fell well short of those standards.
rows.output: Dị ka ha si dị mma n'oge ụfọdụ n'okpuru Gerrard, ha dara n'ụzọ dị ukwuu n'ụkpụrụ ndị ahụ.
rows.reference: Tụmadị ezigbo egwuregwu ahụgoro n’aka ha n’okpuru Gerrard, ha erughi ọkọlọtọ ndị ahụ.

rows.source: Their final ball was lacking - only once did they cut the home side open - and it is something of a wake-up call for Rangers, who find themselves in mid-table.
rows.output: Bọọlụ ikpeazụ ha enweghị ike zuru oke - naanị otu oge ka ha mere ka ndị na-anọ n'ụlọ dị n'ime - na ọ bụ ihe na-echetara Rangers, ndị na-ahụ onwe ha n'etiti tebụl.
rows.reference: Bọọlụ ikpeazụ ha ezughi oke - naanị otu ugboro ka ha mepere ndị otu ahụ nọ n’ụlọ, ọ bụ ihe mmepe anya maka ndị Rangers, ndị hụrụ onwe ha n’etiti tebul.

rows.source: Erdogan get mixed reception in Cologne
rows.output: Erdogan nwetara nnọọdụ dị iche iche na Cologne
rows.reference: Erdogan nwetere nnabata dị iche iche na Cologne

rows.source: There were smiles and blue skies on Saturday (September 29) as the leaders of Turkey and Germany met for breakast in Berlin.
rows.output: Enwere ọchị na mbara igwe na Satọde (29 Septemba) mgbe ndị isi Turkey na Germany zutere maka nri ụtụtụ na Berlin.
rows.reference: Enwere ọchị yana eluigwe na acha agba akwụkwọ ndụ (Septemba 29) ka ndị isi nke Turkey na Germany hụrụ maka nri ụtụtụ na Berlin.

rows.source: It's the last day of President Erdogan's controversial visit to Germany - which is aimed at repairing relations beteen the NATO allies.
rows.output: Ọ bụ ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke nleta onye isi ala Erdogan na Germany, nke bụ nke na-eme ka mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ndị mmekọ NATO.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke mbịambịa na ebute esemokwu nke Onye Isi Ala Erdogan na Germany- nke ezubere iji dozie mmekọrịta n’etiti ndị enyi NATO.

rows.source: They've fallen out over issues including human rights, press freedom and Turkey's accession to the EU.
rows.output: Ha ekewala okwu n'ihe gbasara ikike mmadụ, nnwere onwe nke mgbasa ozi na nnabata Turkey na EU.
rows.reference: Ha enweela esemokwu n’ihi nsogbu gụnyere ikikere ndị mmadụ, nnwere onwe ndị mgbasa ozi yana mgbakwunye nke Turkey na EU.

rows.source: Erdogan then headed for Cologne to open a giant new mosque.
rows.output: Erdogan wee gaa Cologne imeghe nnukwu ụlọ ala.
rows.reference: Mgbe ahụ Erdogan gabara Cologne iji mepee ụlọ alakụba ọhụrụ buru oke ibu.

rows.source: The city is home to the largest Turkish population outside Turkey.
rows.output: Obodo a bụ ebe ndị Turkey kacha ibu n'èzí Turkey.
rows.reference: Obodo ahụ bụ ụlọ nke ọnụọgụgụ ndị Turkey kachasị na mpụga nke Turkey.

rows.source: Police cited security reasons to block a 25,000-strong crowd from gathering in front of the mosque, but plenty of supporters turned out nearby to see their president.
rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii kwuru na nchekwa bụ ihe kpatara ha ji gbochie iguzo mmadụ puku iri abụọ na ise n'ihu ụlọ ala ahụ, ma ọtụtụ ndị na-akwado ya ka nọ n'ebe dị nso ka ha hụ onye isi ha.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii ji n’ihi nche wee gbochie igwe mmadụ ruru 25,000 na ịgbakọta n’ihu ụlọ alakụba ahụ, mana ọtụtụ ndị nkwado pụtara n’ebe dị nso iji hụ onye isi ala ha.

rows.source: Hundreds of anti-Erdogan protesters - many of them Kurdish - also made their voices heard, condemning both Erdogan's policies and the German government's decision to welcome him to the country.
rows.output: Ndị na-emegide Erdogan - ọtụtụ n'ime ha bụ ndị Kurdish - kwukwara olu ha, na-akatọ ma amụma Erdogan na mkpebi gọọmentị German ịnabata ya na mba ahụ.
rows.reference: Narị kwụrụ narị ndị na anaghị akwado Erdogan - imirikiti bụ Kurdish - mekwara ka anụ olu ha, na akpọ iwu nke Erdogan asị yana mkpebi nke ndị Germany iji nabata ya n’obodo ahụ.

rows.source: The dueling protests reflect the divisiveness of a visitor hailed as a hero by some German Turks and reviled as an autocrat by others.
rows.output: Mgbapụta ndị na-eme ihe ngosi na-egosi nkewa nke onye ọbịa a na-asọpụrụ dị ka dike site n'aka ụfọdụ ndị German Turkey na-akparị dị ka onye ọchịchị aka ike site n'aka ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ọgụ ngagharị iwe ahụ na egosi nkewa nke onye ọbịa ụfọdụ ndị Turkey si Germany kpọrọ odogwu n’otu aka ọzọ ndị ọzọ na ahụta ya ka onye ọchịchị akaike.

rows.source: Deptford road crash: Cyclist dies in collision with car
rows.output: Mgbapụta okporo ụzọ Deptford: Onye na-agba ígwé ojì na-anwụpụ n'ọgụ na ụgbọ ala
rows.reference: Ihe mberede okporo ụzọ Deptford: Ọkwọ anyịnya igwe nwụrụ n’ihe mberede yana ụgbọ ala

rows.source: A cyclist has died in a collision involving a car in London.
rows.output: Onye na-agba ígwè agbapụla n'ihe mberede nke metụtaworo ụgbọ ala n'obodo London.
rows.reference: Otu ọkwọ anyịnya igwe nwụrụ n’ihe mberede gụnyere ụgbọ ala na London.

rows.source: The crash happened near the junction of Bestwood Street and Evelyn Street, a busy road in Deptford, in the south-east of the city, at about 10:15 BST.
rows.output: Mgbapụta ahụ mere nso n'akụkụ Bestwood Street na Evelyn Street, okporo ụzọ na-arụsi ọrụ ike na Deptford, na ndịda ọwụwa anyanwụ obodo ahụ, ihe dị ka elekere 10:15 BST.
rows.reference: Ihe mberede ahụ mere n’akụkụ nkwụsị nke Okporo Ụzọ Bestwood na Okporo Ụzọ Evelyn, okporo uzọ na eju eju na Deptford, n’ebe ọwụwa anyanwụ na ndịda nke obodo ahụ, n’ihe dị ka 10:15 BST.

rows.source: The driver of the car stopped and paramedics attended, but the man died at the scene.
rows.output: Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ahụ kwụsịrị wee nye ndị ọrụ ahụike, ma nwoke ahụ nwụrụ n'ebe ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye na anya ụgbọ ala ahụ kwụsịrị, ndị nlekọta letere ya, mana nwoke ahụ nwụrụ n’ebe ahụ.

rows.source: The crash comes months after another cyclist died in a hit-and-run on Childers Street, about a mile away from Saturday's crash.
rows.output: Mgbapụta ahụ na-abịa ọnwa ole na ole ka onye na-agba ọsọ ọzọ nwụrụ n'ihe mberede na-enweghị onye na-akwọ ụgbọ ala na Childers Street, ihe dị ka otu maịlụ site na ihe mberede nke Satọde.
rows.reference: Ihe mberede ahụ na eme n’ime ọnwa ole ma ole ka ọkwọ anyịnya igwe ọzọ nwụrụ n’ihe mberede akụrụ gbapụ ọsọ na Okporo Ụzọ Childers, ihe dị ka otu maịlụ pụọ n’ebe mberede nke Satọde.

rows.source: The Metropolitan Police said officers were working to identify the man and inform his next-of-kin.
rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii Metropolitan kwuru na ndị uwe ojii na-arụ ọrụ iji mata nwoke ahụ ma gwa onye ga-anọchi ya.
rows.reference: Metropolitan Police kwuru na ndị uwe ojii na arụ ọrụ iji mata nwoke ahụ wee gwa onye na esote ya.

rows.source: Road closures and bus diversions are in place and motorists have been advised to avoid the area.
rows.output: Mepụta mperi okporo ụzọ na ndị na-eme njem ụgbọ ala dị na ebe ahụ, ndị ọkwọ ụgbọ ala na-adụ ọdụ ka ha zere mpaghara ahụ.
rows.reference: Mmechi okporo ụzọ na mbugharị nnukwu ụgbọ ala dị, agwala ndị na akwọ ụgbọ ka ha zere mpaghara ahụ.

rows.source: Long Lartin prison: Six officers hurt in disorder
rows.output: Ụlọ mkpọrọ Long Lartin: Mmetụta isii n'oge ọgba aghara
rows.reference: Ụlọ mkpọrọ Long Lartin: Ndị ọrụ isii merụrụ ahụ n’ọgbaghara

rows.source: Six prison officers have been injured in a disturbance at a high security men's jail, the Prison Office has said.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ mkpọrọ isii merụrụ ahụ n'ọgbaghachị n'ụlọ mkpọrọ ndị nwoke nwere nchekwa dị elu, ụlọ ọrụ mkpọrọ kwuru.
rows.reference: Ndị ọrụ n’ụlọ mkpọrọ isii emerụọla ahụ n’ọgbaghara dị n’ụlọ nga ụmụ nwoke nwere nnukwu nche, Ụlọ Orụ Ụlọ Mkpọrọ ahụ kwuru.

rows.source: Disorder broke out at HMP Long Lartin in Worcestershire at about 09:30 BST on Sunday and is ongoing.
rows.output: Mgbapụta mere na HMP Long Lartin na Worcestershire na ihe dị ka 09:30 BST na Sọnde na ọ na-aga n'ihu.
rows.reference: Ọgbaghara dapụtara na HMP Long Lartin dị na Worcestershire n’ihe dị ka 09:30 BST na Sọnde nke ka na aga n’ihu.

rows.source: Specialist "Tornado" officers have been brought in to deal with the disturbance, which involves eight inmates and is contained to one wing.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ "Tornado" pụrụ iche ewerela ọnọdụ ahụ, nke gụnyere ndị mkpọrọ asatọ na nke a na-ejigide na otu akụkụ.
rows.reference: Akpọbatala ndị ọrụ ọkachamara “Tornado” iji gboo ọgbaghara ahụ, nke gụnyere ndị nga asatọ, akpakọtala ya n’otu akụkụ.

rows.source: The officers were treated for minor facial injuries at the scene.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ ahụ nwetara ọgwụgwọ maka mmerụ ahụ dị n'ihu nke dị obere n'ebe ahụ.
rows.reference: Eletere ndị ọrụ ahụ maka obere ahụ mmerụ n’ihu ha n’ebe ahụ.

rows.source: A Prison Service spokesperson said: "Specially trained prison staff have been deployed to deal with an ongoing incident at HMP Long Lartin.
rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka ọrụ mkpọrọ kwuru: "Ndị ọrụ mkpọrọ nke a zụrụ n'ụzọ pụrụ iche ka ebugara iji dozie ihe na-eme ugbu a na HMP Long Lartin.
rows.reference: Onye okwu okwu Ụlọ Orụ Ụlọ Mkpọrọ kwuru: “Ezipula ndị ọrụ ụlọ mkpọrọ azụrụ iche iji gboo ihe ahụ na eme ugbu a na HMP Long Lartin.

rows.source: Six members of staff have been treated for injuries.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ isii enwetala ọgwụgwọ maka mmerụ ahụ.
rows.reference: Eletela ndị otu isii maka mmerụ ahụ.

rows.source: We do not tolerate violence in our prisons, and are clear that those responsible will be referred to the police and could spend longer behind bars."
rows.output: Anyị anaghị anabatakwa ime ihe ike n'ụlọ mkpọrọ anyị, ma anyị dọọ aka ná ntị na ndị na-ahụ maka ya ga-ebuga ndị uwe ojii ma nwee ike ịnọgide n'ụlọ mkpọrọ ogologo oge.
rows.reference: Anyị anaghị anabata ọgbaghara n’ụlọ mkpọrọ anyị, o doro anya na aga enyefe ndị butere ya n’aka ndị uwe oji, ha nwere ike ịnọkwu oge toro ogologo n’ụlọ nga.’

rows.source: HMP Long Lartin holds more than 500 prisoners, including some of the country's most dangerous offenders.
rows.output: HMP Long Lartin na-ejide ihe karịrị ndị mkpọrọ 500, gụnyere ụfọdụ ndị omekome kacha dị ize ndụ n'obodo ahụ.
rows.reference: HMP Long Lartin na eji karịa ndị nga 500, gụnyere ụfọdụ ndị omekome kachasị njọ n’obodo a.

rows.source: In June it was reported that the prison's governor received hospital treatment after being attacked by a prisoner.
rows.output: N'ọnwa Juun, e kwuru na onye isi ụlọ mkpọrọ ahụ nwetara ọgwụgwọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ mgbe ndị mkpọrọ wakporo ya.
rows.reference: Na Juun ekpesara na gọvanọ ụlọ mkpọrọ ahụ nwetere ọgwụgwọ n’ụlọ ọgwụ ka otu onye nga makpuru ya.

rows.source: And in October last year riot officers were called to the prison to deal with a serious disturbance in which staff were attacked with pool balls.
rows.output: N'ọnwa Ọktoba n'afọ gara aga, ndị ọrụ na-ahụ maka ọgba aghara ka a kpọrọ ka ha bịa n'ụlọ mkpọrọ iji dozie esemokwu dị njọ ebe ndị ọrụ ahụ na-egbu egbu na bọọl.
rows.reference: N’ọktoba afọ gara aga akpọrọ ndị ọrụ ọgbaghara iji gboo nnukwu nsogbu nke eji bọọlụ siri ike wee makpuo ndị ọrụ.

rows.source: Hurricane Rosa Threatening Phoenix, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City With Flash Flooding (Drought Areas May Benefit)
rows.output: Ogologo ifufe Rosa na-eyi egwu na Phoenix, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City na idei mmiri (mpaghara ọkọnọ nwere ike iri uru)
rows.reference: Oke Ifufe Rosa Nwere Ike Ibute Ide Mmiri na Phoenix, Las Vega, Salt Lake City (Mpaghara Ọkọchị Nwere Ike Irite)

rows.source: It's rare for a tropical depression to hit Arizona, but that's exactly what's likely to happen early happen early next week as Hurricane Rosa's remaining energy tracks across the Desert Southwest, delivering flash flooding risks.
rows.output: Ọ na-adịkarị obere ka oke ifufe na-eme n'ala Arizona, ma nke ahụ bụ kpọmkwem ihe ga-eme n'oge na-adịghị anya n'oge na-adịghị anya n'oge na-adịghị anya ka ike nke Hurricane Rosa na-aga n'ihu na Desert Southwest, na-ebunye ihe egwu idei mmiri.
rows.reference: O siri ike ịhụ ka oke ifufe egbe-igwe ịkụ Arizona, mana nke ahụ bụ ihe nwere ike ịme na mbido izu na abịa ka ike fọdụrụ na Oke Ifufe Rosa na agafe n’akụkụ Ọdịda Anyanwụ na Ndịda nke Ọzara, na ebute ihe egwu ide mmiri.

rows.source: The National Weather Service has already issued flash flood watches for Monday and Tuesday for western Arizona into southern and eastern Nevada, southeastern California and Utah, including the cities of Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, and Salt Lake City.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ihu igwe nke mba ahụ ewerela nkwupụta idei mmiri ozugbo maka Mọnde na Tuzdee maka mpaghara ọdịda anyanwụ Arizona na ndịda na ọwụwa anyanwụ Nevada, ndịda ọwụwa anyanwụ California na Utah, gụnyere obodo ndị dị ka Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, na Salt Lake City.
rows.reference: Ọrụ Ihuigwe Mba enyela nlepụ anya maka ide mmiri maka Mọnde na Tusde maka akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ nke Arizona ruo n’akụkụ ndịda na ọwụwa anyanwụ Nevada, ọwụwa anyanwụ na ndịda nke California na Utah, gụnyere obodo nke Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, na Salt Lake City.

rows.source: Rosa is expected to take a direct path over Phoenix on Tuesday, approaching late Monday with rain.
rows.output: A na-atụ anya na Rosa ga-esi n'ụzọ kpọmkwem gafere Phoenix na Tuzdee, na-abịa n'oge abalị Mọnde na mmiri ozuzo.
rows.reference: Atụrụ anya na Rosa ga-agafe Phoenix ozugbo na Tusde, jiri mmiri ozizo na erute na mgbede Mọnde.

rows.source: The National Weather Service in Phoenix noted in a tweet that only "ten tropical cyclones have maintained tropical storm or depression status within 200 miles of Phoenix since 1950!
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ihu igwe mba na Phoenix kwuru na tweet na naanị "mmadụ iri na-ahapụ oke ifufe na ọnọdụ oke ifufe ma ọ bụ ịda mbà n'ime 200 kilomita nke Phoenix kemgbe 1950!
rows.reference: Ọrụ Ihuigwe Mba dị na Phoenix ekwuola na twit na naanị “oke ifufe ọjọọ iri dịgidere n’ọkwa oke ikuku mmiri ma ọ bụ oke ifufe egbe-igwe n’ime maịlụ 200 nke Phoenix kemgbe 1950!

rows.source: Katrina (1967) was a hurricane within 40 miles of the AZ border."
rows.output: Katrina (1967) bụ oké ifufe dị n'ime 40 kilomita n'akụkụ oke ala AZ.
rows.reference: Katrina (1967) bụ oke ifufe n’ime maịlụ 40 nke oke ala AZ.”

rows.source: The latest National Hurricane Center models predict 2 to 4 inches of rainfall, with isolated amounts up to 6 inches in the Mogollon Rim of Arizona.
rows.output: Ntuziaka kachasị ọhụrụ nke National Hurricane Center na-atụ anya mmiri ozuzo 2 ruo 4 inch, na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị a na-apụghị ịgbanarị 6 inch na Rim of Mogollon na Arizona.
rows.reference: Ụkpụrụ Ọdụ Oke Ifufe Mba kachasị ọhụrụ ugbu a na ebu amụma inchi 2 ruo 4 nke mmiri ozizo, mkpokọta ndị dịpụrụ iche ga-erucha inchi 6 na Mogolllon Rim of Arizona.

rows.source: Other areas of the Desert Southwest including the central Rockies and the Great Basin are likely to get 1 to 2 inches, with isolated totals up to 4 inches possible.
rows.output: Ogologo ebe ndị ọzọ nke Desert Southwest, gụnyere etiti Rockies na Great Basin, nwere ike nweta sentimita 1 ruo 2, na mkpokota ndị a na-apụghị ịgafe sentimita 4.
rows.reference: Mpaghara ndị ọzọ nke Ọdịda Anyanwụ na Ndịda Ọzara gụnyere etiti Rockies na Great Basin nwere ike ịnweta inchi 1 ruo 2, mgbakọta dịpụrụ iche ruru inchi 4 ma enwee ike.

rows.source: For those out of flash flood risk, Rosa's rain may be a blessing since the region is drought-stricken.
rows.output: Maka ndị na-adịghị n'ihe ize ndụ idei mmiri, mmiri ozuzo Rosa nwere ike ịbụ ihe ọma n'ihi na mpaghara ahụ na-agbaze.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ahụ na anọghị n’egwu ide mmiri, mmiri ozizo nke Rosa nwere ike ịbụ ngozi ebe mpaghara ahụ na enwe nnukwu ọkọchị.

rows.source: Although flooding is a very serious concern, some of this rainfall will likely be beneficial since the Southwest is currently experiencing drought conditions.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na idei mmiri bụ nnukwu nchegbu, akụkụ nke mmiri ozuzo a ga-abụ ihe bara uru n'ihi na ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ na-enwe ụkọ mmiri ugbu a.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị na ide mmiri bụ ihe nnukwu egwu, ụfọdụ mmiri ozizo a ga-adị mkpa ebe akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda ugbu a na enwe nnukwu ọkọchị.

rows.source: According to the U.S. Drought Monitor, just over 40 percent of Arizona is experiencing at least extreme drought, the second highest category," weather.com reported.
rows.output: Dị ka U.S. Drought Monitor si kwuo, ihe dị ka pasentị iri anọ nke Arizona na-enwe ụkọ mmiri dị oke njọ, nke bụ nke abụọ n'ogo "oke ụkọ mmiri," dị ka weather.com si kwuo.
rows.reference: Site n’aka ndị U.S. Ihe Nyocha Ọkọchị, naanị pasentị karịrị 40 na enweta opekata mpe ọkọchị dị oke egwu, otu nke abụọ kachasị,” weather.com kpesara.

rows.source: First, Hurricane Rosa's path leads to landfall across the Baja California peninsula of Mexico.
rows.output: N'ezie, ụzọ nke Hurricane Rosa na-ebute n'ala n'akụkụ Baja California peninsula nke Mexico.
rows.reference: Izizi, ụzọ nke Oke Ifufe Rosa na ada n’ofe Baja California ala mmiri nke Mexico.

rows.source: Rosa, still at hurricane strength Sunday morning with maximum winds of 85 miles per hour, is 385 miles south of Punta Eugenia, Mexico and moving north at 12 miles per hour.
rows.output: Rosa, ka ọ na-adị n'ike n'ike n'ụbọchị Sọnde, na ifufe kachasị elu nke 85 kilometa kwa elekere, dị 385 kilometa ndịda Punta Eugenia, Mexico, na-aga n'ebe ugwu na 12 kilometa kwa elekere.
rows.reference: Rosa, ka nọrọ n’ike oke ifufe ụtụtụ Mọnde nwere ikuku kachasị nke maịlụ 85 kwa aka elekere, nọ maịlụ 385 ndịda nke Punta Eugenia, Mexico na aga n’akụkụ ugwu na maịlụ 12 kwa aka elekere.

rows.source: The storm is encountering cooler waters in the Pacific and therefore powering down.
rows.output: Oké ifufe ahụ na-ezute mmiri oyi na Pacific ma na-ebelata ike ya.
rows.reference: Ikuku mmiri ahụ na abanye mmiri jụrụ oyi na Pacifik ya mere ọ na agbatu n’ike.

rows.source: Thus, it's expected to make landfall in Mexico at tropical storm strength in the afternoon or evening on Monday.
rows.output: Ya mere, a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ada n'ala Mexico n'oge oké ifufe n'ehihie ma ọ bụ mgbede na Mọnde.
rows.reference: Ya mere, atụrụ anya na ọ ga-ada na Mexico n’ike oke ikuku mmiri n’oge ehihie ma ọ bụ mgbede na Mọnde.

rows.source: Rainfall across portions of Mexico could be heavy, posing a significant flooding risk.
rows.output: Osimiri mmiri ozuzo nwere ike ịdị arọ n'akụkụ ụfọdụ nke Mexico, na-ebute nnukwu ihe egwu idei mmiri.
rows.reference: Mmiri ozizo n’ofe akụkụ nke Mexico nwere ike isi ike, na eyite ihe egwu nke ide mmiri.

rows.source: "Rainfall totals of 3 to 6 inches are expected from Baja California into northwestern Sonora, with up to 10 inches possible," weather.com reported.
rows.output: "Ọ na-atụ anya na mmiri ozuzo ga-adị site na 3 ruo 6 sentimita n'ime Baja California ruo n'ebe ugwu Sonora, na ihe ruru sentimita 10 ga-ekwe omume," weather.com kọrọ.
rows.reference: “Atụrụ anya mgbakọta mmiri ozizo nke inchi 3 ruo 6 sitere na Baja California banye n’akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ na ugwu nke Sonora, nwere ruo inchi 10 ma enwee ike,” weather.com kpesara.

rows.source: Rosa will then track north across Mexico as a tropical storm before reaching the Arizona border in the early morning hours Tuesday as a tropical depression, which will then track up through Arizona and into southern Utah by late Tuesday night.
rows.output: Rosa ga-eso n'ebe ugwu n'ofe Mexico dị ka oké ifufe tupu ọ rute na oke ala Arizona n'isi ụtụtụ Tuzdee dị ka oke ifufe, nke ga-esochi n'ebe ugwu Arizona na n'ime ndịda Utah n'ụtọ Tuzdee.
rows.reference: Mgbe ahụ Rosa ga-aga akụkụ ugwu site na Mexico ka oke ikuku mmiri tupu o rute n’oke ala Arizona n’isi ụtụtụ Tusde ka oke ifufe egbe-igwe, nke ga-agafe ozugbo na Arizona wee banye n’akụkụ ndịda Utah n’oge ime mgbede Tusde.

rows.source: "The main hazard expected from Rosa or its remnants is very heavy rainfall in Baja California, northwestern Sonora, and the U.S. Desert Southwest," the National Hurricane Center said.
rows.output: "Ọdachi kacha mkpa a na-atụ anya site na Rosa ma ọ bụ ihe fọdụrụ bụ oke mmiri ozuzo na Baja California, ugwu Sonora, na ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ United States."
rows.reference: “Ihe ịze ndụ kachasị atụrụ anya n’aka Rosa ma ọ bụ ihe fọdụrụ na ya bụ nnukwu mmiri ozizo dị egwu na Baja California, ọdịda anyanwụ na ugwu nke Sonora, yana U.S. Ọdịda Anyanwụ na Ndịda Ọzara,” Ọdụ Oke Ifufe Mba kwuru.

rows.source: These rains are expected to produce life-threatening flash flooding and debris flows in the deserts, and landslides in mountainous terrain.
rows.output: A na-atụ anya na mmiri ozuzo ndị a ga-emepụta idei mmiri na-efe efe na mmiri na-efe efe n'ime ọhịa, na ala ọdịda n'elu ugwu.
rows.reference: Atụrụ anya mmiri ozizo ndị a ịmepụta ịde mmiri nwere ike igbu ndị mmadụ yana ọsụsọ ahịhịa n’ọzara, yana ala ọzịze n’ala ugwu.

rows.source: Midsomer Norton attack: Four attempted murder arrests
rows.output: Midsomer Norton mwakpo: Mmadu anọ e jidere maka igbu mmadụ
rows.reference: Mmakpu Midsomer Norton: Njide mmadụ anọ maka ọnwụnwa igbu mmadụ

rows.source: Three teenage boys and a 20-year-old man have been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after a 16-year-old was found with stab wounds in Somerset.
rows.output: Mmadụ atọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ nọ n
rows.reference: Ejidela ụmụ ntorobịa nwoke atọ yana otu nwoke dị afọ 20 na nyocha nke ọnwụnwa igbu mmadụ ka ahụchara otu onye dị afọ 16 nwere ọnya eji mma mee na Somerset.

rows.source: The teenage boy was found injured in the Excelsior Terrace area of Midsomer Norton, at about 04:00 BST on Saturday.
rows.output: Nwata nwoke ahụ merụrụ ahụ n'obosara Excelsior Terrace nke Midsomer Norton, n'ihe dị ka elekere anọ nke ụtụtụ na Satọde.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ nwoke ntorobịa ahụ ebe ọ nwere ọnya n’ebe mpaghara Excelsior Terrace nke Midsomer Norton, ihe dị ka 04:00 BST na Satode.

rows.source: He was taken to hospital where he remains in a "stable" condition.
rows.output: E bugara ya n'ụlọ ọgwụ ebe ọ ka nọ n'ọnọdụ "dị mma".
rows.reference: Edugara ya n’ụlọ ọgwụ ebe ọ nọrọ n’ọnọdụ “dị mma”.

rows.source: A 17-year-old, two 18-year-olds and a 20-year-old man were arrested overnight in the Radstock area, Avon and Somerset Police said.
rows.output: Nwoke dị afọ iri na asaa, ndị dị afọ iri na asatọ abụọ, na otu nwoke dị afọ iri abụọ ka nwudere n'abalị a n'ógbè Radstock, ndị uwe ojii Avon na Somerset kwuru.
rows.reference: Ejidere otu onye afọ 17, mmadụ abụọ afọ 18 yana otu nwoke afọ 20 n’abalị na mpaghara Radstock, Avon nke Ndị Uwe Ojii Somerset kwuru.

rows.source: Officers have appealed for anyone who may have any mobile phone footage of what happened to come forward.
rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii agwala onye ọ bụla nwere ihe nkiri vidiyo ekwentị ọ bụla nke ihe mere ka ọ bịa.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii arịọla ka mmadụ ọ bụla nwere nseta ekwentị mkpanaka nke ihe mere ka ọ bịa ihu.

rows.source: Trump says Kavanaugh 'suffered, the meanness, the anger' of the Democratic Party
rows.output: Trump kwuru na Kavanaugh 'na-ata ahụhụ, obi ọjọọ, iwe' nke pati Democratic
rows.reference: Trump kwuru Kavanaugh “tara ahụhụ, obi akpọ, iwe” nke Otu Demokrats

rows.source: "A vote for Judge Kavanaugh is a vote to reject the ruthless and outrageous tactics of the Democratic Party," Trump said at a rally in Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.output: "Vootu maka Jọjọ Kavanaugh bụ votu iji jụ ndị Democratic Party na-eme ihe na-enweghị obi ebere na nke na-adịghị mma."
rows.reference: “Otu ntuli aka maka Ọkaikpe Kavanaugh bụ ntuli aka iji jụ obi ọjọọ na ụzọ gafere oke nke ndị Otu Demokrats,” Trump kwuru n’ọgbakọ dị na Wheeling, West Virginia.

rows.source: Trump said that Kavanaugh has "suffered the meanness, the anger" of the Democratic Party throughout his nomination process.
rows.output: Trump kwuru na Kavanaugh enweela "ụnwute, iwe" nke pati Democratic n'ime usoro nhọpụta ya.
rows.reference: Trump kwuru na Kavanaugh “ataala ahụhụ obi akpọ, iwe” nke ndị Otu Demokrat n’usoro nhọpụta ya.

rows.source: Kavanaugh testified before Congress on Thursday, forcefully and emotionally denying an allegation from Christine Blasey Ford that he sexually assaulted her decades ago when they were teenagers.
rows.output: Kavanaugh gbara aka n'ụlọomeiwu n'ụbọchị Tọzdee, na-emegide ebubo nke Christine Blasey Ford na-ekwu na o mere ya ihe ike n'afọ iri abụọ gara aga mgbe ha bụ ndị na-eto eto.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh gbara akaebe n’ihu Nzụkọ na Tọsde, jiri iwe na obi mmụọ wee gọnarị ebubo nke Christine Blasey Ford na ọ wakporo ya n’afọ iri gara aga mgbe ha bụ ndị ntorobia.

rows.source: Ford also testified at the hearing about her allegation.
rows.output: Ford kwukwara n'oge a na-eme nyocha banyere ebubo ya.
rows.reference: Ford gbakwara akaebe nke ọnụnụ ahụ gbasara ebubo ya.

rows.source: The President said on Saturday that the "American people saw the brilliant and quality and courage" of Kavanaugh that day.
rows.output: Onye isi ala kwuru na Satọde na "ndị America hụrụ ihe ndị mara mma, nke ọma na nke obi ike" nke Kavanaugh n'ụbọchị ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala kwuru na Satọde na “Ndị America hụrụ amamịghe na agwa na mgbamume” nke Kavanaugh n’ụbọchị ahụ.

rows.source: "A vote to confirm Judge Kavanaugh is a vote to confirm one of the most accomplished legal minds of our time, a jurist with a sterling record of public service," he told the crowd of West Virginia supporters.
rows.output: "Vootu iji kwado Ụkọn Kavanaugh bụ vootu ijiado otu n'ime ndị nwere ọgụgụ isi iwu kachasị ukwuu n'oge anyị, onye ọka ikpe nwere ndekọ ọla edo nke ọrụ ọha."
rows.reference: “Otu ntuli aka iji kwenye na Ọkaikpe Kavanaugh bụ otu ntuli aka iji kwenye n’otu uche iwu kachasị tozuo etozu n’oge anyị, onye ọkaiwu nwere ndekọ nke ọrụ ọhaneze na amuke amuke,” ọ gwara igwe mmadụ nke ndị nkwado West Virginia.

rows.source: The President obliquely referred to Kavanaugh's nomination while talking about the importance of Republican turnout in the midterm elections.
rows.output: Onye isi ala ahụ kwuru n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi maka nhọpụta Kavanaugh mgbe ọ na-ekwu maka mkpa ndị Republican na-eme ntụliaka na ntuli aka etiti oge.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala ahụ iji ụzọ ọzọ wee rụtụ aka na nhọpụta Kavanaugh ka ọ na ekwu maka mkpa nke mpụta ndị Repọblikan na ntuli aka ndị etiti afọ.

rows.source: "Five weeks away from one of the most important elections in our lifetimes.
rows.output: "Oge ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na ise na
rows.reference: “Izu ise fọdụrụ tupu otu ntuli aka kachasị mkpa na ndụ anyị.

rows.source: I'm not running, but I'm really running," he said.
rows.output: Anaghị m agbapụ, mana m na-agba ọsọ n'ezie," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: Anaghị m apụta, mana m na apụta n’ezie,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "That's why I'm all over the place fighting for great candidates."
rows.output: "Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere m ji na-agba mbọ n'ebe niile na-alụ ọgụ maka ndị na-eme ihe dị mma."
rows.reference: “Ya mere m ji nọrọ n’ebe niile na akwado ndị anamachọihe mara oke mma.”

rows.source: Trump argued that Democrats are on a mission to "resist and obstruct."
rows.output: Trump kwuru na ndị Democrats na-achọ "ịgọnarị na iguzo n'ụzọ."
rows.reference: Trump rụrụ aka na ndị Demokrats nọ na njem iji “kwụsị ma gbochido.”

rows.source: The first key procedural vote on the Senate floor on Kavanaugh's nomination is expected to take place no later than Friday, a senior GOP leadership aide has told CNN.
rows.output: Ntugharị mbụ na usoro Senate ala na nhọpụta Kavanaugh ka a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-eme tupu Fraịde, onye isi ndị isi GOP kwuru na CNN.
rows.reference: Ntuli aka izizi dị mkpa n’ọkwa Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu maka nhọpụta nke Kavanaugh ka atụrụ anya ga-eme tupu Fraịde gachaa, onye otu ọchịchị GOP dị elu gwara CNN.

rows.source: Hundreds killed by Indonesian quake, tsunami, with toll seen rising
rows.output: Puku ndị e gburu site na ala ọma jijiji Indonesia, tsunami, na ọnụ ọgụgụ a na-ahụ na ọ ga-arị elu
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji, tsunami, nke Indonesia gburu narị kwụrụ narị ndị mmadụ, ọgụgụ ka na agbago

rows.source: At least 384 people were killed, many swept away as giant waves crashed onto beaches, when a major earthquake and tsunami hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi, authorities said on Saturday.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị ala, mmadụ 384 nwụrụ, ọtụtụ ndị ebugara n'oké osimiri ka ebili mmiri buru ibu dakwasịrị n'ụsọ oké osimiri, mgbe nnukwu ala ọma jijiji na ebili mmiri dakwasịrị n'agwaetiti Sulawesi nke Indonesia, ndị ọrụ gọọmentị kwuru na Satọde.
rows.reference: Opekata mpe egburu ndị mmadụ 384, ka nnukwu ikuku dara n’akụkụ osimiri ekpochapụrụ ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ, mgbe nnukwu ala ọmajiji na tsunami kụrụ agwaetiti Indonesia nke Sulawesi, ndị ikikere kwuru na Satọde.

rows.source: Hundreds of people had gathered for a festival on the beach in the city of Palu on Friday when waves as high as six meters (18 feet) smashed onshore at dusk, sweeping many to their deaths and destroying anything in their path.
rows.output: Ndị mmadụ dị narị na-ejukwa n'ebe a na-eme mmemme n'akụkụ osimiri obodo Palu n'ụbọchị Fraịde mgbe ebili mmiri dị elu ruru mita isii (ụkwụ iri na asatọ) dakwasịrị n'ụsọ oké osimiri n'ehihie, na-eburu ọtụtụ mmadụ n'ụzọ ọnwụ ma mebisie ihe ọ bụla nọ n'ụzọ ha.
rows.reference: Narị kwụrụ narị ndị mmadụ bịakọtara maka emume n’akụkụ osimiri n’obodo nke Palu na Fraịde mgbe ikuku ruru ogo mita isii (ụkwụ 18) dara n’ala n’oge uhuruchi, zara imirikiti banye n’ọnwụ ha ma na emebi ihe ọ bụla dị n’ụzọ ya.

rows.source: The tsunami followed a 7.5 magnitude earthquake.
rows.output: Mgbọrọgwụ ahụ sochiri ihe mgbapụta ala nke dị 7.5 n'ogologo.
rows.reference: Tsunami ahụ sotere ala ọmajiji ike 7.5.

rows.source: "When the tsunami threat arose yesterday, people were still doing their activities on the beach and did not immediately run and they became victims," Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, the spokesman for Indonesia's disaster mitigation agency BNPB said in a briefing in Jakarta.
rows.output: "Ọbụrụ mgbe ihe iyi egwu tsunami pụtara ụbọchị gara aga, ndị mmadụ ka na-eme ihe n'ụsọ oké osimiri ma ha ewerela ngwa ngwa ịgbaga, ha wee ghọọ ndị iju mmadụ." Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, onye na-ekwu okwu maka ụlọ ọrụ Indonesia maka igbochi ihe mberede BNPB, kwuru n'oge nnọkọ na Jakarta.
rows.reference: “Mgbe ihe egwu tsunami ahụ bidoro ụnyahụ, ndị mmadụ nọ na eme mmemme ha n’akụkụ osimiri ahụ, ha agbaghị ọsọ ozugbo, ya mere o ji metụta ha,” Sutopo Purwo Nugrogo, okwu okwu maka ụlọ ọrụ njikwa ọdachi mba nke Indonesia BNPS kwuru na nchịkọta na Jakarta.

rows.source: "The tsunami didn't come by itself, it dragged cars, logs, houses, it hit everything on land," Nugroho said, adding that the tsunami had traveled across the open sea at speeds of 800 kph (497 mph) before striking the shoreline.
rows.output: "Ọgbụgba ebili mmiri ahụ abụghị naanị ya, ọ kpọpụrụ ụgbọala, osisi, ụlọ, ọ kụrụ ihe niile dị n'ala," Nugroho kwuru, na-agbakwunyere na ebili mmiri ahụ agafeela n'oké osimiri na ọsọ nke 800 kph (497 mph) tupu ọ kụọ n'ikpere mmiri.
rows.reference: “Tsunami ahụ abịaghị n’aka ya, o burulu ụgbọ ala, osisi, ụlọ, ọ kụrụ ihe niile nọ n’ala,” Nugroho kwuru, na ekwukwa na tsunami ahụ gafere na nnukwu osimiri n’ọsọ nke 800 kph (497 mph) tupu o daruo n’akụkụ osimiri.

rows.source: Some people climbed trees to escape the tsunami and survived, he said.
rows.output: Ụfọdụ ndị rịgoro n’osisi ka ha si n’oké ebili mmiri gbapụ ma dị ndụ, o kwuru.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ rịrị elu osisi iji gbanarị tsunami ahụ ma dị ndụ, o kwuru.

rows.source: Around 16,700 people were evacuated to 24 centers in Palu.
rows.output: N'ihe dị ka mmadụ 16,700 ebugara n'ebe a na-anọpụ iche iri abụọ na anọ na Palu.
rows.reference: Ebugara ihe ruru ndị mmadụ 16,700 n’ama 24 dị na Palu.

rows.source: Aerial photographs released by the disaster agency showed many buildings and shops destroyed, bridges twisted and collapsed and a mosque surrounded by water.
rows.output: Foto ikuku e wepụtara site na ụlọ ọrụ ihe mberede gosiri ọtụtụ ụlọ na ụlọ ahịa mebiri emebi, àkwà mmiri gbawara agbawa na nke gbawara agbawa, na ụlọ ala nsọ gbara mmiri gburugburu.
rows.reference: Ọsịse elu nke ụlọ ọrụ ọdachi ahụ buputere gosiri imirikiti ụlọ na ụlọ ahịa emebisiri, akwa mmiri gbagochara ma daa yana ụlọ alakụba mmiri gbara okirikiri.

rows.source: Aftershocks continued to rock the coastal city on Saturday.
rows.output: Mgbagha na-aga n'ihu na-akụda obodo dị n'akụkụ osimiri na Satọde.
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji gara n’ihu na eme n’ụsọ oke osimiri ahụ na Satọde.

rows.source: The series of earthquakes were felt in an area with 2.4 million people.
rows.output: Mgbọrọgwụ ala ndị ahụ dị na mpaghara nwere mmadụ nde 2.4.
rows.reference: Enwere mmetụta usoro nke ala ọmajiji na mpaghara nwere ndị mmadụ nde 2.4.

rows.source: Indonesia's Agency for the Assessment and Application of Technology (BPPT) said in statement the energy released by Friday's massive quake was around 200 times the power of the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima in World War Two.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Indonesia maka nyocha na itinye teknụzụ (BPPT) kwuru na nkwupụta na ike a na-ebupụta site na nnukwu ala ọma jijiji nke Fraịde dị ihe dị ka 200 ugboro ike bọmbụ atomik nke dọọrọ na Hiroshima n'oge Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ Ọrụ maka Nyocha na Ntinye nke Teknụzụ nke Indonesia (BPPT) kwuru na nkwupute na ike nnukwu ọmajiji nke Fraịde buputere dị ihe dị ka ugboro 200 nke ike nke ogbunigwe atọmik atụsara na Hiroshima na Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ.

rows.source: The geography of the city, which sits at the end of a long, narrow bay, could have magnified the size of the tsunami, it said.
rows.output: Oge ala nke obodo ahụ, nke dị na njedebe nke ogologo, obere ọdọ mmiri, nwere ike ime ka oke oke nke tsunami dịkwuo elu, o kwuru.
rows.reference: Ala nke obodo ahụ, nke tukwu na ngwụcha nke mpaghara osimiri toro ogologo, dị warawara, nwere ike ibuwanye nha nke tsunami ahụ, ka o kwuru.

rows.source: Nugroho described the damage as "extensive" and said thousands of houses, hospitals, shopping malls and hotels had collapsed.
rows.output: Nugroho kọwara mmebi ahụ dị ka "nke ukwuu" ma kwuo na puku ụlọ, ụlọ ọgwụ, ụlọ ahịa, na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ dara.
rows.reference: Nugroho kọwara mmebi ahụ ka “ihe gbasara agbasa” ma kwuo puku kwụrụ puku nke ụlọ, ụlọ ọgwụ, ọdụ ụlọ ahịa na ụlọ nkwari dara.

rows.source: Bodies of some victims were found trapped under the rubble of collapsed buildings, he said, adding 540 people were injured and 29 were missing.
rows.output: Achọtara ozu ụfọdụ ndị ahụ n'ime ihe ndị dara ada, o kwuru, na-agbakwunyere na mmadụ 540 merụrụ ahụ na 29 na-efunarị.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ ahụ nke ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ ọ metụtara n’okpuru ahịhịa nke ụlọ ndị dara, o kwuru, tinye ndị mmadụ 540 merụrụ ahụ ma 29 na efu.

rows.source: Nugroho said the casualties and the damage could be greater along the coastline 300 km (190 miles) north of Palu, an area called Donggala, which is closer to the epicenter of the quake.
rows.output: Nugroho kwuru na ndị nwụrụ na mmebi ahụ nwere ike ịbụ nnukwu n'akụkụ osimiri dị ihe dị ka 300 km (190) n'ebe ugwu Palu, ebe a na-akpọ Donggala, nke dị nso na ebe ala ọtọ nke ala ọtọ.
rows.reference: Nugroho kwuru na ndị nwụrụ yana mmebi nwere ike ịkarị n’ogologo ụsọ oke osimiri ahụ 300km (maịlụ 190) n’akụkụ ugwu nke Palu, mpaghara a na akpọ Donggala, nke nọketere nso na etiti nke ọmajiji ahụ.

rows.source: Communications "were totally crippled with no information" from Donggala, Nugroho said.
rows.output: Nkwurịta okwu "kpọnwụrụ kpamkpam na enweghị ozi" site na Donggala, Nugroho kwuru.
rows.reference: Nkwukọrịta enweghị ozi ọ bụla ma ncha sitere na Donggala, Nugroho kwuru.

rows.source: There are more than 300,000 people living there," the Red Cross said in a statement, adding that its staff and volunteers were heading to the affected areas.
rows.output: Enwere ihe karịrị mmadụ 300,000 bi ebe ahụ," otu Red Cross kwuru na nkwupụta, na-agbakwunyere na ndị ọrụ ha na ndị ọrụ ebere na-aga ebe ahụ metụtara.
rows.reference: Enwere karịa ndị mmadụ 300,000 bi ebe ahụ,” Red Cross kwuru na nkwupute, na etinye na ndị ọrụ ya na ndị wepụtara onwe ha na aga n’ebe ndị emetụtara.

rows.source: "This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse," it said.
rows.output: "Nke a bụ ihe na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-adịghị mma, ma ọ nwere ike ime ka ọ ka njọ."
rows.reference: O kwuru “nke a abụrụla ihe mberede, mana ọ nwere ike ịkawanye njọ,”.

rows.source: The agency on Saturday was widely criticized for not informing that a tsunami had hit Palu, though officials said waves had come within the time the warning was issued.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ nwetara nnukwu nkatọ na Satọde maka na ha emeghị ka ọ bụrụ na ebili mmiri tsunami kụrụ Palu, n'agbanyeghị na ndị ọrụ kwuru na ebili mmiri ahụ rutela n'oge a na-enye ịdọ aka ná ntị.
rows.reference: Ekwutọrọ ụlọ ọrụ ahụ nke ukwuu na Satọde maka ịhapụ ikwu na tsunami dara na Palu, agbanyeghị na ndị ọrụ kwuru na nnukwu ikuku bịara n’oge enyere ịdọ aka na ntị ahụ.

rows.source: In amateur footage shared on social media a man on the upper floor of a building can be heard shouting frantic warnings of the approaching tsunami to people on the street below.
rows.output: N'ihe nkiri ndị na-eme ihe nkiri na mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta ọha, otu nwoke nọ n'elu ụlọ nwere ike ịnụ ka ọ na-eti mkpu n'ụjọ na-ekwu na ebili mmiri na-abịa n'ụzọ dị iche iche.
rows.reference: Na nseta ekekọrịtara n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze enwere ike ịnụ ka otu nwoke nọ n’elu ụlọ na eti nnukwu mkpu na adọ aka na ntị maka tsunami na abịa nke ọ na agwa ndị mmadụ n’okporo ụzọ dị n’okpuru.

rows.source: Within minutes a wall of water crashes onto the shore, carrying away buildings and cars.
rows.output: N'ime nkeji ole na ole, mmiri na-efegharị n'elu, na-eburu ụlọ na ụgbọala.
rows.reference: N’ime nkeji ole ma ole nnukwu mmiri dara n’akụkụ osimiri ahụ, buru ụlọ na ụgbọ ala.

rows.source: Reuters was not able to immediately authenticate the footage.
rows.output: Reuters enwetaghị ohere ịkwanyere ihe nkiri ahụ ozugbo.
rows.reference: Reuters enwenwughi ike inyocha nseta ahụ.

rows.source: The quake and tsunami caused a major power outage that cut communications around Palu making it difficult for authorities to coordinate rescue efforts.
rows.output: Mgbawa ahụ na ebili mmiri ahụ butere nnukwu ọkụ eletrik nke bibiri ụzọ nkwurịta okwu gburugburu Palu, nke mere ka ọ bụrụ ihe isi ike ka ndị ọchịchị na-achịkwa mbọ nnapụta.
rows.reference: Ọmajiji na tsunami ahụ butere nnukwu mmebi n’ọkụ latrik nke gbubiri nkwukọrịta n’okirikiri Palu na eme ka ndị ikikere nwee nhịahụ na ịhazi mbọ ịzọpụta ndị mmadụ.

rows.source: The military has started sending in cargo planes with aid from Jakarta and other cities, authorities said, but evacuees still badly need food and other basic necessities.
rows.output: Ndị agha amalitela iziga ụgbọ elu ibu na enyemaka sitere n'obodo Jakarta na ndị ọzọ, ndị ọrụ gọọmentị kwuru, mana ndị a na-azọpụta ka chọrọ nri na ihe ndị ọzọ dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Ndị agha ebidola iziga ụgbọ elu eji ebu ibu bu ihe enyemaka sitere na Jakarta yana obodo ndị ọzọ, ndị ikikere kwuru, mana ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ka chọrọ nri na akụrụngwa ndị ọzọ eji ebi ndụ ngwangwa.

rows.source: The city's airport has been reopened only for relief efforts and will remain closed until Oct.
rows.output: Ụlọ ụgbọ elu obodo ahụ emegheela naanị maka mbọ enyemaka ma ga-anọgide na-emechi ruo Ọktoba.
rows.reference: Emepegharịala ọdụ ụgbọ elu nke obodo ahụ naanị maka mbọ ihe enyemaka, a ga-aga n’ihu mechie ya ruo Ọkt.

rows.source: President Joko Widodo was scheduled to visit evacuation centers in Palu on Sunday.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Joko Widodo bu n'obi ịga ụlọ mgbaba nọọsụ na Palu na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Joko Widodo kwesịrị ịbịa n’ama mgbabata ọsọ ndụ ndị dị na Palu na Sọnde.

rows.source: Indonesia Tsunami Toll Soars Above 800.
rows.output: Mgbapụta tsunami Indonesia agafeela 800.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ Tsunami Indonesia Agafeela 800.

rows.source: It Is Very Bad.
rows.output: Ọ dị njọ nke ukwuu.
rows.reference: Ọ Jọrọ Oke Njọ.

rows.source: While World Vision's staff from Donggala have made it safely to Palu city, where employees are sheltering in tarpaulin shelters set up in the courtyard of their office, they passed scenes of devastation on the way, Mr. Doseba said.
rows.output: N'oge a na-ahụ maka ọrụ nke World Vision si Donggala, ndị ọrụ ahụ rutela n'obodo Palu, ebe ndị ọrụ na-ezo n'ụlọikwuu tarpaulin e debere n'ogige ụlọ ọrụ ha, ha hụrụ ihe mmebi dị egwu n'ụzọ ahụ, Maazị Doseba kwuru.
rows.reference: Ebe ndị ọrụ World Vision si Donggala garuru n’obodo Palu na enweghị nsogbu, ebe ndị ọrụ ya na anara ndo n’okpuru mkpuchi tapọlin atọlitere na mpụga nke ụlọ ọrụ ha, ha gafere okirikiri nke mbibi n’ụzọ ha, Maazị Doseba kwuru.

rows.source: "They told me they saw lots of houses that were destroyed," he said.
rows.output: "Ndị ahụ gwara m na ha hụrụ ọtụtụ ụlọ ndị e bibiri," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: O kwuru “ha gwara m na ha hụrụ ọtụtụ ụlọ emebiri,”.

rows.source: It is very bad.
rows.output: Ọ dị oke njọ.
rows.reference: Ọ jọrọ oke njọ.

rows.source: Even as aid groups began the grim motions of starting the gears of disaster relief, some complained that foreign aid workers with deep expertise were being prevented from traveling to Palu.
rows.output: Ọbụna mgbe ndị otu na-enyere aka malitere ihe na-adịghị mma nke ịmalite igwe nke enyemaka ihe mberede, ụfọdụ ndị na-ekwu na ndị ọrụ enyemaka mba ọzọ nwere nnukwu ihe ọmụma na-ewerekarị na ha agaghị aga Palu.
rows.reference: Ọbụlagodi ka ndị otu enyemaka bidoro ọrụ nhịahụ nke ibido ụkwụ nke ihe enyemaka ọdachi, ụfọdụ kpesara na a na egbochi ndị ọrụ enyemaka mba ofesi nwere nka dị mkpa na ịga na Palu.

rows.source: According to Indonesian regulations, funding, supplies and staffing from overseas can only start flowing if the site of a calamity is declared a national disaster zone.
rows.output: N'ime iwu ndị Indonesia, ego, ngwa na ndị ọrụ sitere na mba ọzọ nwere ike ịmalite ịnyagharị naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ebe ihe mberede dị.
rows.reference: Site n’aka ndị iwu nke Indonesia, ego, ngwa na ndị ọrụ si na mba ofesi nwere naanị ike ibido ịga ma ọ bụrụ na akpọọ ebe nke mbibi ahụ ihe ogige ọdachi mba.

rows.source: That has not happened yet.
rows.output: Nke ahụ emebeghị.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ emebeghị.

rows.source: "It's still a province level disaster," said Aulia Arriani, a spokesperson for the Indonesian Red Cross.
rows.output: "Ọ ka bụ ihe mberede dị na ọkwa steeti," ka Aulia Arriani, onye na-ekwu okwu maka Red Cross nke Indonesia kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ ka bụ ọdachi ọkwa ogige,” Aulia Arriani kwuru, onye okwu okwu maka Red Cross nke Indonesia.

rows.source: "Once the government says, "O.K., this is a national disaster," we can open for international assistance but there's no status yet."
rows.output: "Ozugbo gọọmentị kwuru, "O.K., a bụ ihe mberede mba," anyị nwere ike imeghe maka enyemaka mba ụwa mana enweghị ọnọdụ."
rows.reference: “Ozugbo gọọmentị ahụ kwuru, “Ọ dị mma, nke a bụ ọdachi mba,” anyị nwere ike imepe maka enyemaka ofesi mana enwebeghị ọkwa ọ bụla.”

rows.source: As the second night fell on Palu after Friday's earthquake and tsunami, friends and family of those still missing were holding out hope that their loved ones would be the miracles that leaven the bleak story lines of natural disasters.
rows.output: N'abalị nke abụọ dara na Palu ka abalị Fraịdee gasịrị, ndị enyi na ndị ezinụlọ nke ndị ka na-efunarị olileanya na ndị ha hụrụ n'anya ga-abụ ihe ebube ga-eme ka akụkọ ndị na-adịghị mma nke ihe ndị sitere n'okike dịkwuo mma.
rows.reference: Ka abalị nke abụọ dara na Palu ka ala ọmajiji na tsunami nke Fraịde mechara, ndị enyi na ezinụlọ nke ndị ka na efu jidere okwukwe na ndị ha hụrụ n’anya ga-abụ ọrụ ebube na akpalite mmụọ nke akụkụ ọjọọ nke ọdachi ekereụwa.

rows.source: On Saturday, a little boy was plucked from a sewer.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọdee, a na-ewepụ nwa nwoke dị obere n'ime mmiri mmiri.
rows.reference: Na Satọde, akpapụtara otu obere nwa n’ime olulu.

rows.source: On Sunday, rescuers freed a woman who had been pinned under rubble for two days with the body of her mother next to her.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Sọnde, ndị na-azụlite zọpụtaziri otu nwanyị nke e jidere n'okpuru ihe ndị dara ada ruo ụbọchị abụọ na ahụ nne ya n'akụkụ ya.
rows.reference: Na Sọnde, ndị mgbata ọsọ enyemaka zọpụtara otu nwanyị nke akpadoro n’okpuru ahịhịa n’ime ụbọchị abụọ, n’akụkụ ya bụ ahụ nne ya.

rows.source: Gendon Subandono, the coach of the Indonesian national paragliding team, had trained two of the missing paragliders for the Asian Games, which wrapped up earlier this month in Indonesia.
rows.output: Gendon Subandono, onye nkuzi nke ndị otu mba Indonesia na-agba ọsọ, zụrụla ndị na-agba ọsọ abụọ na-efunahụ maka egwuregwu Asia, nke mechara na Indonesia.
rows.reference: Gendon Subandono, onye ndu nke ndị otu paraglaịdịn nke mba Indonesia, zụrụ mmadụ abụọ nke ndị paraglaịdas maka Egwuregwu Asia na efu, nke mechiri na mbido nke ọnwa a na Indonesia.

rows.source: Others of those trapped at the Roa Roa Hotel, Mr. Mandagi included, were his students.
rows.output: Ndị ọzọ ndị e jidere n'ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ Roa Roa, Maazị Mandagi tinyere, bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ ya.
rows.reference: Ndị ọzọ nke ejidere n’okpuru Ụlọ Nkwari Akụ Roa Roa, Maazị Mandagi gụnyere, bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.

rows.source: "As a senior in the paragliding field, I have my own emotional burden," he said.
rows.output: "Dị ka onye isi na ubọchị, enwere m ibu mmetụta uche nke m."
rows.reference: “Dị ka onye ọkaibe n’ama paraglaidin, enwere nsogbu mmụọ nke m, o kwuru.

rows.source: Mr. Gendon recounted how, in the hours after the news of the Roa Roa Hotel collapse circulated among the paragliding community, he had desperately sent WhatsApp messages to the Palu competitors, who were taking part in the beach festival.
rows.output: Nna Gendon kwuru otu oge, n'ime awa ole na ole ka akụkọ nke mgbaba ụlọ Roa Roa gasịrị n'etiti obodo ndị na-ese n'elu mmiri, o zipụrụ ozi WhatsApp na-agbawa obi na ndị asọmpi Palu, bụ ndị na-eme mmemme n'ụsọ oké osimiri.
rows.reference: Maazị Gendon chetara otu, n’ime elekere ka akụkọ nke ọdịda Ụlọ Nkwari Akụ Roa Roa gbasara n’ime ogbe paraglaịdịn, o ji ọsọ zigara ndị asọmpi Palu ozi na WhatsApp, ndị na esonye n’emume akụkụ osimiri ahụ.

rows.source: His messages, though, only resulted in one gray check mark, rather than a pair of blue checks.
rows.output: Ozi ya, n'agbanyeghị, butere naanị otu akara agba acha anụnụ anụnụ, kama akara abụọ na-acha anụnụ anụnụ.
rows.reference: Ozi ya, agbanyeghị, dapụtara naanị n’otu nrịbama agba ntụ, kama nrịbama agba eluigwe dị mkpị.

rows.source: "I think that means the messages were not delivered," he said.
rows.output: "Ekwenyere m na nke ahụ pụtara na ozi ahụ adịghị ebuga ya," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Echere m na nke ahụ pụtara na ezigaghị ozi ndị ahụ,” ka o kwuru.

rows.source: Thieves take $26,750 during ATM refill at Newport on the Levee
rows.output: Ndị ohi na-eburu $26,750 n'oge na-eme ka ATM na Newport na Levee.
rows.reference: Ndị oyi were $26,750 n’oge mkpojugharị ATM na Newport dị na Levee

rows.source: Thieves on Friday morning stole $26,750 from a Brink's worker refilling an ATM at Newport on the Levee, according to a news release from the Newport Police Department.
rows.output: Ndị ohi ji $26,750 n'isi ụtụtụ Fraịde were n'aka onye ọrụ Brink's na-eme ka ATM na-eme ka ọ dị na Newport on the Levee, dị ka ntọhapụ ozi sitere na ngalaba ndị uwe ojii Newport si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ndị oyi n’ụtụtụ Fraịde zuru $26,750 n’aka onye ọrụ Brink na ekpojugharị ATM dị na Newport na Levee, site na akụkọ ebuputere n’aka Ngalaba Ndị Uwe Ojii Newport.

rows.source: The car's driver had been emptying an ATM in the entertainment complex and preparing to deliver more money, Det. Dennis McCarthy wrote in the release.
rows.output: Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ahụ na-ebupụla ụlọ akụ ATM n'ime ebe ntụrụndụ ma na-akwado ibufe ego ọzọ, ka onye nchọpụta Dennis McCarthy dere na ntọhapụ ahụ.
rows.reference: Ọkwọ ụgbọ ala nke ụgbọ ala ahụ na ekpochapụ ATM dị n’ụlọ ntụrụndụ ahụ ma na akwadobe itinyekwu ego ọzọ, Onye Uwe Ojii. Dennis McCarthy dere na nkwupute ahụ.

rows.source: While he was occupied, another man "ran up from behind the Brink's employee" and stole a bag of money meant for delivery.
rows.output: N'oge ọ na-arụ ọrụ, otu nwoke ọzọ "bilitere n'azụ onye ọrụ Brink" ma zuru akpa ego e mere maka ibufe.
rows.reference: Ka ọ nọ n’ọrụ, nwoke ọzọ “si n’azụ wụchibido onye ọrụ nke Brink ahụ” wee zuru akpa ego ezubere maka nnyefe.

rows.source: Witnesses spotted multiple suspects fleeing the scene, according to the release, but police did not specify the number involved in the incident.
rows.output: Ndị akaebe ahụ hụrụ ọtụtụ ndị a na-enyo enyo na-agbapụ n'ebe ahụ, dị ka nkwupụta ahụ si kwuo, mana ndị uwe ojii akọwaghị ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị metụtara ihe ahụ.
rows.reference: Ndị akaebe hụrụ ọtụtụ ndị a na enyo enyo na agbapụ n’okirikiri ahụ, site na nkwupute ahụ, mana ndị uwe ojii akọwapụtaghị mmadụ ole so na mmereme ahụ.

rows.source: Anyone with information about their identities should contact Newport police at 859-292-3680.
rows.output: Onye ọ bụla nwere ozi gbasara njirimara ha kwesịrị ịkpọtụrụ ndị uwe ojii Newport na 859-292-3680.
rows.reference: Onye ọ bụla nwere ozi maka njirimara ha kwesịrị ịkpọtụrụ ndị uwe ojii Newport na 859-292-3680.

rows.source: Kanye West: Rapper changes his name to Ye
rows.output: Kanye West: Onye na-agụ egwu na-agbanwe aha ya ka ọ bụrụ Ye
rows.reference: Kanye West: Rapa gbanwere aha ya ka ọ bụrụ Ye

rows.source: Rapper Kanye West is changing his name - to Ye.
rows.output: Onye na-agụ egwu Kanye West na-agbanwe aha ya - ka ọ bụrụ Ye.
rows.reference: Rapa Kanye West na agbanwe aha ya - ka ọ bụrụ Ye.

rows.source: Announcing the change on Twitter on Saturday, he wrote: "The being formally known as Kanye West."
rows.output: Na-ekwu na Twitter na Satọde, o dere: "Onye ahụ a na-akpọbu Kanye West."
rows.reference: Na ekwupute mgbanwe ahụ na Twitter na Satọde, ọ dere: “Mmadụ amabu ka Kanye West.”

rows.source: West, 41, has been nicknamed Ye for some time and used the moniker as the title for his eighth album, which was released in June.
rows.output: Ọwesị, 41, a na-akpọkarị Ye kemgbe oge, ma jiri aha ahụ mee ihe dị ka aha album nke asatọ ya, nke e wepụtara na June.
rows.reference: West, afọ 41, azaala Ye ka aha otutu ya n’oge nso nso a ma jiri aha otutu ahụ ka aha nke egwu nke asatọ ya, nke ebuputere na Juun.

rows.source: The change comes ahead of his appearance on Saturday Night Live, where he is expected to launch his new album Yandhi.
rows.output: Mgbanwe a na-eme tupu ihe ngosi ya na Satọde Night Live, ebe a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ewebata album ọhụrụ ya Yandhi.
rows.reference: Mgbanwe ndị ahụ na abịa tupu mpụta ya na Saturday Night Live, ebe atụrụ anya na ọ ga-ebupụta egwu ọhụrụ ya Yandhi.

rows.source: He replaces singer Ariana Grande on the show who cancelled for "emotional reasons," the show's creator said.
rows.output: Ọ na-anọchi onye na-abụ abụ Ariana Grande na ihe ngosi ahụ bụ onye kwụsịrị maka "ihe ndị mmetụta uche," dịka onye okike ihe ngosi ahụ kwuru.
rows.reference: Ọ na anọchi ọkụegwu Ariana Grande n’ihe ngosi ahụ onye kagburu “n’ihi ihe obi mmụọ,” onye mmepụta ihe ngosi ahụ kwuru.

rows.source: As well as being an abbreviation of his current professional name, West has previously said the word has religious significance for him.
rows.output: Ọ bụghị naanị aha ọrụ ya ugbu a, West ekwukwala na okwu ahụ nwere ihe dị nsọ nye ya.
rows.reference: Yanakwa ịbụ nkenke nke aha njirimara ya dị ugbu a, West ekwubuola na mkpụrụokwu ahụ nwere nghọta okpukperechi n’ebe ọ nọ.

rows.source: "I believe 'ye' is the most commonly used word in the Bible, and in the Bible it means 'you,'" West said earlier this year, discussing his album title with radio host Big Boy.
rows.output: "Ekwenyesiri m na 'ye' bụ okwu a na-ejikarị eme ihe n'ụzọ dị ukwuu n'ime Akwụkwọ Nsọ, ma n'ime Akwụkwọ Nsọ, ọ pụtara 'iwe gị,'" ka West kwuru na mbụ n'afọ a, na-ekwu maka aha album ya na onye na-eme ihe nkiri Big Boy.
rows.reference: “Ekwenyere m na ‘ye’ bụ mkpụrụokwu akachasị jiri n’ime Akwụkwọ Nsọ, n’ime Akwụkwọ Nsọ ọ pụtara ‘gị,”” West kwuru na mbido afọ a, mgbe ọ na akparịta maka aha egwu ya n’etiti onye njikwa redio Big Boy.

rows.source: "So I'm you, I'm us, it's us.
rows.output: "Ya mere, mụ bụ gị, mụ bụ anyị, ọ bụ anyị.
rows.reference: “Yabụ abụ m gị, abụ m anyị, ọ bụ anyị.

rows.source: It went from Kanye, which means the only one, to just Ye - just being a reflection of our good, our bad, our confused, everything.
rows.output: Ọ gara site na Kanye, nke pụtara naanị otu, gaa na naanị Ye - naanị ịbụ ihe ngosi nke ihe ọma anyị, ihe ọjọọ anyị, ihe mgbagwoju anya anyị, ihe niile.
rows.reference: O si na Kanye, nke pụtara nke ọ bụ naanị ya, ịbụ naanị Ye - nke bụ ngosipụta nke mma anyị, njọ anyị, mgbagwoju anya anyị, ihe niile.

rows.source: The album is more of a reflection of who we are."
rows.output: "Album ahụ bụ ihe ngosi nke onye anyị bụ."
rows.reference: Egwu ahụ bụkwa ngosipụta nke onye anyị bụ.”

rows.source: He is one of a number of famous rappers to change their name.
rows.output: Ọ bụ otu n'ime ọtụtụ ndị na-agba egwu ama ama na-agbanwe aha ha.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ otu n’ime rapa ndị ama ama gbanwere aha ha.

rows.source: Sean Combs has been variously known as Puff Daddy, P. Diddy or Diddy, but this year announced his preference for the names Love and Brother Love.
rows.output: Sean Combs a maara dị ka Puff Daddy, P. Diddy ma ọ bụ Diddy, ma n'afọ a, ọ kwuputara mmasị ya maka aha Love na Brother Love.
